article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuddalore: Bird flu alert, stringent preventive measures at the testing checkpoints
article.articleSummary: Bird flu alert in Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district: Avian influenza detected on poultry farms in the Kurinjippadi–Kattiyanguppam area on the 13th. The illness is caused by Influenza A virus, notably H5N1 strains, which primarily affect chickens and ducks but can rarely infect humans and other mammals. In response, the Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry Department has intensified preventive measures statewide. Seven testing checkpoints at Panthalur and Kudalur corridors conducted anti-influenza operations, including rigorous disinfection using germicidal agents. Vehicles from Kerala and Karnataka bringing live birds and eggs were halted at these posts; buses and other vehicles from Kerala were stopped, disinfected, and poultry transport was redirected away from Tamil Nadu. Additional surveys were carried out in nearby Torappalli and surrounding areas, with ongoing guidance issued by the region's joint director, Dr. Neelavannan. Authorities say preventive actions will continue.

triage.headline_ja: クダロール:鳥インフルエンザ警戒、検査拠点で厳格な予防対策
triage.triage_reason: 家禽でのH5N1発生に伴う州内の移動規制・消毒対策が報告されているが、人への感染例は確認されておらず、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響は現時点で不明。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州クダロール県の家禽農場でのH5N1検出と、ケララ・カルナータカ州との境界での検疫強化を報じている。人への感染例の報告はなく、動物衛生当局による予防的対応が中心。

article.articleHeadline: College Freshmen in China Show High Willingness for Tuberculosis Screening
article.articleSummary: Anhui Province, China—Among 9,790 first-year university students surveyed in April 2025, willingness to participate in tuberculosis (TB) screening and preventive treatment was high, despite knowledge gaps. The cross-sectional study, published in BMC Infectious Diseases, used multistage stratified cluster sampling and anonymous electronic questionnaires to assess TB knowledge (average core knowledge 75.8%), Health Belief Model constructs, and readiness for campus TB control measures. Mean willingness scores were 4.61 ± 0.74 for screening and 4.72 ± 0.66 for preventive treatment on a 5-point scale. In multivariable linear mixed-effects models (random intercepts by institution), greater TB knowledge, perceived benefits, self-efficacy, and cues to action independently predicted higher willingness for both screening and treatment. Perceived susceptibility and disease severity were not significantly associated. The findings suggest campus health promotion should clarify key facts, emphasize benefits, boost self-efficacy, and provide actionable cues to engage new students.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の大学新入生、結核検診への意欲が高い
triage.triage_reason: 結核の疫学調査・意識調査に関する学術研究記事であり、新規の公衆衛生イベントや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核に対する大学新入生の検診受診意欲に関する学術研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A có thể khiến người cao tuổi viêm phổi, suy hô hấp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A can cause pneumonia and respiratory failure in the elderly.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infections are triggering pneumonia risk and potential respiratory failure among the elderly in Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam. At Van Don Regional General Hospital, over 50 patients with respiratory infections were treated in the past week, with many diagnosed as influenza A. Elderly patients showed severe symptoms, including hypertension, dyspnea, bronchitis, and pneumonia, with some requiring monitoring and hospitalization for respiratory failure. Classic influenza A symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, myalgia, and fatigue. Older adults, especially with underlying conditions, face complex disease progression. Physicians urge prompt medical evaluation for fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, and body aches; seek urgent care for shortness of breath, rapid breathing, chest pain, cyanosis, confusion, or prolonged high fever. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics or antivirals. Prevention priorities: vaccination, hand hygiene, masking in crowds, avoiding close contact with sick individuals, and annual influenza vaccination, especially for the elderly and high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: A型インフルエンザは高齢者に肺炎や呼吸不全を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる高齢者の重症化に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA型による高齢者の合併症リスクに関する一般的な医療情報・注意喚起記事。特定のアウトブレイクや異常な増加を示すデータはなく、通常の季節性疾患として扱われるべき内容。

article.articleHeadline: 43 fall ill after eating Bhiwandi street shawarma
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning from a roadside chicken shawarma stall in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, sickened 43 people, including 17 men, 16 women, and 10 children, with ages from 2 years to 40; a pregnant woman was among the patients. Illness followed consumption of shawarma from the Vanjar Patti Naka stall; patients developed vomiting, severe diarrhoea, and high fever. The cluster was confirmed on Wednesday, and victims were admitted to Indira Gandhi Memorial Sub-District Hospital in Bhiwandi, where doctors are giving emergency treatment and monitoring to prevent dehydration. The outbreak appears linked to the same vendor, with local authorities investigating the stall. A recovering patient described rapid onset after eating the food, and several others reported similar symptoms. Medical teams continue care for all 43 victims as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディの屋台シャワルマを食べた後43人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一の屋台が原因と見られる食中毒クラスターであり、病原体不明の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 食中毒（疑い）事案であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性の感染症ではないため対象国リストへの計上は不要と判断。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Gavi plans 1.5 million doses of experimental Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Experimental Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; as of 25 November 2026, the Bundibugyo outbreak has killed more than 5,700 people. Gavi plans to buy up to 1.5 million doses if trials show safety and efficacy. The vaccine, developed by Britain's University of Oxford and the Serum Institute of India, is in trials in DRC. There are no licensed vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola. Gavi has allocated $40 million to support development. Gavi CEO Dr. Sania Nishtar urged health agencies to increase funding and rapidly outline rollout protocols if efficacy is demonstrated. She emphasized regulators must clear steps and follow-up procedures before deployment; she also called on WHO to expedite regulatory alignment.

triage.headline_ja: Gaviが実験的エボラワクチン150万回分の購入を計画
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行により5,700人以上が死亡しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な支援の必要性が認められるため。
triage.notes: インドと英国は発生地域ではなく、ワクチン開発機関（オックスフォード大学、インド血清研究所）の所在地であるため verified_locations から除外した。実際の流行はDRCのみで確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Смертоносная лихорадка могла попасть в Израиль - минздрав
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly fever could have reached Israel — Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: Israel is investigating a suspected case of Ebola virus disease after a resident who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed symptoms. The patient has been placed in isolation at Tel Aviv's Ichilov Medical Center, where doctors are conducting examinations and providing care while awaiting laboratory confirmation. The Health Ministry said the case remains a suspicion and that additional tests are needed to confirm or rule out infection. Symptoms emerged after travel abroad, and authorities note there are no confirmed Ebola cases in Israel at this time; final conclusions depend on lab results. Ebola is a rare but highly dangerous viral hemorrhagic illness that can cause severe bleeding, organ failure, and death. The infection is travel-related, indicating an imported potential case.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性の熱病がイスラエルに持ち込まれた可能性 ― 保健省
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者がエボラ疑い症例としてイスラエルで隔離されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はイスラエルでの輸入疑い症例であり、対象国リストにイスラエルは含まれない。コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は渡航元として言及されているが、現地での具体的な流行状況は記事中に明記されていないため verified_locations には含めない。確定診断結果待ちの状況であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة رم : إيبولا: أكثر من 11 ألف إصابة مؤكدة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ram Agency: Ebola: More than 11,000 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of Nov 17, 2026, 11,613 confirmed infections and 5,678 deaths, with 3,148 recoveries. The outbreak spans 68 health zones across eight provinces, with ongoing transmission in 48 zones. Ituri Province reports 7,946 cases and 3,751 deaths; North Kivu 2,996 cases and 1,654 deaths. Deaths outside health facilities remain high—452 of 720 deaths occurred in communities in the three weeks to Nov 17, signaling late detection and limited access to care. Contributing factors include deteriorating security, limited access, displacement, weak health systems, and contact-tracing challenges. On Nov 18, WHO kept the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Spillovers observed in Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France; no new cases in Kenya or Nigeria in the latest update. Urging continued border monitoring, early detection, testing, and contact tracing; outbreak risk remains high within DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ラム通信：エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例が11,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続中の大規模アウトブレイクで、複数国へのスピルオーバーも確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスへのスピルオーバーが報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOは2026年11月18日時点でPHEIC指定を継続。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Free Meal Poisoning Sends 58 Cirebon Students to Hospital
article.articleSummary: In Cirebon Regency, West Java, 58 high school students from Dukupuntang 1 State Senior High School sought emergency care after consuming meals distributed under the government Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program on Monday. By Tuesday evening, Sumber Hurip Hospital reported 58 patients in its emergency department, with 13 admitted for further observation. Most complaints involve digestive symptoms, notably diarrhea and vomiting. Hospital officials said a laboratory confirmation is needed before concluding it is food poisoning. Preliminary investigations indicate the affected individuals consumed MBG meals, and the incident also affected several teachers and a parent. Authorities will coordinate with the health department and the National Nutrition Agency to evaluate the kitchen supplying the meals and determine the cause. The MBG program, launched in early 2025 under President Prabowo Subianto, has faced recurring food-safety scrutiny.

triage.headline_ja: 無償給食による食中毒疑い、チルボンの学生58人が病院搬送
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の疑いであり感染症イベントではなく、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクも認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来の非感染性疾患）の疑いであり、感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。原因は給食プログラムの調理過程にある可能性が高く、感染症の国際的拡大リスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Fogo cruzado e mau tempo travam ajuda a equipes de saúde na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Crossfire and bad weather hinder aid to health teams in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province: 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths. WHO staff and aid workers are blocked by crossfire and torrential rains, sheltering inside a maternity hospital as response is hindered; UN urges treating health facilities as neutral safe zones. The outbreak persists amid conflict between government forces and armed groups. Funding shortfalls compound challenges to the response and protection efforts. A UNICEF-led study with Solidarité Féminine and the University of Washington finds nearly 60% of women and girls in Ituri report the onset or worsening of violence since the virus arrived; in households under quarantine, about two-thirds experience physical, psychological or sexual abuse. Stigma and misinformation worsen vulnerability, while eight safe spaces run by Solidarité Féminine saw tripled demand July-September. Authorities stress community dialogue and women's safety as top priorities from day one.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：銃撃戦と悪天候がコンゴ民主共和国の保健チームへの支援を阻害
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（11,613症例、5,678死亡）が紛争地域で継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、人道支援の障害、国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo ebolavirus、Ituri州）。紛争・資金不足・ジェンダーに基づく暴力の悪化など複合的危機が報告されている。既にWHO/国連が介入中であり、継続モニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trapped Ebola health workers rescued after three days of fighting in Congo
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, Ebola health workers were rescued after being trapped at Akwe hospital for more than three days amid clashes between the Congolese army and the CRP led by Thomas Lubanga. Staff sheltered in a maternity ward for over 24 hours before evacuation; at least 10 people were killed and refugees fled toward Bunia. The outbreak, among the largest on record, continues to suffer from insecurity hindering surveillance, contact tracing, and quarantine. The Bundibugyo outbreak has caused nearly 12,000 cases and nearly 6,000 deaths. The CRP is one of many armed groups; attacks by the Islamic State–linked ADF have also disrupted relief efforts. Gavi plans to buy up to 1.5 million doses of an experimental Bundibugyo strain vaccine being trialed in DRC, developed by Oxford and Serum Institute. No approved treatments exist; case finding and isolation remain essential, but only about 11% of cases are on contact lists, far below 95% target.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの戦闘から3日後、閉じ込められていたエボラ対応医療従事者が救出される
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で進行中の大規模エボラ流行（約12,000症例、約6,000死亡）が武力紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武力紛争（CRP、ADF等の武装勢力）が接触者追跡・隔離等の対応を著しく阻害しており、接触者リスト登録率は目標95%に対し約11%にとどまる。Gaviによるワクチン調達計画あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola burial teams struggle to keep pace with deaths in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, Ebola burial teams in eastern Congo's Oicha and surrounding villages bury three to six people daily, struggling to keep pace with deaths. With only two vehicles available, logistical bottlenecks hamper rapid safe burials and ongoing outbreak response. Widespread community mistrust fuels tension, with residents accusing burial teams of spreading the virus rather than containing it. The article highlights operational strain and the impact on outbreak control, as limited transport and skepticism impede outreach, contact tracing, and safe handling of bodies. The report centers on burial operations rather than clinical details, and provides no further information on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ埋葬チームが死者数増加に対応しきれず苦闘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な死亡事例とアウトブレイク対応の機能不全（埋葬・接触追跡の遅延、コミュニティの不信）が確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は臨床詳細・検査確定情報を欠くが、致死事例の継続、物流逼迫、コミュニティの不信によるアウトブレイク対応の阻害が明確であり、既存エボラ流行の深刻化を示唆する。続報でのケース数・検査確定状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zhejiang Pest Control Program Linked to Lower Mosquito, Fly, and Rodent
article.articleSummary: Zhejiang Province, China, rural communities in the Four Pests-Free Villages program showed reduced densities of mosquitoes, flies, and rodents versus matched controls in a 2024 field evaluation across 11 cities (22 intervention, 22 control). In 44 villages, adult female mosquitoes were captured with light traps (4,530 total, 2,926 females); Culex pipiens pallens dominated (89.49%). Intervention areas averaged 3.29 mosquitoes per trap-night vs 5.36 in controls (delta −0.282, 95% CI −0.404 to −0.149; p<0.001). City-stratified analyses found significant reductions in Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Lishui, and Shaoxing; seven cities showed no significant difference. Larval dynamics were assessed with the Breteau Index across 16,147 households and 9,345 water receptacles. Cockroach populations showed no provincial-level difference. Vector-borne diseases such as dengue, chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis, and rodent-borne plague and hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome underscore Zhejiang's push for environmental remediation and community mobilization with limited chemical use, highlighting outdoor pest suppression and containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 浙江省の害虫駆除プログラム、蚊・ハエ・げっ歯類の個体数減少と関連
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は害虫駆除プログラムの効果に関する研究報告であり、実際の疾病発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は媒介動物・げっ歯類駆除プログラムの疫学的評価研究であり、デング熱やペストなどの疾患名は背景説明として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 7 ngày ECMO cứu chàng trai sốt xuất huyết biến chứng tim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven days on ECMO save a young man with dengue fever and heart complications.
article.articleSummary: A 24-year-old man developed dengue fever that progressed to cardiogenic shock with acute myocarditis. On day 3 of fever, he had persistent vomiting, hypotension, tachycardia, and poor cardiac contraction, prompting transfer from Vung Tau General Hospital to Gia Dinh People’s Hospital in Ho Chi Minh City. With rising troponin and deteriorating function, clinicians initiated VA-ECMO around 15–16:00, with dengue confirmation by 20:00. Seven days on ECMO, the heart briefly collapsed then gradually recovered; ECMO flow was 3 L/min, and anticoagulation was avoided due to thrombocytopenia and coagulopathy. Liver and kidney function stabilized, allowing ECMO withdrawal and near-complete recovery. Timely ECMO before cardiac arrest contributed to the outcome. Dengue can cause severe complications in young, healthy people, typically days 3–7. Prevention includes vector control and vaccination for those aged 4+, two doses 3 months apart, with >80% efficacy and reduced hospitalization; vaccination after recovery is advised about 6 months.

triage.headline_ja: ECMO7日間で心合併症を伴うデング熱の若者を救命
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例の臨床治療報告であり、デング熱自体はベトナムで流行している既知の疾患。異常なアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の新たな脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は単一患者の重症化・救命治療に関する医療ニュースであり、集団発生や異常な流行動向を示すものではない。デング熱はベトナムで季節的に発生する既知の風土病。

article.articleHeadline: Mandaue logs 1,289 dengue cases, 9 deaths in 2026
article.articleSummary: Mandaue City, Cebu Province, Philippines, reports 1,289 dengue cases across 27 barangays as of November 23, 2026, with 9 deaths (0.6% CFR) and one death under investigation. The Level 1 infirmary (25 beds) is congested with dengue patients. This year's tally exceeds 2025's 520 cases and 3 deaths. To curb transmission, the City Health Office emphasizes daily mosquito breeding-site control and 4S practices—search and destroy, 4 o'clock discard of water-holding containers and snack wrappers, and misting when cases spike or rains return—plus weekly monitoring. Residents should seek care on fever day one at dengue fast lanes in health centers, satellite OPDs, the main OPD, or the hospital. Warning signs include vomiting, bleeding, poor appetite, and abdominal pain. OPD hours are 8 a.m.-5 p.m. weekdays; hospital fast lanes operate evenings, weekends, and 24/7, with BHERTS and OpCen. Education Department involvement includes student monitoring, cleanups, and insecticide-treated nets.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市、2026年のデング熱症例1,289件・死亡9人を記録
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ州マンダウエ市での季節性デング熱流行報告。症例数は前年比で増加し死亡例・病院混雑もあるが、異常性や国際拡大リスクは低く、地域の通常対応の範囲内と見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年発生する季節性デング熱の地域報告。前年(520例・3死亡)から今年(1,289例・9死亡)へ増加しており、病院の収容能力逼迫が報告されているが、地方自治体レベルで対応中であり国際的な懸念材料は確認されない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Смртоносни вирус стигао до Европе: Паника се шири, за овај сој нема лијека
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus has reached Europe: Panic is spreading; there is no cure for this strain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak has reached Europe as the epidemic accelerates in Africa. CIDRAP reports 10,000 cases in 163 days, 51 days faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Africa: Uganda 20 confirmed, 2 deaths; Kenya 9 cases, 2 deaths; Nigeria 1 case. Europe links involve evacuees/returnees from DR Congo: Germany 2; Netherlands 1; France 1 (doctor returning from DR Congo); Switzerland 1 (after two Nigerians evacuated, contact quarantined); United Kingdom 1 (British doctor evacuated from DR Congo on Nov 5, recovered). Late detection cited by CDC (mid-to-late February onset; WHO declared mid-May). Three main drivers: Bundibugyo lacks approved vaccines, rapid population movement, and distrust leading to attacks on health workers (≈260 in six months). Calls for strengthening local clinics, PPE, and door-to-door work in Ituri and North Kivu; border closures deemed ineffective. Vaccine trials for Bundibugyo (including Oxford) could yield breakthroughs by early 2027; Ervebo (Zaire strain) under review for cross-compatibility.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスが欧州に到達：パニックが拡大、この株には治療法がない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、コンゴ民主共和国発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が欧州への渡航者を介して拡散、WHO・CDCも注視しており社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ、北キブ）を起点とするエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の流行を主題とし、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア、および欧州各国（独・蘭・仏・英・スイス）への帰国者・退避者を介した波及に言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 市农业中心扎实开展人畜共患病防控宣传月活动_部门动态_天津政务网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tianjin Municipal Agricultural Center rigorously conducts a month-long public awareness campaign on the prevention and control of zoonotic diseases.
article.articleSummary: Tianjin Municipal Agricultural Center conducted a month-long zoonotic disease prevention and control awareness campaign (September–October) across all city districts, focusing on cattle and sheep farming areas to reduce risks of anthrax, brucellosis, bovine tuberculosis, and rabies. The campaign targeted farming, slaughter, and market workers, using lectures, field outreach, house-to-house education, and distribution of educational materials, posters, and on-site visits to farms and rural markets. By emphasizing disease features, transmission, screening, and personal protection, it aimed to close the 'last mile' of knowledge transfer and align with World Rabies Day for community education. It adopts problem-, risk-, and outcome-oriented approaches to strengthen source control and practical protection measures. The Municipal Center plans to consolidate the campaign framework, scale best practices, and reinforce the zoonotic disease prevention network to safeguard livestock and public health.

triage.headline_ja: 天津市農業センターが人畜共通感染症の予防・対策に関する啓発月間活動を着実に実施
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生ではなく、人畜共通感染症の予防啓発キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines Bans Pork Imports from Finland and Estonia to Combat African Swine Fever
article.articleSummary: Philippines bans pork imports from Finland and Estonia to curb African swine fever (ASF) and protect local and wild pigs. In circulars dated 9 November, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. imposed a temporary ban on pork and swine products, with quarantine officers intercepting shipments at ports. Restrictions cover domestic and wild pigs, pork meat, pig skin, semen and by-products; Estonia’s sanitary import clearances are automatically revoked and new permits suspended. Duration unspecified. ASF remains active in 236 barangays across 23 provinces, with 716 cities/municipalities (64.68% of affected areas) reclassified as buffer or surveillance zones. The swine herd remains below the 2019 pre-ASF level of about 13 million. From 2024 to midyear, 499,008 ASF vaccine doses were given on 54 farms in seven provinces (99.8% uptake). DA expanded a community biosecurity program to 258 backyard farmers in 14 barangays and paid indemnities totaling ₱49.824 million across eight regions.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、アフリカ豚熱対策でフィンランドとエストニアからの豚肉輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上の脅威ではなく貿易措置に関する継続的な報道に過ぎないため。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトへの感染症ではなく、動物衛生・貿易に関する事案。フィンランド・エストニアは禁輸対象国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれず、また記事の主題はフィリピン国内の既存流行状況であるためPhilippinesのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Development and internal evaluation of a random forest-based prediction model for mortality among congolese children with severe malaria
article.articleSummary: 100 Congolese children with severe malaria were analyzed, with 17 deaths observed. The study developed and internally validated an interpretable Random Forest mortality predictor using six routinely available variables: pH, strong ion gap, potassium, creatinine, respiratory rate, and glucose. A SMOTE-based model showed strong discrimination (ROC-AUC 0.989; 95% CI 0.986–0.991) and balanced accuracy 0.920, with 98.1% sensitivity and 85.9% specificity across 200 stratified Monte Carlo cross-validation repetitions. A class-weighted variant yielded ROC-AUC 0.958, higher specificity (96.5%) but lower sensitivity (74.7%). Model interpretability was assessed via permutation importance and SHAP; a bootstrap validation supported discrimination though calibration was unstable. External validation is required before clinical deployment. The work highlights potential for rapid mortality risk stratification in children with severe malaria using routinely collected data.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ人重症マラリア患児の死亡率予測のためのランダムフォレストモデルの開発と内部評価
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は重症マラリア患者の死亡率予測モデルに関する学術研究であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Urinary Urobilinogen and Organ Impairment Predict Mortality in Severe SFTSV
article.articleSummary: Urinary urobilinogen positivity, elevated serum creatinine, and advanced age independently predict in-hospital mortality among critically ill patients with severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV) infection. A retrospective multicenter study across five tertiary centers in China (April 1, 2021–October 31, 2024) analyzed 798 lab-confirmed SFTSV cases: 527 non-critical and 271 critical, with 137 in-hospital deaths in the ICU (50.6%). The cohort’s median age was 67 years, and 87.3% lived in rural areas. Critical illness correlated with pronounced hematological, coagulation, and multiorgan dysfunction, and higher rates of urinalysis abnormalities (proteinuria, hematuria, glycosuria). In multivariable analysis among the critically ill, older age, elevated serum creatinine, and positive urinary urobilinogen independently associated with fatal outcomes; overall, age, direct bilirubin, ALT, CK, D-dimer, and organ dysfunction predicted critical illness. The authors highlight routine urinalysis plus standard biochemistry as a practical prognostic tool, while noting retrospective design limits and need for prospective validation.

article.articleHeadline: ЮНИСЕФ: семьи в ДР Конго испытывают серьезное давление из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF: Families in the Democratic Republic of the Congo under severe pressure due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF reports that families in the Democratic Republic of Congo are under severe pressure from the Ebola outbreak, with women and girls bearing the heaviest burden. Seven of ten households have faced isolation, quarantine, or contact tracing. Despite progress since May in halting spread, challenges remain, including rising violence and fear that restricts women’s movement, increasing their vulnerability. Since June, UNICEF and partners have provided support to more than 3,300 people subjected to gender-based violence in Ituri and North Kivu. The eastern Ituri province reported 246 suspected Ebola cases and 65 deaths by May 15. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no approved treatments or vaccines for this outbreak. The article underscores the need to center women and children in response and to address the financing gap (76%).

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により家族に深刻な負担
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中で、死亡例・治療薬未承認・人道危機（ジェンダーに基づく暴力増加）など深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が複数確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はUNICEFによる人道面の報告であり、感染者数・死亡者数データ（246例疑い・65死亡、5月15日時点）は既存流行の継続状況を示す。治療薬・ワクチン未承認の点から公衆衛生リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Απομακρύνθηκε υγειονομικό προσωπικό από νοσοκομείο εν μέσω μαχών και επιδημίας Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Medical staff evacuated from a hospital amid fighting and an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Evacuation of health workers, WHO staff, and Democratic Republic of Congo Ministry of Health officials from a hospital in Ituri province amid intensified fighting accompanies the ongoing Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. In Ituri, the Ebola outbreak has recorded 11,762 cases and 5,775 deaths. The eastern and northeastern DRC conflict since late October is hindering containment efforts. There is no approved vaccine or treatment specifically for Bundibugyo; two candidate vaccines are set for trials in Ituri. One, developed by the Serum Institute of India and Oxford Vaccine Group, has a pre-purchase agreement with Gavi for up to 1.5 million doses, contingent on trial success and regulatory approvals. The WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the evacuation, stressing protection of health services and responders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:戦闘とエボラ流行の中、病院から医療スタッフが退避

article.articleHeadline: 流感进入流行季，三种毒株流行意味着什么？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As influenza enters flu season, what does the circulation of three strains mean?
article.articleSummary: Influenza is in China's peak season, with national surveillance showing among positive samples: H1N1 56.2%, H3N2 15.5%, and B/Victoria lineage 28.3%. The co-circulation of three strains in a season is possible; there is no cross-protection between subtypes, so infection with one does not guard against others. Symptoms for influenza A and B are similar (fever, headache, sore throat, cough, myalgia, fatigue) and standard treatments apply. Public health authorities monitor essential medicines and antiviral stocks. In Chongqing’s Longzhouwan Street Community Health Service Center, respiratory illness visits rose about 28% and prescriptions about 30% from Oct 31 to Nov 15, with adequate supplies of fever reducers, cough meds, antivirals, and testing reagents. Children aged 5–14 show higher infection rates. Beijing Children’s Hospital emphasizes early identification and reducing crowding in schools and daycare to prevent clusters. Published 2026-11-25.

article.articleHeadline: Córdoba confirmó dos casos de dengue y serían los primeros positivos que registra en la temporada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Córdoba confirmed two dengue cases and they would be the first positive cases recorded this season.
article.articleSummary: Córdoba, Argentina confirms two dengue cases—the first of the 2026-2027 season—in a 48-year-old man and a 29-year-old woman who had recently traveled to the Dominican Republic and Mexico, respectively. Laboratory Central de Córdoba verified the infections; both patients are recovering. Authorities activated vector-control measures around the patients’ areas to curb local transmission, emphasizing elimination of standing water and potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites in homes, yards, and outdoor spaces. Recommendations include removing water-collecting containers, maintaining clean patios, daily care of animal water dispensers, and frequent cleaning of plant pots and gutters; use of repellents and, for infants, nets and protective clothing. Nationwide, 11 imported dengue cases have been reported in the 2026-2027 season, including four in Buenos Aires (travel to Brazil, Ecuador, Mexico, Dominican Republic), three in the City of Buenos Aires (Peru, Brazil), plus cases in Santa Fe (Peru) and Santa Cruz (Costa Rica).

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : East Records 9 Cholera Cases
article.articleSummary: Cholera in Zambia's Eastern Province totals nine reported cases in Chipata and Kasenengwa as of 24 November 2026, with four laboratory-confirmed. Three cases are in Chipata and six in Kasenengwa. All infections are linked to attendance at the funeral of an 80-year-old relative who died on 18 November and was buried on 21 November in the Kazimule area. The outbreak cluster is currently observed in Chipata and Kasenengwa districts. Authorities, through the Eastern Province Public Health Office, have intensified outbreak response activities and are urging residents of Chipata and Kasenengwa to adhere to preventive measures to halt transmission. The briefing, delivered by Chipata District Commissioner Elidah Mwanza on behalf of Eastern Province Permanent Secretary Paul Thole, disclosed the nine-case tally.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：東部州でコレラ9例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ザンビア東部州の葬儀関連クラスターで9例（4例検査確定）が報告されているが、死亡例や重症度情報がなく、現時点では小規模なローカルアウトブレイクのため続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Giành sự sống cho cụ bà 79 tuổi hôn mê sau khi mắc cúm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saving the life of a 79-year-old grandmother in a coma after contracting influenza.
article.articleSummary: 79-year-old woman from Hai Phong developed influenza, fell into coma with severe electrolyte disturbances, pneumonia, and secondary bacterial infection. She was treated at Hai Duong Tropical Disease Hospital after a 27 Oct–5 Nov course at a nearby facility with no improvement. On admission she was comatose with marked electrolyte imbalance, urinary retention, pneumonia, and multi-organ involvement; her age and frailty posed high risks. Rapid resuscitation, infection control, electrolyte correction, urinary drainage, and nutrition support were started. After 5 days of intensive care, consciousness improved and vital signs stabilized, though fatigue persisted and arrhythmia appeared. Cardiac biomarkers were elevated; echocardiography showed heart failure, prompting adjusted heart-failure–focused therapy and close monitoring. She eventually regained urination, infection resolved, electrolytes normalized, and nutrition improved. Influenza can cause pneumonia, bacterial superinfection, respiratory failure, and worsen cardiovascular disease; vaccination is advised for the elderly and those with comorbidities.

article.articleHeadline: Are Mumbai's shawarmas safe? Rising food poisoning cases spark concern
article.articleSummary: Shawarma-linked food poisoning outbreaks have raised safety concerns in Mumbai and Thane's Bhiwandi. A 19-year-old died in 2024 after shawarma; in April 2024, 12 people were hospitalised after consuming chicken shawarma from a roadside stall in Santosh Nagar, Goregaon East; in June 2024, more than 120 were ill after dining at Famous Shawarma in Bhiwandi's Khandu Pada, with 124 admitted to IGM Hospital. The latest outbreak in Bhiwandi near Vanjarpatti Naka sickened at least 43, including 10 children and a pregnant woman; the stall was demolished. Bacteria such as Salmonella, E. coli and Campylobacter are potential hazards from inadequately handled poultry. Maharashtra FDA under Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe has conducted inspections, sealed outlets, and tested samples; no shawarma ban has been announced. Investigations focus on cooking temperature, refrigeration, and cross-contamination.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのシャワルマは安全か？食中毒の増加が懸念を呼ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の食中毒菌（サルモネラ・大腸菌・カンピロバクター）による単発の食品衛生事案であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、地元当局（FDA）が通常の衛生対応（施設閉鎖・検査）で管理できている。
triage.notes: 食品媒介性の食中毒（シャワルマ屋台由来）であり、感染症の国際伝播リスクは認められない。地域の食品安全規制強化が主な対応となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ƙawancen Gavi na shirin sayen allurar gwaji ta rigakafin cutar Ebola
article.articleSummary: Gavi announced plans to procure up to 1.5 million doses of a new Ebola vaccine candidate, pending proof of efficacy and impact, to strengthen preparedness for rapidly spreading Ebola outbreaks. The vaccines are currently in trials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, developed by the University of Oxford (UK) and an Indian disease-research institute. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, which has caused more than 5,700 deaths in the Congo, placing communities in peril. Gavi has already provided $40 million to accelerate vaccine development; terms of the agreement were not disclosed. Chair Sania Nishtar described the pledge as an initial step, urging additional funding and the establishment of rapid deployment rules if efficacy is confirmed. She emphasized meeting WHO requirements before distribution under an emergency-use framework to protect lives.

article.articleHeadline: Паразит превращает мышей в приманку для клопов: раскрыт хитрый механизм заражения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A parasite turns mice into bait for bed bugs: an ingenious mechanism of infection revealed.
article.articleSummary: Trypanosoma rangeli-infected mice become more attractive to kissing bugs (Rhodnius prolixus) than healthy mice. In a 16-hour choice assay, 154 nymphs clustered near infected mice versus 86 near healthy. When bugs could contact mice, healthy rodents repelled 22.89% of approaching nymphs, while infected mice repelled 14.67%, indicating increased host attractiveness coupled with weakened defenses. Among bugs that fed on infected mice, 46.5% acquired the parasite, expanding transmission opportunities. While T. rangeli is not typically pathogenic to mammals, it can impair Triatominae reproduction, with infected bugs often dying before adulthood or showing reduced fecundity. By contrast, T. cruzi-infected mice did not become more attractive; a possible, small bias toward healthy hosts emerged with unclear significance. Researchers from Fiocruz (Brazil) and INBIOTEC-CONICET (Argentina) analyzed volatile emissions via GC-MS, suggesting odor changes drive attraction; results are currently limited to laboratory conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫がマウスをサシガメの『おとり』に変える:感染メカニズムの巧妙な仕組みが解明
triage.triage_reason: 実験室レベルの基礎研究（トリパノソーマ感染マウスとサシガメの行動学的研究）であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上の緊急性や実際の感染拡大事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 研究はブラジル(Fiocruz)とアルゼンチン(INBIOTEC-CONICET)の研究機関によるものだが、実際の疾病発生事例ではなく基礎科学研究のため、対象国リストにアルゼンチンは含まれず、ブラジルも実際の感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре оценили заболеваемость корью в РФ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor assessed measles incidence in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Russia are isolated and not linked, according to Anna Vatolina, deputy head of the epidemiological surveillance department at Rospotrebnadzor, speaking at a meeting of epidemiologists from Russia and the CIS. Public health officials warn of growing vaccine hesitancy, with outbreaks suppressed by rapid measures in foci and in Novosibirsk Oblast. Since 2023, Russia has conducted catch-up measles immunization nationwide, vaccinating about 4.4 million people, contributing to a 3.4-fold drop in incidence in 2025 versus 2024. The experts caution that importation of infections remains a risk. In 2026, measles activity is highest in Southeast Asia, the Asia-Pacific region, and Africa, with potential import from other Russian regions and neighboring countries. Measles is highly contagious, primarily a pediatric disease but also affecting adults, transmitted by airborne droplets; complications include otitis, meningitis, and encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、国内の麻疹発生状況を評価

article.articleHeadline: "Precisamos da colaboração da população para retirar das residências objetos que possam acumular água e se transformar em criadouros do mosquito"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We need the public's cooperation to remove from homes objects that can accumulate water and become mosquito breeding grounds.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared over by the state Health Department after 12 weeks with no new cases linked to identified transmission chains; the last confirmed case presented symptoms on August 28, 2026. Four monitoring devices continue 24/7 surveillance; initial readings were expected on November 20–21, but determining the outbreak’s cause requires additional data. The update appears within a broader municipal bulletin that also covers governance, infrastructure, and fiscal matters, with no further infectious-disease developments reported. As of November 25, 2026, there are no active measles transmission chains identified in the region, signaling containment of the outbreak described in the piece.

article.articleHeadline: Horror health warning as three deadly strains of same virus spread round nation
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains—H1N1, H3N2, and the Victoria lineage—are circulating nationwide in China, with northern regions showing a sharp rise in flu positivity and southern areas fluctuating, according to the China Influenza Surveillance Weekly Report and the Chinese CDC. Officials warn there is little cross-protection between subtypes and urge universal vaccination, especially for the elderly, children, and those with chronic diseases. Xin Lin of the Institute of Viral Diseases stresses that vaccination is advised even after prior flu infection to reduce reinfection risk and complications. Li Tongzeng, chief physician at Beijing You'an Hospital, notes the growing risk of sequential infections: contracting influenza A does not rule out influenza B, and A(H3N2) offers limited protection against A(H1N1). Common symptoms include fever, headache, sore throat, cough, muscle aches, and fatigue. Current vaccines protect against both influenza A and B strains.

triage.headline_ja: 恐怖の健康警告：同一ウイルスの3つの致死的な株が国内で拡大
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ複数株（H1N1、H3N2、Victoria系統）の同時流行は通常の季節的現象であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、再感染リスクや重症化の懸念から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行報道であり、タブロイド紙（Daily Star）による煽情的な見出しが付けられているが、内容は中国CDCの定期サーベイランス報告に基づく通常の注意喚起。パンデミックや新型株の出現を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-大火重创巴西基孔肯雅热研究
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet - A massive fire devastates Chikungunya fever research in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, a fire at the Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE) in Recife, Brazil, destroyed a laboratory central to Chikungunya fever long-term effects research. The second-floor facility housed about 85,000 samples—blood, urine, and plasma—from roughly 900 Chikungunya patients at different disease stages, stored between a CO2 incubator and a microscope. The loss jeopardizes understanding why many infected individuals develop chronic joint and neuropathic pain. Globally, last year saw over 500,000 Chikungunya cases, with about half of patients potentially enduring chronic pain. About 200 students lost substantial research results; Brazil's Education Ministry arranged student relocation and coordinated roughly USD 28 million for disaster recovery with the science ministry. Fire department and police investigations are ongoing; the campus had two prior small fires recently. REPLICK plans to expand research sites despite the setback.

triage.headline_ja: 科学網-大火がブラジルのチクングニア熱研究に大打撃
triage.triage_reason: 研究施設の火災による研究試料の喪失に関する事象であり、公衆衛生上の感染拡大や症例増加を示すものではないため、感染症シグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事象はチクングニア熱の発生そのものではなく、研究施設火災による研究資料喪失に関する報道であるため、感染症発生地としてのBrazilはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 53 in hospital after consuming shawarma in Thane: Officials
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning linked to shawarma caused 53 hospitalisations in Bhiwandi-Nizampur City, Thane district, Maharashtra, after residents consumed shawarma at a Vanzarpatti Naka eatery on Monday night. On Tuesday, 11 were hospitalised; the total rose to 53 with patients currently stable per Medical Officer of Health Dr Sandeep Gadekar. A case has been registered against the eatery owner under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and FDA regulations at Nizampura police station, with the accused absconding. FDA Assistant Commissioner Santosh Shisodia urged designated street-food zones for monitoring. He noted drinking water in the town appeared yellow, and laboratory tests are required to confirm whether the illnesses are due to food poisoning or another factor, with laboratory confirmation pending.

triage.headline_ja: ターネーでシャワルマ摂取後、53人が入院：当局発表

triage.notes: 飲料水が黄色く見えたとの指摘があり、食中毒か水質汚染かラボ確認待ちの状態。原因が水系感染症であれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 永州疾控：流感流行季致家长的一封信_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yongzhou Center for Disease Control and Prevention: A Letter to Parents During the Influenza Season
article.articleSummary: Yongzhou City has entered the winter–spring influenza high season. WHO estimates globally influenza causes 3–5 million severe cases and 290,000–650,000 respiratory deaths annually. Children are high-risk; infection can lead to pneumonia and myocardial injury, impacting health and learning, with schools facilitating transmission. Annual influenza vaccination is the most cost-effective prevention; vaccines are nationally approved with safety assurances, though antigenic drift and waning immunity warrant yearly vaccination. Policies protect key groups: in rural areas, residents aged 65+ and rural primary/secondary students receive one free dose of trivalent influenza vaccine; urban residents can use personal medical insurance accounts to pay vaccination costs for themselves and relatives. Chinese guidelines (2026–2027) note vaccination reduces school absenteeism, illness, and hospitalization risk. Parents should follow local vaccination unit and school notices and vaccinate. Yongzhou CDC, 2026-11-25; rural 'one old, one small' vaccination clinics listed.

article.articleHeadline: मुंबईतील 'शोरमा' खरोखरच सुरक्षित आहे का? भिवंडीतील वाढत्या विषबाधेच्या घटनांनंतर धक्कादायक वास्तव समोर!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Mumbai's 'Shorma' really safe? A shocking reality comes to light after the rising poisoning cases in Bhiwandi!
article.articleSummary: Shawarma-related food poisoning outbreaks in Mumbai have raised urgent food-safety concerns. In Bhiwandi, a street cart near Wanjarpatti Naka sickened at least 43 people after eating chicken shawarma, including 10 children and a pregnant woman; vomiting, diarrhea and fever required hospital care, and authorities seized the vendor. In June, Kandhu Pada’s Famous Shawarma triggered illness in more than 120 customers; the shop was sealed and samples sent to a lab by the FDA. In April 2024, Santosh Nagar, Goregaon East saw 12 admissions after shawarma consumption, and a week later a Trombay incident involved a 19-year-old who died; two vendors were arrested. This year, Kandhu Pada cases at IGM Hospital reached 124. Risk factors include inadequate cooking temperatures on vertical skewers, cross-contamination, and mishandling. Pathogens cited: Salmonella, E. coli, Campylobacter. The Maharashtra FDA, led by Commissioner Mundhe, conducts inspections and suspends licenses; no sale ban yet.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの『シャワルマ』は本当に安全か？ビワンディでの食中毒増加後に衝撃的な実態が明らかに！
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食品衛生問題（食中毒）であり国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、繰り返し発生しており自治体の対応状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 食品衛生(食中毒)案件であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性感染症のアウトブレイクではない。地元FDAが対応中で、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: FKM Unand Edukasi Siswa SMAN 6 Padang tentang Pencegahan HIV dan Penyakit Menular Seksual - Harian Singgalang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Andalas University's Faculty of Public Health educates SMAN 6 Padang students about HIV prevention and sexually transmitted infections - Harian Singgalang.
article.articleSummary: Padang, Indonesia — Hundreds of students from SMAN 6 Padang participated in education on adolescent reproductive health, HIV prevention, and sexually transmitted infections. The program, conducted by Andalas University’s Faculty of Public Health (FKM Unand) on July 15, 2025, used a peer-educator-based Communication, Information, and Education (KIE) approach to strengthen teen health literacy. Led by Dr. Vivi Triana, SKM, MPH, from the Master of Epidemiology program at FKM Unand, the session clarified differences between HIV and AIDS and explained sexually transmitted infections such as syphilis, gonorrhea, chlamydia, genital herpes, and HPV. It covered that HIV is transmitted via specific body fluids, not through everyday social contact. The educators emphasized removing stigma and discrimination against people living with HIV/AIDS. Message: Know, Prevent, Care. Protect Yourself, Respect Others.

triage.headline_ja: アンダラス大学公衆衛生学部、パダン第6国立高校生徒にHIVおよび性感染症予防について教育

article.articleHeadline: 鼓山、左營再爆5登革熱！高雄已6區淪陷 疾管署喊可控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gushan and Zuoying report five more dengue fever cases; six districts in Kaohsiung have fallen; the CDC says it's under control.
article.articleSummary: Five more locally acquired dengue cases were reported in Kaohsiung on November 25, increasing the city’s local cluster to seven. Patients include three men and two women in their 50s; four are part of a Gushan District cluster (two in Yu Xing Li, one in Meishu Guan Li, one in Zuoying District’s Fushan Li) with onset November 20–23, all infected with Dengue Virus Type 1. The fifth case resides in Qianzhen District’s Ru Gang Li, onset November 18, Dengue Virus Type 2; infection source under investigation. Nationwide this year totals 267 dengue cases, with 27 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 22) and 240 imported; origins include Vietnam, the Philippines, and Indonesia. Health authorities deem the outbreak controllable, conducting breeding-site inspections, spraying, expanded testing, and mobilizing prevention teams. Six Kaohsiung districts are affected: Xiaogang, Gushan, Gangshan, Lingya, Zuoying, Qianzhen. Symptoms include fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, rash; NS1 rapid testing advised.

article.articleHeadline: Black Death Tak Berakhir dalam Sekejap, Ini yang Terjadi Setelahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Black Death Won't End in an Instant: Here's What Happens Next
article.articleSummary: Second Plague Pandemic continues after the Black Death, with a new PNAS study from the University of Tartu detailing repeated plague resurgence across Western Eurasia through the 14th–18th centuries. Using refined phylochronology that fuses radiocarbon dating, genetic timelines, historical records, and 26 Yersinia pestis genomes from 11 archaeological sites in Estonia, Russia, England, the Netherlands, and Switzerland, researchers dated 75 genomes with improved accuracy. The work links multiple plague waves to city- or region-specific outbreaks and identifies substantial diversification of Y. pestis lineages around 1450–1500, suggesting new rodent reservoirs in urban and rural settings. A proposed connection to the Great Renaissance Drought is discussed, potentially driving rodent die-offs or migrations toward humans and accelerating transmission. The findings show repeated introduction of plague into Estonia starting in the late 14th century, highlighting the enduring historical and global health relevance of the disease.

triage.headline_ja: 黒死病は一瞬では終わらなかった、その後に起きたこと
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は14〜18世紀の歴史的なペスト大流行に関する学術研究（PNAS論文）の紹介であり、現代における公衆衛生上の実際の発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は中世〜近世ヨーロッパにおけるペスト（黒死病）の歴史的研究に関する内容であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。発生地域リストにタイ（Bangkok/Kingdom of Thailand）が含まれるが、記事本文・サマリーには一切言及がなくBluedotの誤割当とみられるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ขบ.จับมือ 'สาธารณสุข' ลุยคัดกรองวัณโรคเชิงรุกกลุ่มผู้ขับรถสาธารณะ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities join forces with Public Health to proactively screen for tuberculosis among public transport drivers.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Land Transport, in partnership with the Department of Disease Control and health networks, launched proactive tuberculosis (TB) screening for public transport drivers and the general public using AI-assisted digital chest X-ray. The program aims to screen over 1.7 million drivers, provide health checks and influenza vaccination, and enable early TB detection ahead of the New Year travel season in Bangkok and nationwide. It forms part of the four-accelerator TB plan: 1) AI-enabled chest radiography screening, 2) rapid molecular diagnostics, 3) prompt treatment with ongoing follow-up, 4) public education and cross-sector cooperation to reduce stigma and broaden participation. WHO Global TB Report 2026 estimates Thailand has about 101,000 new TB cases annually (142 per 100,000). Mobile screening units offer sputum testing when indicated and medical fitness-to-drive assessments. Symptomatic individuals (cough ≥2 weeks, blood in sputum, weight loss, fever, night sweats) or TB contacts should seek screening at local facilities, especially in Bangkok.

triage.headline_ja: 陸運局、公衆衛生省と連携し公共交通運転手を対象に結核の積極的スクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの一環としての予防的スクリーニング施策であり、異常な流行や急性の公衆衛生リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: タイ国内の既存結核流行（年間約10万例）への対策強化施策であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。政府主導の定例的公衆衛生プログラムとして報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo (RDC) : la peur d'Ebola enferme les victimes de violences dans le silence
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): Ebola fear traps victims of violence in silence.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak worsens violence against women and girls, with fear of infection deterring care. UNICEF-SOFEPADI data from Ituri (Bunia) and five health zones, plus real-time surveillance of 1,062 women/adolescents, show about 60% report violence and abuse began or intensified since the outbreak. In households under isolation or contact tracing (roughly 70%), two-thirds report increased violence; nine in ten link abuse to epidemic-related stress and fear. Between January–March and July–September, safe spaces recorded 1,183 and 3,548 visits, respectively (a threefold rise). The report emphasizes that protection against Ebola does not guarantee protection against violence, urging stronger community protection, open safe spaces, confidential reporting, and accessible care and psychosocial support. Context includes insecurity in Ituri, with violence near hospitals disrupting Ebola response; the outbreak has caused about 5,800 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）：エボラへの恐怖が暴力被害者を沈黙に追い込む
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（死者約5,800人）に関連し、公衆衛生上重大な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事本体はエボラ流行下での女性・少女への暴力増加に焦点を当てた社会的影響報告だが、背景にあるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク自体（約5,800人死亡）が重大な公衆衛生事象であるためPICKUPと判断。治安悪化が対応を妨げている点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Salmonella Persists Across Broiler Slaughter Stages Despite Significant
article.articleSummary: Salmonella persists across the entire processing chain in a high-capacity commercial broiler slaughterhouse in Paraná, Brazil, despite reductions from interventions. A 20-week longitudinal study (Aug 2020–Mar 2021) tracked 15 randomly selected carcasses per week (n=2,100 analyses) through seven processing points: pre-scalding, post-scalding, post-defeathering, post-evisceration before CP1B, post-evisceration after CP1B, post-final washing, and post-chilling. Overall Salmonella detection reached 45.3% of samples; pre-scalding 78.66% highest, then 42.66% post-scalding, 43.01% post-defeathering, 49.33% post-evisceration before CP1B, 38.01% post-evisceration after CP1B, 28.99% post-final washing, and 36.66% post-chilling. Final average concentration after chilling was 0.33 log MPN/g (down from 1.30 log MPN/g initially). Initial reductions occurred after scalding; immersion chilling coincided with a rise in contamination, suggesting cross-contamination via shared water. The facility operates under official federal inspection and is authorized for international export.

triage.headline_ja: 大幅な処理工程での低減にもかかわらず、ブロイラー屠畜の全段階でサルモネラ菌が残存

article.articleHeadline: Kenya nears Ebola-free status as vaccine deal targets Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: Kenya nears an Ebola-free status, aiming for declaration on Dec 23 after discharging the last patient on Nov 12, 2026, and entering day 14 of a 42-day surveillance countdown; WHO reported nine confirmed Kenyan cases and two deaths, with seven survivors recovered and no new infections since Oct 19. The Democratic Republic of Congo continues a severe outbreak with over 11,600 confirmed cases and about 5,700 deaths, sustaining WHO's PHEIC. Gavi and Serum Institute signed an advance purchase agreement for up to 1.5 million doses of ChAdOx1 BDBV for Bundibugyo, contingent on positive trials, regulatory approvals, and WHO policy recommendations; no vaccine is licensed for Bundibugyo. Serum Institute has produced drug substance for >500,000 doses. Kenya also seeks 10,000 Ervebo doses via WHO/Africa CDC, though Ervebo's protection against Bundibugyo remains unproven and should be used only in approved protocols.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱終息間近、ブンディブギョ株を対象としたワクチン契約締結へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,600例超・死亡5,700人規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しWHOのPHEICが維持されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアのエボラ終息間近の状況だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは依然深刻な進行中アウトブレイクでPHEIC継続中のため主要対象として記録。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン（ChAdOx1 BDBV）開発・供給契約が進行中である点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue death toll rises to four in Puducherry
article.articleSummary: Dengue deaths in Puducherry, a Union Territory, rise to four in 2026, the highest in nine years. On 24 November, a 29-year-old nurse and a 16-year-old girl died from dengue at government facilities; two additional dengue fatalities occurred last week (a 19-year-old girl and a 23-year-old boy). By 19 November, total dengue cases reached 1,362, with Puducherry region accounting for 1,232. Authorities intensified anti-dengue measures to curb water stagnation, citing fluctuating monsoon rainfall and climate change as contributors, and expanded surveillance, fever clinics, and testing. On 25 November, intermittent rains caused minor inundations in several areas as outbreaks persist.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーでデング熱の死者数が4人に増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は地域の風土病であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、過去9年で最多の死者数・症例数となっており、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はベクター媒介性感染症でありヒト-ヒト感染はしないため、WPRO基準の流行しやすさは蚊媒介の観点から評価。地域内での季節的流行であり、国の対応能力の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱群聚增至7例！小北百貨員工染疫　534人已採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung dengue fever cluster rises to 7 cases! Xiao Bei Department Store employees infected; 534 people have been tested.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City, Taiwan reports a dengue fever cluster rising to seven cases. From Nov 23–25, five new locally acquired cases (three men, two women; ages 50s)—four linked to the Gushan District cluster—occurred with onset dates 11/20–11/23. The five include two cohabitants in Yuxing Li, plus cases in Meishuqu Li and Zuoying District’s Fushan Li; four are dengue virus type 1, while one in Qianzhen District’s Ruagang Li (onset 11/18) is type 2 under investigation. The Xiao Bei Department Store, Qingfeng Branch, has mosquito breeding sites detected; residents or shoppers since 11/01 urged to test at the CosMed testing station on Qingfeng Street. Overall, 534 people have been tested; one additional positive was identified (case 17). Health authorities conducted vector control and expanded testing; 29 mobile teams (58 personnel) checked 435 households, finding 7 positive households and 7 positive containers, with 6 inspection notices. Taiwan totals: 267 dengue cases (local 27; Kaohsiung 22 local; imported 240; Vietnam 73, Philippines 38, Indonesia 32).

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱再增5例！鼓山群聚擴及左營 累計7例觀察至12／26
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Dengue Fever Adds 5 More Cases! Gushan District Cluster Expands to Zuoying District; Total 7 Cases Under Observation Through December 26.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung, Taiwan, reports five new locally acquired dengue cases (Nov 23–25), expanding the Gushan District cluster to Zuoying District and placing seven cases under observation through December 26. All patients are in their 50s (three men, two women) with onset between Nov 20–23; residences include Gushan’s Yuxing Li and Meishuguan Li and Zuoying’s Fushan Li. The year has seen domestic clusters in Xiaogang, Gangshan, Qianzhen, and Lingya’s Minsheng Hospital. Public health actions include environmental inspections and spraying, expanded testing, 29 mobile teams (58 staff), 435 households checked, seven positive households and seven positive containers, and six enforcement notices. Nationally in 2026: 267 dengue cases, 27 locally (Kaohsiung 22), 240 imported (Vietnam 73, Philippines 38, Indonesia 32).

article.articleHeadline: 高雄再新增5例本土登革熱　鼓山群聚擴及左營
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung adds five more locally transmitted dengue fever cases; the Gushan cluster expands to Zuoying.
article.articleSummary: Five more locally transmitted dengue cases were reported in Kaohsiung from November 23–25, 2026, extending the Gushan cluster to Zuoying; four cases are linked to the Gushan cluster with onset 11/20–11/23 (two in Gushan's Yu Xing Li, one in Gushan's Meishuguan Li, one in Zuoying's Fu Shan Li), all dengue virus type 1, bringing the cluster total to seven. One additional case in Qianzhen District's Ru Gang Li (onset 11/18) is dengue virus type 2, with infection source under investigation. Nationwide, Taiwan has 267 dengue cases this year, including 27 locally acquired; Kaohsiung accounts for 22 local cases across six districts (Xiaogang, Gushan, Gangshan, Lingya, Zuoying, Qianzhen). The remaining 240 are imported, mainly from Vietnam, the Philippines, and Indonesia. Public health measures include vector control, expanded testing, and community emergency response; clinicians should assess TOCC and use NS1 rapid testing for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で本土感染のデング熱患者が新たに5例、鼓山クラスターが左営まで拡大

article.articleHeadline: 瑞普生物(300119.SZ)：获得非洲猪瘟重组腺病毒载体活疫苗临床试验批件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ruipu Biotech (300119.SZ): Obtained clinical trial approval for an African swine fever recombinant adenovirus vector live vaccine
article.articleSummary: Ruipu Biotech (300119.SZ) announced on November 25, 2026 that the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs issued a clinical trial approval for an African swine fever (ASF) recombinant adenovirus vector live vaccine. ASF is caused by African swine fever virus (ASFV) and is an acute, virulent, highly contagious disease; the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) lists it as a notifiable disease, and China designates it as a Class I animal disease. Outbreaks entail high mortality and threaten China’s swine industry; no vaccine has been approved for commercialization in China yet. The recombinant adenovirus vector live vaccine represents a novel preventive candidate. Ruipu Biotech has pursued this product since 2023 in collaboration with Huazhong Agricultural University and other institutions. The trial approval marks a key step in addressing ASF in China.

triage.headline_ja: 瑞普生物(300119.SZ)：アフリカ豚熱組換えアデノウイルスベクター生ワクチンの臨床試験承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発企業の臨床試験承認に関する企業発表であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はASFワクチンの臨床試験承認という企業ニュースであり、実際のASF発生事例の報告ではないため、発生地域としての中国は該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Random Forest Shows Potential Predicting Severe Malaria Mortality in
article.articleSummary: Severe malaria mortality in 100 Congolese children (Democratic Republic of the Congo) was analyzed; 17 deaths occurred. A random forest model using six routine predictors—blood pH, strong ion gap, potassium, creatinine, respiratory rate, and glucose—predicted mortality in pediatric severe malaria. Feature selection used Boruta, correlation filtering, and recursive elimination from 42 candidates. Model development used SMOTE, stratified Monte Carlo cross-validation, and hyperparameter tuning; interpretability was assessed via permutation importance and SHAP. Across 200 cross-validation iterations, the SMOTE RF achieved AUC 0.989 (95% CI 0.986-0.991), balanced accuracy 0.920, sensitivity 98.1%, specificity 85.9%. A class-weighted RF yielded AUC 0.958, sensitivity 74.7%, specificity 96.5%. Bootstrap validation supported discrimination, but calibration estimates were unstable. External validation in independent cohorts is needed before clinical deployment of this six-variable, interpretable model for mortality risk stratification in pediatric severe malaria in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ランダムフォレストがコンゴ人小児の重症マラリア死亡率予測に有望性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究・予測モデルに関する学術的内容であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: देहरादून के 95 झरनों में बैक्टीरिया, बारिश के बाद ई-कोलाई 11 गुना बढ़ा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria in Dehradun's 95 waterfalls; E. coli increases 11-fold after rainfall.
article.articleSummary: Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India: A study of 22 samples from 11 natural waterfall sources found widespread fecal contamination. 95% contained total coliform bacteria and 68% contained E. coli. Post-monsoon E. coli levels increased about 11-fold (4.4 to 50.6 MPN/100 ml), while total coliforms rose from roughly 200 to 1,860 MPN/100 ml. Conducted by GB Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment in 2025, the pre- and post-monsoon water from springs showed nearly all springs affected. Despite an overall good water quality index, bacterial presence raises safety concerns for drinking water. E. coli can cause diarrhea, vomiting, and severe infections. Rainfall may transport human and animal waste into recharge zones; exact source not confirmed. In Chakrata, about 27% of drinking-water schemes rely on springs; deforestation and urban growth may pressure recharge areas, though causality is unproven. Boil or chlorinate water before use; absence of E. coli and total coliform is essential.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラドゥーンの95か所の泉で細菌検出、降雨後に大腸菌が11倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症例報告はなく水質調査結果に留まるが、飲用水源の糞便汚染が確認されており継続的な曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は水質調査（研究機関によるモニタリング）の結果であり、実際のヒト感染例やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。飲用水源（泉水）への糞便性汚染が雨季後に増加している点が継続的な公衆衛生リスクとして注視される。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄新增5例本土登革熱！鼓山區4例同群聚　累計7例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports 5 new locally transmitted dengue fever cases; 4 in Gushan District linked to the same cluster, bringing the total to 7 cases.
article.articleSummary: Five new locally transmitted dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung, Taiwan: three men and two women in their 50s. Four cases are linked to a Gushan District cluster, with residents in Yuxing Li, Meishuguan Li, and Zuoying District's Fushan Li, all infected with dengue virus type 1; the cluster totals seven cases. Another case in Qianzhen District's RuGang Li, onset November 18, was dengue virus type 2; source under investigation. Health authorities are conducting vector inspections and spraying at homes and workplaces, and expanding testing. Since November, 29 teams (58 personnel) inspected 435 households, finding seven positive households and seven positive containers, and issuing six notices. Nationally, 267 dengue cases this year: Kaohsiung 22 locally; Changhua 2; Pingtung 2; New Taipei 1; 240 imported, mainly from Vietnam, Philippines, and Indonesia. Prevention: drain, cover, clean, spray; use approved repellents; seek care with travel/occupation/contact/cluster history; NS1 testing may aid diagnosis.

triage.notes: 台湾（Kaohsiung）における季節性デング熱の国内感染クラスター事例。フィリピン・ベトナム・インドネシアは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、これらの国での発生イベントではないため verified_locations には含めない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため、本イベントは対象国いずれにも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱再增5例！鼓山群聚擴及左營 累計7例觀察至12／26
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung dengue fever adds 5 more cases! Gushan cluster expands to Zuoying District; total of 7 cases under observation as of 12/26.
article.articleSummary: Five new locally acquired dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, from Nov 23–25, 2026. Four cases link to the Gushan District cluster, which has spread to Zuoying District, raising the cluster total to seven; one case in Qianzhen District is dengue virus type 2, with the infection source under investigation. All patients are in their 50s (three men, two women); onset dates range Nov 20–23. Residences include Gushan Yu Xing Li (two), Meishuguan Li, and Zuoying FuShan Li. The Gushan cluster observation is extended to Dec 26. Kaohsiung has six districts with domestic clusters this year: Xiaogang (4), Gushan/Zuoying (7), Gangshan (3), Qianzhen (2), and Lingya’s Minsheng Hospital cluster (6). Nationally, 267 dengue cases this year, with 27 locally (Kaohsiung 22) and 240 imported (Vietnam 73, Philippines 38, Indonesia 32). Public health actions include vector control, expanded testing; 29 mobile teams inspected 435 households, finding 7 positive households and 7 positive containers, and issuing 6 enforcement notices. Residents should use DEET, picaridin, or IR3535 repellents, drain standing water, wear protective clothing, and seek care for fever with travel history.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF transfère la gestion de son centre de traitement de Mongbwalu au ministère de la Santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF transfers management of its treatment center in Mongbwalu to the Ministry of Health
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC: MSF transfers management of the Mongbwalu Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) in Ituri province to the Ministry of Health, effective 30 November 2026. The transition, announced 25 November, maintains a 20-bed capacity (10 for suspected cases and 10 for confirmed Ebola) during the handover. The move does not signal the end of the outbreak; confirmed cases and deaths continue in Ituri, and MSF warns that the true scale of transmission may be undercounted in areas with weak surveillance, testing, and care access. The objective is to strengthen national and local health authorities' capacity to manage patients, while enabling MSF to reallocate resources to other zones with ongoing medical and operational needs. MSF will maintain a presence and continue supporting the Ebola response in collaboration with local authorities and partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 in DRC: MSFがマングバルの治療センターの管理を保健省に移管
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で確認症例・死亡が継続しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
