article.articleHeadline: Ebola fight runs up against customs, rites in remote DR Congo
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s North Kivu, centered on Bulambo-Isale, has raged for six months, spreading across the region with more than 11,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths since May. The Bundibugyo strain, with transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids, has no vaccine or specific treatment. Burial protocols requiring sealed bags and family-led interment clash with local Nande customs that insist the deceased be laid to rest by kin and return to ancestral soil, fueling distrust of authorities and perceptions of profiteering. Health workers face daily hostility and violence; armed groups and language/cultural barriers complicate outreach. Community leaders lament top-down approaches and call for culturally aware, bottom-up engagement to explain the response. The outbreak’s persistence is tied to suspicion, missed communication, and the need for local-language, respectful burial and disease-control practices.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の奥地で、エボラ対策が慣習や儀式と衝突
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が6か月間続き1万人超の症例・5千人超の死亡を記録しており、ワクチン・特効薬がなく、文化的障壁により対応が難航していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチンや特効薬がない株での大規模流行であり、埋葬慣習との対立が感染拡大の持続要因となっている。致死率が高く(約45%)、地域的拡大や国際的懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Lamongan Catat 86 Kasus DBD Berat hingga November 2026, Warga Diminta Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lamongan Records 86 Severe Dengue Cases Through November 2026, Residents Urged to Be Vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Lamongan, East Java, Indonesia reports 86 severe dengue cases, 110 dengue fever cases with mild symptoms, and 12 suspected dengue cases through November 2026 (Dinas Kesehatan Lamongan). One dengue case with Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS) was recorded the day before. A transition to the rainy season raises concern for Aedes aegypti breeding; a prolonged dry season this year contributed to a drop from nearly 400 cases in 2025. Health officials note the vector can reach adulthood in about a week, underscoring rapid risk as rains resume. Preventive measures emphasized include eliminating mosquito breeding sites (3M Plus) by draining standing water, closing water containers, burying used items, and using repellents during the rainy season. Education materials have been distributed to puskesmas and Dasawisma volunteers to reinforce community action.

triage.headline_ja: ラモンガン、2026年11月までに重症デング熱86例を記録、住民に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なデング熱流行だが前年より件数減少しており、通常の季節性拡大リスクの範囲内。ただし雨季入りによる媒介蚊増加の懸念があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地域の風土病的デング熱流行で、2025年より症例数は減少。雨季入りによる蚊の繁殖増加が懸念されているが、現時点で国際的拡大や異常事態とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ nhập viện do cúm A gia tăng ở Phú Thọ, phụ huynh cần cảnh giác
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children hospitalized due to rising influenza A cases in Phu Tho Province; parents should be vigilant.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, influenza A cases among children are rising at Cam Khe Regional Health Center in Phu Tho Province, Vietnam, with increasing pediatric admissions. The virus spreads mainly via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces, and poses greatest risk to children under 5. Common symptoms include fever, chills, fatigue, headache, body aches, cough, sore throat, and runny nose, with some cases featuring nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or diarrhea. Parents should seek early medical evaluation for suspected flu and not self-diagnose. Warning signs needing urgent care include persistent high fever, seizures, rapid or labored breathing, chest pain, blue lips or extremities, lethargy, poor feeding, or dehydration. If untreated, influenza A can cause bronchitis, pneumonia, otitis media, or encephalitis, and worsen existing conditions. Public health measures emphasize annual seasonal flu vaccination, handwashing with soap, masks in crowded places, covering coughs, good ventilation, and staying home when sick.

triage.headline_ja: フート省でA型インフルエンザによる子どもの入院が増加、保護者に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行であり、特異な病原性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事にとどまる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの地域的な増加を報じる一般的な保健啓発記事であり、異常性や重症化の顕著な増加は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: تقنية وولباتشيا لمكافحة حمى الضنك والشيكونغونيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wolbachia technology to combat dengue fever and chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes were released in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, as part of a four-year study to curb transmission of dengue fever and chikungunya. The natural Wolbachia bacterium, introduced into mosquitoes, weakens replication of arboviruses and prevents them from reaching saliva, reducing human infection risk without eradicating the vector. In over 5,700 children studied, areas with Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes saw a roughly 69% drop in dengue and chikungunya cases compared with control areas maintaining standard mosquito-control measures. Results remained favorable during a Brazil-wide dengue surge in 2024. The approach spreads Wolbachia through mosquito populations via female transmission, enabling gradual establishment without ongoing releases. Experts see potential for India and other endemic regions but stress local evaluation, as success depends on ecological and entomological factors. Conventional measures—eliminating standing water, repellents, protective clothing—remain essential, along with vigilance for fever and other dengue-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とチクングニア熱対策のためのウォルバキア技術
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ブラジルで実施されたウォルバキア技術によるデング熱・チクングニア熱抑制の研究成果に関する科学記事であり、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ベロオリゾンテで実施された4年間の研究結果を紹介するもの。インドは将来的な適用可能性として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Covid: sobe para 21 o número de estados com alta de casos da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: the number of states with rising cases of the disease has risen to 21.
article.articleSummary: As of November 16, 2026, Brazil reports rising COVID-19 activity in 21 states (up from 17), with 135,378 COVID-19–related respiratory illness cases. Rio de Janeiro remains the only state with a high-alert level for severe illness, although this reflects circulation of influenza A and B and metapneumovirus. Severe COVID-19 cases stay at low risk nationally, but signals of growth appear in the Distrito Federal and multiple states across all regions. New entrants to the list include Amazonas, Maranhão, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio Grande do Norte, Sergipe, and Tocantins; Alagoas and Roraima exited. In the private sector, SARS-CoV-2 positives have risen for 11 weeks. Vaccination remains the main protection, with over 22.9 million doses distributed in 2026; a shipment of 1.41 million doses to ten states, including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Minas Gerais, was announced.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19:感染増加州が21州に増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでCOVID-19やインフルエンザ等複数の呼吸器疾患活動が季節的に増加しているが、重症度は全国的に低リスクとされ、国際的な拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は示されていない。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器疾患（COVID-19、インフルエンザA/B、メタニューモウイルス）の国内サーベイランス報告であり、重症度・国際的懸念は低い。ワクチン接種体制は維持されている。

article.articleHeadline: Les combats perturbent la riposte contre Ebola dans l'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting disrupts the Ebola response in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Fighting in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, disrupts the Ebola response as clashes between the army and CRP rebels led by Thomas Lubanga cause mass displacement to Bunia and threaten health teams. Rebels briefly controlled Iga-Barrière, 25 km from Bunia, before retreating on 24 November. The civilian exodus toward Bunia and restricted access undermine Ebola surveillance, case management, and treatment access; WHO warns of blocked staff at Akwe, with evacuations from Mongbwalu to Bunia via MONUSCO. No casualty toll is reported. Civil society fears a broader spread of Ebola as populations flee. The CRP has stated it will halt its advance toward Bunia; authorities remain silent. Deo Bungamusi calls for urgent action to secure Djugu and protect health workers. The CRP emerged in March 2025 from Kampala.

triage.headline_ja: 戦闘によりイトゥリ州でのエボラ対応が妨げられる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州での武力衝突がエボラ出血熱対応を妨害し、住民の大量避難とサーベイランス・治療アクセスの阻害が報告されているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（カンパラ）はCRP反乱軍の発祥地として言及されているが、エボラ発生・対応妨害はイトゥリ州（DRC）が主題であるため、Ugandaは対象国verified_locationsに含めない。死傷者数など具体的被害規模は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Myriam Rios é internada após diagnóstico de Influenza A | Celebridades | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Myriam Rios is hospitalized after being diagnosed with Influenza A | Celebrities | O Dia
article.articleSummary: 67-year-old Brazilian actress Myriam Rios was hospitalized in São Paulo after diagnosis with Influenza A. Doctors kept her under observation due to slightly low oxygen saturation amid an influenza outbreak. On Nov 24, 2026, she posted a video updating fans, noting she canceled a live event as sore throat, fatigue, and a worsening cough developed over about a week. She said her condition is under control and that she is recovering in hospital at the moment. Her eldest son recently had respiratory symptoms and was diagnosed with viral sinusitis after two weeks of coughing. Rios also shared plans for her monologue Rainha Ester, with a Brazil-wide tour expected once she recovers.

triage.headline_ja: ミリアン・リオス、インフルエンザA型と診断され入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の季節性インフルエンザ罹患に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 著名人の個人的な健康状態に関する芸能記事であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての意義は低い。ブラジルで季節性インフルエンザが流行している可能性を示唆する記述はあるが、具体的な公衆衛生データはない。

article.articleHeadline: Người chăn nuôi khó khăn trước áp lực giá giảm và nỗi lo dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Farmers struggle under the pressure of falling prices and the fear of disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Live pig prices in Hà Tĩnh, Vietnam, stand at 46,000–50,000 VND/kg in late November 2026, squeezing profitability for farms and businesses as feed and disease-control costs stay high. Large producers, such as Mitraco, with about 6,500 breeding sows and an annual output of roughly 150,000 pigs and piglets, report losses near 15,000 VND/kg and are tightening biosecurity while aligning production and sale timing. Prices had dropped to 44,000–46,000 VND/kg from late September to mid‑November, prompting cautious restocking and careful consideration of sale timing to stabilize year‑end supply. Drivers include an earlier-year surge in restocking, competition from cheaper imported pork, and reports of banned substances in some farms affecting consumer confidence. ASF outbreaks persist in 45 hamlets across 19 communes, with over 600 pigs infected, dead, or culled; authorities bolster border controls with Laos and urge farmers to source clean stock, vaccinate, disinfect, and report signs promptly. Plan prudently for Tet.

triage.headline_ja: 価格下落の圧力と疫病への懸念に苦しむ畜産農家
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省でASFが45集落・19コミューンに拡大し600頭以上が感染・死亡・殺処分されているが、人への健康影響はなく経済的側面が主題のため、動物衛生面の継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病でありヒトへの感染症ではないため公衆衛生リスクは低いが、畜産業への経済的影響と越境リスク（ラオスとの国境管理強化）が記載されている。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Egg prices crash up to 20% in India as Tamil Nadu bird flu outbreak disrupts exports; poultry farmers hit
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu confirms an outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 in Cuddalore district, with about 100,000 chickens dead or culled since late October; infection confirmed November 13 from a Kattiyankuppam farm (NIHSAD). A central team leads containment as NCDC monitors suspected human infections. Measures include 1-km culling radius, carcass burial, sanitisation, movement restrictions, and a three-month ban on poultry farming/restocking in affected areas. Namakkal, the hub accounting for >90% of India’s egg exports, saw prices rise to ₹6.70 on Nov 11 but fall to ₹5.60 after confirmation, a ~19% drop. Nationwide prices are down 10–20% in 8–10 days due to export disruption. Maize costs have risen ~50% and soybean meal ~30%, squeezing margins as chicken costs exceed sale prices (₹120/kg vs ₹80/kg). AIPBA urges government relief; no human cases yet; surveillance intensified in poultry hubs.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州の鳥インフルエンザ流行で輸出が混乱し、インドの卵価格が最大20%下落
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で高病原性H5N1が家禽に拡大し、約10万羽が死亡・殺処分され、輸出規制・移動制限など経済・流通への影響が大きく、NCDCが疑い人感染例を監視中であるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒト感染例は報告されていないが、NCDCが疑い例を監視しており、家禽業界への経済的影響（卵価格20%下落、飼料コスト上昇）が顕著。続報でヒト感染の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Tömeges járvány tört ki egy magyar iskolában: rendkívüli tanítási szünetet rendeltek el, hatvan diák betegedett meg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass outbreak occurred at a Hungarian school: an extraordinary school break was ordered, sixty students fell ill.
article.articleSummary: Two concurrent outbreaks marked Hungary’s Week 46. In Somogy County, an elementary school outbreak began November 11, with 66 of 212 exposed ill (60 students, 6 staff) with vomiting and diarrhea; no hospitalizations. A Fejér County elderly home outbreak began November 6, with 35 of 140 exposed (33 residents, 2 staff) infected; fever, vomiting, and diarrhea were common, and one resident was hospitalized. Investigations noted a possible foodborne origin in the elderly home; visitor restrictions and enhanced hygiene were imposed, and the school closed for an extraordinary break with intensified disinfection. Separately, a lab-confirmed measles case was reported in Budapest: a 38-year-old Indian national who travelled in India and had no vaccination history. Five new mpox cases were identified—four in Budapest and one in Csongrád-Csanád County, all men 23–36, none vaccinated; total mpox this year is 26, prompting accelerated vaccine procurement. Campylobacter 139, Salmonella 81, Rotavirus 34, Hepatitis A 31 of 40, Scarlet fever 57, Varicella 57 (down from 82); Pertussis none.

triage.headline_ja: ハンガリーの学校で集団感染が発生：臨時休校措置、60人の生徒が発症
triage.triage_reason: 学校および高齢者施設での同時多発的な胃腸炎様集団感染により臨時休校・訪問制限が発動され、社会的・行政的関心が高いため。ただしIHR基準の国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはハンガリー国内（Somogy県の小学校、Fejér県の高齢者施設）で発生した感染性胃腸炎（食品由来疑い）の集団感染が主題であり、ハンガリーは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。記事内でインド（India）への言及は、ブダペストで確認された麻疹症例の患者がインド渡航歴を持つという文脈であり、インド国内での発生事例ではないため除外した。また同記事にはMpox（サル痘）の増加や複数の腸管感染症（カンピロバクター、サルモネラ等）の季節的発生状況も含まれるが、いずれも国内管理下にあり国際的拡大の兆候は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Escola de Divinópolis suspende aulas após 15 casos confirmados de sarna humana - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis School Suspends Classes After 15 Confirmed Cases of Human Scabies - Portal MPA
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, Brazil, with 15 confirmed cases and 46 suspected among students at Escola Municipal Sidney José de Oliveira in the Candidés neighborhood. Classes were suspended on 25 November 2026 to interrupt transmission and intensify cleaning; AABB Divinópolis activities were also halted. An intersectoral committee (Health, Education, Social Development, City Attorney, and Communications) will monitor cases, coordinate response, and publish daily updates. On 24 November, 10 children were admitted to UPA Padre Roberto with suspected scabies; other affected schools were not disclosed. Health Secretary Sheila Salvino notes that scabies outbreaks are not isolated to Divinópolis, with cases reported in other municipalities in Minas Gerais and in Mato Grosso do Sul. Parents should monitor for intense nocturnal itching, red skin lesions, and small eruptions; symptomatic children should not attend school and seek care. Makeup classes will be discussed by the Education Secretariat.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスの学校、ヒト疥癬の確定15例を受けて休校 - Portal MPA
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低く局地的な学校内感染事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当せず社会的関心も限定的なため見送り。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重篤な疾患ではなく、地域の保健当局により管理可能なレベルの学校内集団感染。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fight runs up against customs, rites in remote DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola is spreading in eastern DRC's North Kivu, centered in Bulambo-Isale (Vuhovi health district). The six-month outbreak has killed more than 5,000 people among more than 11,000 cases since May. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; bodies must be buried in sealed bags by trained workers, but local customs require family burials and earthward contact with ancestors. Locals accuse outsiders and authorities of imposing responses, fueled by mistrust, corruption fears, and perceptions of profiteering; some believe doctors are poisoning people. Attacks on health staff occur; incidents include a nurse's son injured and a machete-armed interrupter. Community leaders urge blending respect for customs with disease control, favoring bottom-up engagement over top-down imposition. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, and language/cultural gaps hinder risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策、遠隔地コンゴ民主共和国の慣習・儀式と衝突
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株エボラが北キブ州で6ヶ月にわたり流行し、11000例・死者5000人超という深刻な公衆衛生被害が継続しており、ワクチン・治療法がなく地域の文化的抵抗により制御が困難なため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%（5000/11000）と極めて高く、文化的・社会的要因（埋葬儀式、医療従事者への不信・暴力）が感染制御を阻害している。国際的拡大の明記はないが、国境地帯であるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱再增5例 鼓山群聚累計7人 估疫情可控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever in Kaohsiung rises by 5 cases; Gushan cluster now totals 7; outbreak deemed under control.
article.articleSummary: As of November 25, 2026, Kaohsiung City reports five new locally acquired dengue fever cases, four linked to the Gushan District cluster, now totaling seven. An additional case in Qianzhen District is serotype 2; its infection source is under investigation. Of the four Gushan cases, onset dates are Nov 20–23; residences: Yuxingli (two), Meishuguan Li (one), and Fushan Li, Zuoying District (one). All four are dengue virus serotype 1. The cluster remains within a 400-meter emergency control zone, and officials say the outbreak is controllable. Vector-control includes targeted inspections and spraying; since early November, 29 teams (58 personnel) have checked 435 households, with seven positive households, seven positive containers, and six enforcement actions. Nationally, Taiwan has 267 dengue cases this year, including 27 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 22); imported 240 cases, mainly from Vietnam, the Philippines, and Indonesia. Citizens should continue preventive measures and seek medical care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄登革熱再増5例 鼓山群聚累計7人 疫情は制御可能と推定
triage.triage_reason: 小規模なクラスターで当局が制御可能と明言しており、台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、IHR・WPRO基準も該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（高雄市）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピン・ベトナム・インドネシアは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna em 40 municípios mineiros expõem falhas no diagnóstico e no tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Scabies in 40 Municipalities in Minas Gerais Expose Flaws in Diagnosis and Treatment
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks in Minas Gerais, Brazil, have risen to at least 40 municipalities, up from 11 in October–November 2026, per a November 19, 2026 state bulletin. Cities include Belo Horizonte, Ouro Preto, Poços de Caldas, and Varginha, with some infant schools suspending classes in September–October. The surge reveals diagnostic and containment gaps, as most cases were not diagnosed using standardized criteria, complicating inter-municipal comparisons. The state urges reporting of two or more cases and emphasizes active contact tracing, since reinfestation is prevented by treating all household members simultaneously, even if asymptomatic. Scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei; itching arises from hypersensitivity, with a typical 4–6 week incubation for the first infestation. In the SUS, first-line treatments are 5% permethrin or oral ivermectin, with a second dose after one to two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州40自治体での疥癬症例が診断・治療の不備を露呈
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度が低く国際的拡大リスクも乏しいが、自治体数の急増と診断・管理体制の不備が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重篤な疾患ではないが、10月から11月にかけて症例報告自治体数が11から40へ急増し、診断基準の不統一や感染管理の不備が指摘されている。学校閉鎖も発生しており地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念はあるが、国際的な影響は限定的と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果戰火威脅伊波拉抗疫　醫療人員撤離疫情重災區一所醫院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting in the Democratic Republic of the Congo threatens Ebola response as medical staff evacuate from a hospital in the hardest-hit outbreak area.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-25, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced that medical personnel evacuated from Akwe hospital in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after sheltering for more than three days amid fierce fighting. The Ebola response team, including WHO and the DRC Ministry of Health, has temporarily relocated to another site until security stabilizes. Ituri Province remains the outbreak’s center and is described as among the most severe in years. Cumulatively, Ebola has 11,762 cases and 5,775 deaths. The evacuation highlights safety challenges that are disrupting on-the-ground containment efforts in a conflict zone. The article reports these figures from WHO, with no additional laboratory confirmation details or infection sources provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での戦闘激化がエボラ対応を脅かす――最も深刻な被災地の病院から医療従事者が避難
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で大規模なエボラ流行（累計11,762例、死亡5,775例）が継続しており、武力紛争により対応チームが病院から避難するなど封じ込め活動が阻害されている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長自らが発表している点からも国際的関心が高いことが伺える。紛争により対応活動が妨げられており、感染拡大のリスクが増大している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Завозные случаи денге и малярии в Казахстане: данные 2026 -- Tengri Health
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported cases of dengue and malaria in Kazakhstan: 2026 data -- Tengri Health
article.articleSummary: Since the start of 2026, Kazakhstan has reported 14 imported dengue fever cases and 5 imported malaria cases linked to travel. Dengue cases were mainly in Almaty and Astana, with origins in the Maldives (7), Vietnam (2), India (1), and Dubai (1); Astana residents had holidays in Vietnam and Indonesia, and one case in Kostanay region was tied to Vietnam. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, but climate in Kazakhstan is unlikely to support permanent mosquito establishment, so domestic transmission risk is considered absent. Malaria comprises five imported cases (four in Almaty, one in Astana), four tropical malaria and one three-day malaria, all laboratory-confirmed. Travel histories include Uganda, Ghana, Gabon, Zanzibar (Tanzania), and Vietnam. Health authorities emphasize pre-travel precautions and note no change in domestic outbreak risk.

triage.headline_ja: カザフスタンにおけるデング熱・マラリアの輸入症例：2026年のデータ
triage.triage_reason: カザフスタンへの渡航関連輸入症例の統計報告であり、国内伝播リスクなしと当局が明言している。対象国は渡航先として言及されるのみで、現地での流行拡大を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカザフスタン(対象国リスト外)における輸入症例の年間統計。ベトナム・インドネシア・インド・ガーナ等は患者の渡航歴（感染源の可能性がある国）として言及されているのみで、これらの国自体での流行状況を報じる記事ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC roza ya los 12.000 casos, con más de 5.800 muertos en poco más de seis meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears 12,000 cases, with more than 5,800 deaths in just over six months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared mid-May, nears 12,000 cases with more than 5,800 deaths. The INSP bulletin reports 11,955 infections and 5,867 deaths, including 69 new cases and 35 deaths in the last 24 hours, for a case-fatality rate of 49.1% since the start. There are 1,161 patients hospitalized or in isolation, and 3,307 have recovered. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no vaccine or approved treatment. Contact tracing stands at 77.6%. Eight provinces have been affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, Nord Ubangi, and Ubangi. Ituri accounts for 67.9% of confirmed cases, though transmission has spread in recent weeks. This is the deadliest outbreak in DR Congo’s history, with projections that it could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) of 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、6か月余りで症例数約12,000人、死者5,800人超に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、症例数約12,000人、死者5,800人超という規模でDRC史上最悪の流行となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: जींद ने तोड़ी HIV संक्रमण की चेन, जानें कैसे बदली जिले की तस्वीर - dainiktribuneonline.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jind breaks the chain of HIV transmission; learn how the district's image has changed.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, Jind district in Haryana has secured Safe district status for HIV/AIDS control. Once among Haryana’s most vulnerable districts for HIV, Jind has effectively cut transmission by identifying and treating infected individuals. In a population of over 1.6 million, health officials have identified over 4,338 people living with HIV/AIDS, more than 95% of the district’s estimated infected population. About 1,800 of them receive AIDS pensions. Currently around 3,400 people with AIDS are on antiretroviral therapy, with viral loads suppressed to levels that minimize transmission risk. The district now targets Safe Plus by eliminating Hepatitis B and C infections among pregnant women. A meeting at Jind Civil Hospital, chaired by Deputy Civil Surgeon Dr. Paleram Kataria, highlighted that Jind is among Haryana’s nine Safe districts and aligns with the Haryana AIDS Control Society’s objectives. Ramkumar Sharma attended.

triage.headline_ja: ジンド、HIV感染の連鎖を断ち切る―地域の実態がどう変わったかを知る
triage.triage_reason: HIV/AIDS対策の成功事例を報じるポジティブな内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIV対策の成功事例を伝えるものであり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Suspension of F2F classes at Tabunok Central School extended amid rising dengue cases
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases at Tabunok Central School in Talisay City, Cebu, prompt a one-week extension of face-to-face class suspensions following recommendations from the City Health Office (CHO) and the Department of Education (DepEd). CHO data show 20 dengue cases at the school from October to November, with two students dying. Mayor Gullas says preventive measures have intensified, including misting operations and school-wide and community clean-up drives, targeting Tabunok Central School and other schools in the city. Officials urge barangay leaders and parents to maintain cleanliness and eliminate mosquito-breeding sites to curb transmission. Coordinated actions by the city government, agencies, barangays, and communities are hoped to reduce dengue cases in Talisay City.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例増加に伴い、タブノック・セントラル・スクールの対面授業停止を延長
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・タリサイ市の一校における局地的なデング熱クラスター（20例、死亡2名）で、学校閉鎖延長という対応が取られているが、国全体や国際的な拡大は確認されておらず、IHR基準には該当しない。季節性デング熱の地域事例として続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 死亡者2名が報告されているが、事例数は20例と限定的で、特定の学校という局地的な発生にとどまる。市当局が防蚊対策・清掃活動を強化しており、外部支援の必要性は示されていない。デング熱はフィリピンで季節性に発生する疾患であり、特異性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus-based antibody products cross-neutralize 2026 Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein - Nature Microbiology
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 10,091 confirmed cases and 4,891 deaths as of 25 October 2026. Although vaccines and antibody therapeutics exist for Ebola virus (EBOV), none are approved for Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). EBOV glycoprotein (GP) conservation raises potential cross-protection against the current BDBV-2026; 12 GP differences vs the 2007 BDBV isolate (mucin-domain changes and two in the receptor-binding site) could affect neutralization. In VSV pseudotype assays with diverse EBOV-derived antibodies, BDBV-2026 remains susceptible, though neutralization is lower than Makona GP. Makona GP-hyperimmunized horse plasma neutralized both BDBV-2007 and BDBV-2026; EBOV Makona survivors showed reduced neutralization of BDBV-2026. Mosaic multivalent immunogens and three equine F(ab')2 products neutralized Makona, BDBV-2007, and BDBV-2026, with the 2015 product retaining similar activity after storage. Cross-neutralization suggests EBOV-based countermeasures could offer partial protection against BDBV.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス由来の抗体製剤は2026年ブンディブギョウイルス糖タンパク質と交差中和する - Nature Microbiology
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで進行中のブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイクが確定例10,091例・死亡4,891例（致死率約48%）と極めて深刻であり、既存ワクチン・治療薬が未承認の新規株(BDBV-2026)による国際的拡大事例であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は科学論文（抗体の交差中和性評価）であり、アウトブレイクの詳細な臨床・公衆衛生対応状況は記載されていないため、一部基準は不明と評価。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。致死率・症例数から見て既にWHO通知相当の深刻性を有すると考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: "On se dirige vers l'épidémie d'Ebola la plus importante de l'histoire" : une ONG lyonnaise s'inquiète de la flambée du virus en Afrique centrale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We are heading towards the largest Ebola epidemic in history": a Lyon-based NGO is worried about the virus flare-up in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, starting in Ituri and now affecting eight regions, with 11,000 cases since May 2026 and a 50% case-fatality rate (about 5,500 deaths in six months). Approximately 500 new cases weekly; a new epicenter has emerged in Beni, Nord-Kivu, with additional hard-to-reach pockets. No vaccines are effective against this mutated Ebola strain. WHO is testing two new vaccines, but mass cold-chain logistics are needed to reach electricity-poor areas; Handicap International (Lyon) coordinates last-mile logistics, delivering medicines, isolation tents, and PPE, with daily PPE changes. Convoys may take 2–4 weeks due to difficult terrain and security barriers. Armed groups (ADF, ISIS-affiliated) hinder access; cultural burial practices complicate containment as the virus spreads via contact with corpses. Global Ebola toll: about 21,000 deaths in 50 years; concern for the largest outbreak since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: 「史上最大のエボラ流行に向かっている」：リヨンのNGOが中央アフリカでのウイルス急増を懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000症例・致死率50%の大規模エボラ流行が進行中で、変異株にワクチンが効かず、武装勢力の妨害で対応が困難という深刻かつ異常な状況のため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: リヨン（フランス）はNGOの拠点であり、発生地域ではない。実際の流行地はDRCのイツリ州・北キブ州（ベニが新たな中心地）。変異株に既存ワクチンが無効であること、武装勢力（ADF/ISIS系）による対応妨害、埋葬慣習による感染拡大など、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry urges vigilance against new COVID-19 variant
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, the Ministry of Health on November 24 urged proactive but calm measures against COVID-19 amid a new SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 monitored by the WHO. The WHO’s initial risk assessment (Nov 19) classifies PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring, with its proportion rising in reported sequencing samples in some countries; there is currently no evidence it causes more severe illness or transmits more easily. Global public health risk is low, with low confidence. MOH warns that winter-spring conditions, increased travel, gatherings, and crowded events during year-end and Lunar New Year could heighten respiratory infection risk, especially in enclosed spaces. High-risk groups (older adults, pregnant women, those with underlying conditions or immunosuppression) should take extra precautions and seek medical advice if symptoms arise. Precautions include masking in healthcare settings, on public transport, and in crowded areas; regular handwashing and ventilation. Seek care for fever, cough, sore throat, or shortness of breath.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、新型COVID-19変異株への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下に置く新変異株PJ.2.1について言及されているが、重症化・感染力増強の証拠はなく、世界的リスクも低いとされているため、現時点ではフルRRAの必要性は低いが継続監視の対象とする。
triage.notes: WHOのリスク評価では世界的な公衆衛生リスクは低いとされており、ベトナム保健省は注意喚起レベルの予防的声明を発出している段階。新変異株の特性（重症度・伝播性）についての新知見はなく、季節性呼吸器感染症対策の一環としての発信と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ibaté reforça orientações de prevenção à Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ibaté Reinforces COVID-19 Prevention Guidelines
article.articleSummary: Ibaté reports 10 confirmed COVID-19 cases in November up to the 23rd, after a two-month period with no recorded infections. Prevention measures emphasize well-ventilated environments, frequent hand hygiene with soap and water or 70% alcohol, covering the mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, avoiding close contact with people showing respiratory symptoms, using masks and avoiding crowds when flu symptoms appear, and keeping vaccination up to date. People with fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, or body aches should seek a health unit for evaluation and testing as advised, with special attention to contacts of the elderly, immunocompromised, and those with chronic diseases. Vaccination remains available at municipal health units per the current calendar; doses administered: 1,526 (September), 1,358 (October), and 417 (November, partial). The Health Secretariat continues monitoring cases and cites vaccination and preventive measures as key to reducing transmission and protecting against severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: イバテ市、COVID-19予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 小規模自治体での通常範囲のCOVID-19症例報告（10例）であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の一地方自治体における通常の予防啓発情報であり、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本件は季節性の軽微な感染報告でシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue voltam a crescer em Ibiporã e município reforça ações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases rise again in Ibiporã, and the municipality steps up its efforts.
article.articleSummary: Eight dengue cases were confirmed in Ibiporã between early October and early November 2026, up about 166% from the same period in 2025, with a 12% rise in suspected cases; no severe illness or deaths during this interval in either year. The latest Aedes aegypti rapid infestation index (LIRAa) reached ~4.7%, indicating high risk, based on an October survey of 1,287 properties identifying 60 mosquito breeding sites. About 130 ovitraps are monitored across more than 60 neighborhoods to guide control efforts. Preventive actions include intensified household visits, stronger enforcement by vector-control and community health agents, waste removal, urban cleaning, and cross-secretariat collaboration for education. Health services are being scaled up and staff trained since October. Mayor Jose Maria Ferreira emphasized community and private-sector participation to eliminate water-holding receptacles. Despite a 98% year-to-date decrease in confirmed dengue and a 66% drop in suspected cases, rising vector indices underscore continued vigilance ahead of summer.

triage.headline_ja: イビポラン市でデング熱症例が再び増加、市当局が対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 小規模市の季節性デング熱増加であり、重症例・死亡なし。地方自治体レベルで管理可能であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・パラナ州イビポラン市の地方ニュース。症例数は少数（8例）で重症例なし。年初来では前年比98%減とむしろ改善傾向。媒介蚊指数の上昇への注意喚起が主旨であり、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - November 25, 2026
article.articleSummary: US flu activity continues to rise with more Americans seeking care for flulike symptoms, though severity has not increased. As of November 18, 2026, 34 states report growing COVID-19 infections, 3 declining, and 12 unchanged. In Boise, a late fall surge features high COVID-19, EV-D68, influenza, rising norovirus, and moderate rotavirus activity. In eastern DR Congo, the Ebola outbreak shows three times as many confirmed cases as West Africa’s 2014 epidemic had at the point, with a case-fatality rate around 50%. Satellite imagery indicates graveyards expanding faster than official death counts, suggesting undercount; Uganda and South Sudan intensify efforts to keep Ebola out amid the outbreak. Travel drove Ebola spread in DRC; vaccine trials underway and a plan to buy 1.5 million doses of a Bundibugyo vaccine. Paxlovid use links to 12% lower long‑COVID risk, 30% fewer hospitalizations, and 47% lower all‑cause mortality over six months in high-risk adults.

triage.headline_ja: バルーン・ジュース - 疫病・パンデミック最新情報 - 2026年11月25日
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが2014年西アフリカ流行時の3倍の症例数、致死率約50%、死亡数過小評価の疑い、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダ・南スーダン）があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国のインフルエンザ・COVID-19・ノロウイルス動向やPaxlovidの効果など複数トピックを含む総括記事だが、DRCのエボラ出血熱が最も深刻なシグナルであり、対象国リストに含まれるためDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bhiwandi: Number Of People Hospitalised Due To Shawarma Food Poisoning Rises To 53; Samples Sent For Testing
article.articleSummary: 53 people were hospitalised in Bhiwandi for suspected shawarma-related food poisoning, up from 48, including a two-month pregnant woman among the initial 48. The outbreak is linked to shawarma consumption from AK Shawarma near Vanjarpatti Naka, with 23 families reporting similar symptoms: vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, and fever. Twenty-two men, 16 women, 3 young boys, and 7 young girls were among the initial group. Vomit and stool samples have been collected for chemical analysis and sent to the Microbiology Department at Parvara Medical College to identify the microorganism or infection type; results are awaited. Police have recorded statements, and the shop has been shut down as FDA officials conducted inspections. This incident follows a prior shawarma-related illness 3–4 months ago, which saw about 57 hospitalisations. Lab confirmation is pending.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディ:シャワルマによる食中毒で入院した人数が53人に増加、検体を検査に送付
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設関連の食中毒疑い事案であり、病原体不明・検査結果待ちのため、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、原因究明まで経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の飲食店に由来する食中毒事案であり、感染症というより食品衛生上の問題。病原体同定のための検査結果が待たれている状況。過去にも同様の事案が発生している。

article.articleHeadline: Com a chuva, a chikungunya pede olhar atento a idosos e bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With the rain, Chikungunya requires close attention to the elderly and infants.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul totals 11,076 confirmed cases and 32 deaths in 2026 as of November 13, with dengue reporting 2,327 cases and 1 death in the same period. With the return of rains, Aedes aegypti breeding in standing water raises transmission risk, including in plant dish residues, gutters, and bottle caps. Vulnerable groups—children under two years and newborns—require heightened vigilance for mother-to-child transmission around birth. Common symptoms include sudden fever and joint pain severe enough to hinder daily tasks. Hospitals Proncor and Santa Marina urge seeking care for worsening symptoms; Proncor offers emergency care and scheduled follow-ups for persistent joint pain after the acute phase, while Santa Marina provides pediatric and obstetric emergency services. Access: Central 3003-3230 (6h–19h), online booking at hospitalproncor.com.br, WhatsApp 21 2101-2658, Concierge 67 99830-4241.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の到来でチクングニア熱、高齢者と乳幼児への注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州における季節性（雨季）のチクングニア熱・デング熱流行に関する定例的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 蚊媒介感染症の季節性流行であり、地域医療機関（Proncor, Santa Marina）が対応中。新規性・緊急性は低く、定例的なサーベイランス報告・住民向け注意喚起記事と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 流感进入流行季，三种毒株流行意味着什么？专家提醒→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu season begins: What does it mean that three influenza strains are circulating? Experts remind.
article.articleSummary: China is in influenza season with three circulating strains: A(H1N1) 56.2%, A(H3N2) 15.5%, and B/Victoria lineage 28.3%, per the latest China CDC surveillance. Pediatric clinics, including Guangzhou's Fifth Hospital, report rising influenza visits. Co-circulation of multiple strains can occur within a season, but symptoms are similar across types—fever, cough, sore throat, and body aches—and treatment follows standard guidelines. Early antiviral therapy within 48 hours, especially oseltamivir for children, offers the greatest benefit; fever control with acetaminophen and ibuprofen; avoid unnecessary antibiotics. Severe warning signs in children include high fever for >3 days, tachypnea, oxygen saturation ≤93%, nasal flaring, retractions, altered consciousness, poor intake, and dehydration—seek urgent care. Annual flu vaccination is recommended; practice hand hygiene, mask-wearing in crowded settings, and limit close contact with ill family members. Health authorities continue to monitor antiviral supply and essential medicines.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行期入り：3種の株が流行する意味とは？専門家が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行シーズンに関する注意喚起記事であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A/H1N1、A/H3N2、B/Victoria）の通常の流行シーズンに関する一般的な保健啓発記事。新型・異常株の出現や重症例急増の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 流感季来了，这些防护要点请收好 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The flu season has arrived; please follow these protective measures.
article.articleSummary: Influenza season has begun in China, with flu and other acute respiratory infections entering the peak period. On November 24, the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention held a briefing, underscoring that prior flu infection does not guarantee protection, as multiple virus types/subtypes may co-circulate within the same season. Even if previously infected, vaccination against this season’s influenza is advised, especially for the elderly, young children, and people with chronic illnesses. Do not rely on regular exercise or vitamin C to prevent or treat flu; exercise cannot replace vaccines, and antipyretics/analgesics do not kill the virus. During the acute phase, avoid strenuous activity, which could delay recovery and raise risks of myocarditis, arrhythmia, or rhabdomyolysis. For winter outdoor activity, prepare with dynamic warm-ups and the onion-style layering approach, keeping the head and neck warm to safeguard cardiovascular health, per Zhang Wei of the China CDC Environmental Institute.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行シーズン到来、これらの予防ポイントを押さえよう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する予防啓発情報であり、例年の流行シーズンの範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Mandaue City urges 27 barangays to step up dengue prevention
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Mandaue City, Cebu: 1,289 cases and nine deaths recorded as of November 23, with another death under investigation. On November 24, 27 barangays were urged to intensify prevention, strengthen community surveillance, and improve early detection after a meeting with barangay captains. Efforts focus on eliminating mosquito breeding sites, persistent search-and-destroy campaigns, and the 4 o’clock habit; fogging is temporary and not a substitute for regular household cleanup. Dengue fast lanes operate at city health centers, satellite clinics, and Mandaue City Hospital to expedite assessment of suspected cases. Residents should seek medical consultation on day one of fever; mild cases may be monitored at home, but warning signs—vomiting, bleeding, loss of appetite, abdominal pain—require hospital attention. BHERTs run 24/7 for patient transport, and the city’s operations center coordinates referrals. Mandaue City Hospital has 25 beds and functions as a Level 1 infirmary, handling surge.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市、27のバランガイにデング熱予防強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: セブ州マンダウエ市における季節性デング熱の発生で死者・患者数は一定数報告されているが、国家・国際的な拡大や渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当せず、地方自治体レベルの通常の対応にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: フィリピン・セブ州マンダウエ市における地域限定のデング熱流行で、市当局が27バランガイに予防強化を要請。病床25床の市立病院で対応中だが、外部（国・国際）支援の必要性は記載なし。季節性の地方レベル対応として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Detectaron en Argentina los primeros tres casos de un nuevo linaje de COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First three cases of a new COVID-19 lineage detected in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: Three cases of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron sublineage PJ.2.1 have been detected in Argentina, the first identifications in the country. Two are infants under three months and one adult, all residents of Buenos Aires Province; detections were notified on November 20, with samples collected between November 6–11. Provincial and national health teams, in collaboration with INEI-ANLIS Malbrán, are completing clinical and epidemiological characterization. Although this finding is relevant for national genomic surveillance, there is currently no evidence of sustained community transmission or clear magnitudes of PJ.2.1 circulation in Argentina. The lineage has been classified as a variant under monitoring by PAHO/WHO, reflecting increased global representation (notably in Brazil, Canada, and the United States) but with a low public health risk and no demonstrated higher transmissibility or disease severity. In 2026, SARS-CoV-2 circulation remained low, with a slight uptick since week 35; COVID-19 hospitalizations year-to-date are 46.2% lower than in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで新型COVID-19系統の最初の3症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 新規Omicron亜系統PJ.2.1がアルゼンチンで初検出されたが、持続的市中感染の証拠はなく、PAHO/WHOも公衆衛生リスクは低いと分類しており、対象国（ブラジル等）での主題性もないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの新規変異株検出であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル等）は比較対象として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് ചിക്കൻപോക്സ് വ്യാപിക്കുന്നു; ഈ വർഷം 12 മരണം | Chickenpox spreads in kerala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox is spreading in the state; 12 deaths this year.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox is spreading in Kerala, India, with reports from Kozhikode. Health officials say yesterday 94 new cases were confirmed, raising November’s tally to 1,821. For January 1–November 24 this year, 34,852 infections have been recorded, with 12 deaths in 2026; 2025 saw 29,055 infections. The disease, caused by Varicella Zoster Virus, presents with fever, headache, fatigue, loss of appetite, and a vesicular rash that starts as red papules and evolves into fluid-filled blisters, commonly on the face, chest and back. It is highly contagious via airborne spread and direct contact with blister fluid; infectiousness lasts from 1–2 days before rash until all lesions crust. Two-dose varicella vaccination significantly reduces risk and severity. Preventive measures include isolating the patient, ensuring ventilation, hand hygiene, avoiding shared items, and limiting contact with pregnant women, newborns, or immunocompromised individuals; stay away from schools/work until all vesicles crusted. Bathing is allowed; maintain cleanliness and pat dry.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で水痘が拡大、今年は12人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのケララ州で水痘（水痘帯状疱疹ウイルス）の症例数が増加し死亡例も報告されているが、季節性・地域性の既知の感染症であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限、異常性は認められないため、フルRRAには至らず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 水痘はワクチンで予防可能な既知の感染症であり、今回の報告は地域の年次統計の更新に過ぎない可能性が高い。死亡率や重症度の経年比較データがなく、severityは不明と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Paraguay confirmó ocho casos de viruela símica y refuerza la vigilancia sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraguay confirms eight cases of monkeypox and strengthens health surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) has been confirmed in Paraguay with eight cases in the Central Department surrounding Asunción (Luque, San Lorenzo, Capiatá, Fernando de la Mora, Areguá). All patients are around 35 years old; one required hospitalization for observation, the rest are under medical follow-up. Paraguay is not endemic for mpox; cases are linked to two imported infections that spread to close contacts. The situation is described as contained, with patients isolated while authorities reinforce epidemiological surveillance and border monitoring due to cross-border movement with Argentina and Brazil for shopping and tourism. Mpox transmission occurs mainly through close contact with an infected person, including direct contact with lesions, prolonged respiratory exposure, sharing contaminated objects, or sexual contact. Symptoms include fever, headache, and skin lesions evolving from rash to pustules and crusts; incubation can reach 21 days. Treatment is symptomatic; no specific antiviral noted; monitoring recommended for individuals with preexisting conditions or immunosuppression.

triage.headline_ja: パラグアイでサル痘（Mpox）8例を確認、保健当局が監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイは非流行国であり、輸入症例を起点に濃厚接触者へ拡大したことは異常かつ国際的拡大リスクを示唆するため、IHR基準2項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil（3469034）が含まれるが、記事はパラグアイ国内（アスンシオン首都圏）の事例が主題であり、ブラジル・アルゼンチンは越境移動の文脈でのみ言及されているため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, tra gli oltre 5 mila morti nella RD del Congo ci sono soprattutto bambini piccoli: l'allarme dell'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, among the more than 5,000 deaths in the DRC there are mainly very young children: the WHO's warning.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains severe. WHO’s 20 November 2026 bulletin, with data as of 17 November, reports 11,613 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 5,678 deaths. While some areas show a slight decrease, transmission is high and steady nationwide, with Ituri and North Kivu the most affected. South Kivu and South Ubangi have not reported cases for more than 42 days. A large share of deaths occur in communities outside Ebola Treatment Centers, highlighting delays in early case detection and timely care, especially for young children. No new cases have been reported in Kenya or Nigeria, and no other country has confirmed cases. UNICEF warns of rising violence and abuse against women and girls during the outbreak; in Ituri, nearly 60% of women and girls aged 15+ surveyed report increased violence since the epidemic began, prompting calls for safer spaces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国での5000人超の死者のうち多くは幼い子ども：WHOの警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,613例・5,678名の死者という大規模かつ継続的なエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ケニアとナイジェリアは発生地域として挙げられているが、記事では両国で新規症例なしと明記されており、主題の発生国はDRCのみ。南キブも42日以上症例報告なしだが州として地域リストに含まれるため除外せず注記のみとする。

article.articleHeadline: 瑞普生物：非洲猪瘟重组腺病毒载体活疫苗获临床试验批件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ruipu Biotech: African Swine Fever Recombinant Adenovirus Vector-Based Live Vaccine Receives Clinical Trial Approval
article.articleSummary: Ruipu Biotech Co., Ltd. (300119) announced on November 25, 2026 that the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs granted a clinical-trial approval for its recombinant adenovirus vector-based live vaccine against African Swine Fever (ASF). ASF, caused by the African swine fever virus, is an acute, highly contagious disease; the World Organisation for Animal Health lists it as a notifiable disease, and China designates it as a Class I animal disease with high mortality, threatening the domestic swine industry; no ASF vaccine is approved domestically. The vaccine program, begun in 2023 with Huazhong Agricultural University and others, aims to prevent ASF. Following clinical trials, the company must complete registration to obtain a new veterinary drug certificate and product approval number before marketing. The development milestone is unlikely to affect finances in the short term but could expand the company's major pig disease vaccine pipeline and competitive position.

triage.headline_ja: 瑞普生物：アフリカ豚コレラ組換えアデノウイルスベクター生ワクチン、臨床試験承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病であるASFに関するワクチン開発・承認の企業発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国企業によるASFワクチンの臨床試験承認に関する企業発表であり、ASFの新規発生や流行拡大を報告するものではない。ASFは動物疾病でヒトへの感染性はなく、人獣共通感染症の公衆衛生リスクとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Fogo cruzado e mau tempo travam ajuda a equipes de saúde na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Crossfire and bad weather hamper aid to health teams in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues as crossfire and severe weather impede aid operations. Relief workers are trapped inside a maternity ward in eastern Congo while battling the outbreak, which has claimed more than 5,600 lives. Ongoing security risks and inclement weather slow response efforts, limiting vaccination, treatment, and other essential services to affected communities. The crisis is part of a broader humanitarian emergency in the region, with violence against women reported by up to 60% of females. The situation highlights the perilous conditions under which health teams operate amid conflict and climate challenges as of 25 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：銃撃戦と悪天候がDRCの医療チームへの支援を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的流行で5,600人超の死者が出ており、紛争により対応活動が妨げられている重大な公衆衛生危機であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 死者数5,600人超という既存の大規模流行の継続事例。紛争地域での人道支援活動の困難さが焦点であり、国際的拡大リスクについての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhiwandi shawarma scare: Over 50 fall ill, children and a pregnant woman among those in hospital
article.articleSummary: In Bhiwandi, Thane district, at least 53 people were hospitalised after eating shawarma from the same roadside stall in Vanzarpatti Naka on Monday evening. The patients—including 25 women, 17 children, and one pregnant woman—developed vomiting, diarrhoea, and severe abdominal pain; by Tuesday morning 11 were admitted and the total rose above 50, with all currently stable at Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital (IGM). Samples have been sent for chemical analysis to identify the causative microorganism; authorities cautioned that lab tests are needed to confirm if the illness originated from food or another source. A case has been registered at Nizampura police station; the stall owner is absconding. FDA officials noted dispersed street-vendor activity in Bhiwandi and potential water quality concerns. A prior shawarma-related outbreak in the city saw about 57 patients admitted a few months earlier.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディのシャワルマ食中毒騒動：50人以上が発症、子供や妊婦も入院
triage.triage_reason: 単一の屋台における食中毒（疑い）事例で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、同様の事例が過去にも発生しており、原因究明の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未特定で、食品由来か水質由来かも不明。過去にも類似の集団食中毒事例が発生しており、地域の食品衛生管理体制に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : Inquiétude pour des travailleurs mobilisés contre Ebola, alors que les violences faites aux femmes et aux filles s'aggravent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Concern for workers mobilized against Ebola, as violence against women and girls worsens.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, WHO personnel and Ebola responders remain blocked inside a hospital in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as intense fighting continues around the facility. A UN situation update indicates access for frontline staff mobilized to contain Ebola is blocked, raising safety concerns for responders amid the ongoing outbreak response. Violence against women and girls has worsened in the area, intensifying humanitarian distress. No Ebola case or death counts are provided, and there is no detail on infection sources or imported/exported cases. The blocked response underscores the difficulty of outbreak containment in a volatile security context around Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対策従事者への懸念、女性・少女への暴力が悪化する中で
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の対応要員が武力衝突により施設内に閉じ込められ、アウトブレイク封じ込めが困難化している。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイツリ州の病院内でエボラ対応要員が戦闘により身動きが取れなくなっている状況を報じている。症例数・死亡者数などの具体的疫学データは記載されておらず、治安悪化が対応能力に直接影響している点が主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : les partenaires appelés à renforcer leurs moyens de lutte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: partners urged to bolster their Ebola-response capabilities.
article.articleSummary: As of November 25, 2026, in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola-response partners were urged to strengthen their capabilities. Samuel Bosembe Ngolu, provincial president of the Mouvement des Sociétés Civiles du Congo, called on partners to take the necessary steps to bolster the currently deficient response resources. The issue is highlighted by CREC (Communication Risk for Community Engagement) which reports logistics bottlenecks, including a lack of transport for field teams. In the Wanie-Rukula health zone (PK 58 on National Road No. 3), phone and internet coverage is estimated at 3.5% across the zone. Reports are received weekly rather than daily, since many health areas lack mobile network coverage. Ebola response in the area is hindered by these multiple constraints.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱：パートナーに対応能力強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の対応体制に深刻な不備（物流・通信の欠如）が指摘されており、公衆衛生上の重大なリスクと外部支援の必要性が明確であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はキサンガニ（Tshopo州）における既存のエボラ対応の物流・通信面の課題を報じており、新規発生の確認は含まれていないが、対応能力不足がアウトブレイク制御リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : deux zones de santé signalent de nouveaux cas d'Ebola après une accalmie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: two health zones report new Ebola cases after a lull - ACP.
article.articleSummary: November 25, 2026 – Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo: The health zones of Kambala (Mahagi Territory) and Ariwara (Aru Territory) reported new Ebola virus disease cases after gaps of more than 125 days and more than 90 days, respectively. Robert Ndjalonga, provincial director of civil protection, urged renewed vigilance across Ituri, stressing enhanced community surveillance, rapid notification of suspected cases, and prompt contact tracing for isolation and follow-up. He called for stronger hygiene practices to limit transmission. Ebola remains a threat, but with sustained community engagement and adherence to control measures, the outbreak can be controlled. The report notes the resurgence after a lull but provides no case counts or laboratory confirmation details beyond the new positives. The emphasis is on surveillance, reporting, and hygiene to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：2つの保健地区で小康状態後にエボラ新規症例を報告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラは致死率の高い疾患であり、長期間の小康状態後の再燃は異常事象かつ公衆衛生上重大な懸念であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: 症例数や検査確定の詳細情報は記事に記載されておらず、続報の確認が必要。125日以上・90日以上の小康期間を経た再燃であり、エボラという疾患の性質上、早期のリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: ஊழலில் திளைக்கும் புதுச்சேரி அரசு; ரங்கசாமியின் மெத்தன போக்காலே டெங்கு மரணங்கள்; நாராயணசாமி குற்றச்சாட்டு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Puducherry government thriving on corruption; Rangasamy's negligent conduct causing dengue deaths; Narayanasamy's accusation.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Puducherry has caused four officially reported deaths amid accusations that the health department under Chief Minister Rangasamy failed to take preventive measures. Former Chief Minister Narayanasamy, in a video statement, alleges widespread corruption across Puducherry's administration - public works, agriculture, education, electricity - that has hampered dengue control and urged immediate action. He says preventive steps were lacking even as cases rose, and questions why investigators have not acted against corrupt practices involving public funds. The report calls for universal free dengue testing in all private hospitals, free treatment, and expanded hospital beds to prevent further deaths, along with mass blood-testing drives to curb transmission. The governor-CM dispute underpins the stagnation, and the piece notes a 50-acre land grant in Setharapattu to JIPMER for a research center, six months into the new government.

triage.headline_ja: 汚職に浸るプドゥチェリー州政府；ランガサミーの怠慢な対応がデング熱死亡を招く；ナラヤナサミーが非難
triage.triage_reason: プドゥチェリーでデング熱による死者4名が報告され政治問題化しているが、感染規模や地域拡大の詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年インドの複数州で流行する風土病であり、本記事は主に政治的対立（州政府と知事の対立、汚職疑惑）に焦点を当てた報道。感染症対策としての医療崩壊リスクや感染者数の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: புதுச்சேரியில் அதிகரிக்கும் டெங்கு; 4 பேர் மரணம்; முதல்வர் ரங்கசாமி அவசர ஆலோசனை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue on the rise in Puducherry; four dead; Chief Minister Rangasamy holds emergency meeting.
article.articleSummary: Four dengue-related deaths reported in Puducherry amid rising cases; fatalities linked to Muthialpet, Poorananguppam, Villianur, and Noanankuppam areas. With public fear mounting, Chief Minister Rangasamy convened an emergency meeting with health department officials at the Legislative Assembly complex, attended by the Health Department Director Dr Sevel. The discussion reviewed current fatalities, hospital admissions, and treatments being provided. Rangasamy directed intensified vector-control measures (urban and rural mosquito control) and expanded public awareness campaigns. He also ordered stockpiling of dengue medicines in the health department to prevent shortages and called for updated figures on deaths, hospitalizations, and treatment strategies to ensure prompt, responsive public health action.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーでデング熱が増加、4人死亡；首相ランガサミーが緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: インド・プドゥチェリーでデング熱による死亡者が発生し行政が緊急対応を行っているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の要素はなく、季節性流行の域を出ないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年季節的に流行する既知の感染症であり、地方政府レベルでの対応が行われている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての性質は低いが、死亡者増加と行政の緊急対応は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах смертельно небезпечного вірусу може охопити весь світ: у ВООЗ б'ють на сполох
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of a deadly virus could engulf the world: the WHO sounds the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Over 11,000 people are infected with the Ebola virus Bundibugyo in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with a case fatality rate near 50% and more than 5,500 deaths reported; additional cases have been registered in Nigeria, Uganda, Kenya, and France. This outbreak is the second-largest in Ebola history and is spreading faster than the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. No vaccine exists for this strain. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi warned that instability, population displacement, and outbreaks in hard-to-reach areas hinder containment, though global risk remains low for now; international spread cannot be ruled out. The United States has tightened entry restrictions for travelers from affected countries, requiring, since November 3, certification that entrants were not in the DRC in the prior 21 days, with penalties for false statements. CDC notes an 8-10 day incubation, with initial symptoms of fever, severe headache, loss of appetite, and sore throat, followed by abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスの発生が世界を席巻する恐れ：WHOが警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが致死率約50%・死者5,500人超・感染者11,000人超と史上2番目の規模に達し、複数国への越境拡大と渡航制限が既に発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行を主題とし、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・米国への波及や渡航制限に言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra: 53 fall ill after eating shawarma at roadside stall in Bhiwandi
article.articleSummary: 53 people, including 10 children, were hospitalized with suspected food poisoning after consuming shawarma at a roadside stall in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra. The illness followed Monday night consumption; 48 were admitted on Tuesday and five more on Wednesday. Among the 48 admitted, 22 men, 16 women, three boys and seven girls were treated. Vomit and stool samples have been collected and sent for laboratory testing to identify the causative agent. A case has been registered against the stall owner, who is absconding, and the authorities demolished the allegedly unauthorised eatery. This marks a second shawarma-linked illness in Bhiwandi in recent months, after a June incident where 117 people fell ill at another stall.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州:ビワンディの路上屋台でシャワルマを食べた後53人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食中毒（疑い）事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 原因物質は検査中であり感染症起因か食品汚染（化学物質等）かは不明。過去にも同地域で同様の事例（6月、117人発症）があり、食品衛生管理の問題として地域保健当局が対応中。感染症のアウトブレイクではなく食中毒事案のためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Criança de 5 anos morre após quadro de infecção intestinal em Bom Jesus do Itabapoana; familiar descarta febre maculosa - Folha BJI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 5-year-old child dies after a case of gastroenteritis in Bom Jesus do Itabapoana; a family member rules out spotted fever - Folha BJI.
article.articleSummary: Five-year-old Allycia Andrade died in Bom Jesus do Itabapoana, Northwestern Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, after a gastroenteritis-like illness that began at school on Friday, 20 November. She was treated at the Hospital São Vicente de Paulo’s Urgent Care, initially improved after antibiotics, but around 18:00 her condition deteriorated with about eight episodes of vomiting and a fever of 37.6 C. She died the same day. A blood sample was drawn and sent to a laboratory in Rio de Janeiro for analysis. According to a family member speaking to Folha BJI, hypotheses of Brazilian spotted fever and meningitis were ruled out, with the family attributing the death to a severe intestinal infection. The case is under investigation and, at the time of reporting, there is no official diagnosis confirmed. No additional cases or outbreak details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 5歳児が胃腸炎様症状の後に死亡、ボン・ジェズス・ド・イタバパナ（ブラジル）；家族は紅斑熱を否定
triage.triage_reason: 単独の原因不明死亡例であり、公式診断も未確定、他症例の報告もないため情報不足だが、死亡例として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の小児死亡例で、原因不明の急性疾患。公式診断未確定、血液検査結果待ち。他の症例報告なく、集団発生の兆候は見られない。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Atriz é internada às pressas após contrair vírus que mata milhares de pessoas por ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actress rushed to hospital after contracting a virus that kills thousands of people each year.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actress Myrian Rios, 67, is hospitalized in São Paulo after testing positive for influenza A, which has caused decreased blood oxygenation and required ongoing medical supervision. The illness began about a week earlier with sore throat, fatigue, and a mild cough, progressing to a crisis between Sunday and Monday that led to a visit to the emergency department. Physicians admitted her due to unstable oxygen levels, with her condition described as under control and steadily improving as of Nov 24, 2026. Rios posted from her hospital room via social media, noting an influenza surge in the area and urging others with concerning symptoms to seek urgent care at an ER or UPA. No laboratory confirmation details or case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 女優、年間数千人が死亡するウイルスに感染し緊急入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の季節性インフルエンザA罹患に関する一般的な健康ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザによる地域的な流行への言及があるが、個人の症例報告であり集団発生の規模や異常性を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Explosão de casos faz MS chegar a 1,1 mil infectados por sarna humana em 44 cidades - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã/MS e Pedro Juan Caballero/PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in cases brings Mato Grosso do Sul to 1,100 people infected with human scabies in 44 cities - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã, MS and Pedro Juan Caballero, PY.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul reports at least 1,137 cases of human scabies across 44 municipalities, led by Paranaíba with 155, followed by Nova Andradina (152) and Nova Alvorada do Sul (106). Data from COSEMS/MS were updated to Tuesday, 24 November, noting limitations because scabies is not a mandatory-notification disease, complicating precise counts. The state council labels the scenario an outbreak, while the state health secretariat calls it an observatory notice for a collective increase; the Ministry of Health says scabies is not an official public health emergency. The MoH offered technical support and urges that transmission be halted by treating close contacts simultaneously, washing clothes/bedding in hot water, and avoiding sharing personal items. Transmission is via skin-to-skin contact, with a 2–6 week incubation. In crowded settings with children, control requires treatment, active case finding, and strict follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 症例急増によりマトグロッソ・ド・スル州で疥癬感染者が44都市で1,100人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬の症例が州内44自治体で増加し州評議会はアウトブレイクと表現しているが、保健省は公衆衛生上の緊急事態とは認定しておらず、重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は届出義務のある疾患ではなく正確な把握が困難。保健省は正式な公衆衛生緊急事態とは認定していないが、州レベルではアウトブレイクと認識されており、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rebels pull back near Bunia as violence deepens in Ebola-hit Ituri
article.articleSummary: Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faced intensified violence as the rebel Convention for the Popular Revolution, led by Thomas Lubanga, announced a halt to its advance toward Bunia and a withdrawal from recently captured positions after days of fighting with government forces. Bunia, the provincial capital, sits near Iga-Barriere, captured 25 kilometers north, prompting a government retreat toward the city. The army accused rebels of continuing attacks in Djugu territory, including Pacio, Mabanga and Liko, with civilians harmed; casualty figures were not provided. Thousands have fled toward Bunia amid renewed clashes. The rebels also reportedly took Lopa and Linji. Diplomatic talks hosted by Ugandan President Museveni in Entebbe on Oct. 9 aimed to revive dialogue. Ituri is the epicenter of Congo’s ongoing Ebola outbreak, elevating humanitarian concerns; no infection counts or lab-confirmed figures are given in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 反政府勢力がブニア近郊から撤退、エボラ発生地イトゥリで暴力拡大
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州における武力紛争が主題であり、同地域がエボラ流行の震源地である点に言及しているが、感染者数や疫学的新情報は提供されていないため、紛争がアウトブレイク対応に与える影響を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は武力紛争であり、エボラ関連の疫学データ（症例数、死亡数等）は含まれていない。紛争による人道状況悪化がエボラ対応・封じ込めに影響を与える可能性があるため、続報を注視する価値がある。ウガンダ（Entebbe）、中国、スペイン等の地名は外交対話や無関係な場所として言及されているのみで、疾病発生とは無関係のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Myrian Rios é internada com influenza A: quando a doença preocupa?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Myrian Rios hospitalized with Influenza A: When should the illness be a cause for concern?
article.articleSummary: Myrian Rios, a 67-year-old Brazilian actress, has been hospitalized after testing positive for influenza A, with symptoms worsening over about a week. She reported sore throat, mild cough, and fatigue that intensified, leading to an overnight visit and admission for monitoring due to oxygen saturation below normal. The article notes influenza A and B as seasonal respiratory viruses; A can affect humans and animals and includes subtypes H1N1 and H3N2, while B circulates mainly among humans. Common symptoms include cough, fever, chills, runny nose, sore throat, headache, myalgia, and fatigue, with occasional gastrointestinal symptoms, especially in children. Flu usually lasts about a week; more severe cases can last 7–10 days, with higher risk for complications among vulnerable groups. Treatment relies on antivirals such as oseltamivir (most effective within 48 hours), supportive care, vaccination, masking, and hand hygiene in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ミリアン・リオス、インフルエンザAで入院：この病気が懸念されるのはどんな時か？
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の季節性インフルエンザ罹患に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 有名人の個人的な罹患・入院に関する報道であり、季節性インフルエンザの一般的な説明記事。公衆衛生イベントとしての異常性・集団感染の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna toma conta de MS e até escolas precisam fechar as portas - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies takes over Mato Grosso do Sul, and even schools have to close their doors - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 1,302 confirmed cases in 44 municipalities as of 2026-11-25 (Cosems-MS). Nova Andradina leads with 185 cases, followed by Paranaíba (155); Dourados, Rio Brilhante, and Nova Alvorada do Sul exceed 100 each. At least seven municipalities closed schools and daycares for disinfection; Dourados and Juti remain closed, while Campo Grande, Angélica, Batayporã, Itaporã and Nova Andradina have reopened. Campo Grande reports 15 confirmed and 45 suspected cases. In Juti, seven cases are recorded, though numbers may be higher. Scabies causes intense nocturnal itching and spreads via prolonged direct contact or shared contaminated fabrics and bedding; not due to poor hygiene. SES-MS has logged 31 outbreaks; the true burden is uncertain since scabies is not a mandatory-notification disease. Public health measures emphasize containment and disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬がマットグロッソ・ド・スル州を席巻、学校も閉鎖に追い込まれる
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準で複数該当（異常な拡大規模、持続的曝露、流行しやすさ）し、学校閉鎖など社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 疥癬は致死的な疾患ではないが、44自治体で1,302例・31件のアウトブレイクが報告され学校・保育施設の閉鎖が相次ぐなど、地域内での急速な拡大と社会的影響が顕著。届出義務がないため実際の規模は不明。重症度は低いが流行規模・拡大性の観点からWATCHではなくPICKUPと判断。
