article.articleHeadline: Dengue: tres nuevos casos, dos de ellos con antecedentes de viaje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: three new cases, two of them with travel history.
article.articleSummary: Dengue: three new cases reported in Argentina on 25 November 2026. Two cases have travel histories to Mexico and the Dominican Republic and are both DENV-2; the third case in Buenos Aires Province also traveled to Mexico, with serotype not yet identified. For the 2026-2027 season, 11 imported dengue cases have been notified: four in Buenos Aires Province with travel to Brazil, Ecuador, Mexico and the Dominican Republic; three in Buenos Aires City with travel to Peru and Brazil; two in Córdoba; one in Santa Fe with travel to Peru; one in Santa Cruz with travel to Costa Rica. Of 1,584 suspected dengue cases, 797 were discarded, 760 are under investigation, and 16 are probable. Chikungunya shows no new cases in the last analyzed week; one case remains in Orán, Salta, with travel to Bolivia. Despite low current risk, intensified surveillance and continued chikungunya screening among acute febrile illnesses are advised to detect new transmission foci.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：新たに3例、うち2例は渡航歴あり
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおける輸入デング熱症例の報告であり、対象国（ブラジル・フィリピン等）は旅行歴としての言及に過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン（対象国外）における輸入デング熱・チクングニア熱症例の疫学サマリーであり、現地伝播リスクは低いとされている。発生地域リストに含まれるブラジル・フィリピン等は患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Seasonal fever cases on the rise in Tiruchi
article.articleSummary: Seasonal fever cases are rising in Tiruchi (Tiruchirappalli) due to monsoon-related illnesses and intermittent rainfall. So far this month, about 12 dengue cases have been reported, with fever, viral fever, cough and cold commonly noted. Doctors advise tests if fever lasts more than three days. The Tiruchi Corporation has intensified surveillance and preventive measures: about 450 domestic breeding checkers conducting door-to-door inspections across wards to identify and eliminate mosquito-breeding sources; dedicated fogging teams with portable machines and high-capacity fogging vehicles; intensified fogging in areas with reported fevers. Special fever camps are being organized, along with daily health camps at Urban Primary Health Centres and health and wellness centres. Surveillance priorities target vulnerable, densely populated areas, including Thiruvanaikoil, Selva Nagar, and extended/peripheral zones. Residents report ongoing mosquito nuisance linked to stagnant water in open drains and vacant plots.

triage.headline_ja: ティルチ(ティルチラーパッリ)で季節性熱病の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加であり、地方自治体が通常の対策（防疫・サーベイランス）を実施している段階で、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、継続的な動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（Tiruchi Corporation）が独自に蚊対策・サーベイランス強化を行っており、季節性のモンスーン関連疾患として管理可能な範囲内と判断される。重症例や死亡者数の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: TB cases rise by around 20 % in Bhopal; health department to intensify screening
article.articleSummary: TB cases in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, rose about 20–30% this year (2026), with roughly 12,000–13,000 cases versus 10,000 last year. CMHO Manish Sharma said the health department will intensify screening and contact tracing in identified hotspots under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), including camps, Sanjeevani Clinics, and mobile X-ray screening to identify suspected TB patients and start treatment. Preventive measures include TB Preventive Treatment (TPT) and BCG vaccination for people in contact with TB patients. Factors driving transmission include poor nutritional status and low socioeconomic status, with higher risk in slum settlements due to living conditions, food habits, and inadequate ventilation. Sharma emphasized basic hygiene and nutrition, and warned that completing treatment does not prevent recurrence if immunity weakens.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでTB症例が約20%増加、保健当局がスクリーニングを強化へ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の症例増加報告であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域的な感染拡大・対策強化の動きがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 結核はインドにおいて既知の流行病であり、NTEPの通常プログラム活動の一環としての報告。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、地域の症例増加傾向として継続的な監視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Fight Runs Up Against Customs, Rites In Remote DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bulambo-Isale, North Kivu’s Vuhovi district, amid decades-long conflict with armed groups. Six months into the outbreak, there have been over 11,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths since May. The haemorrhagic fever spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. Health workers face daily attacks and hostility as locals distrust authorities who they view as corrupt and profiteering, and fear being harmed by outsiders. Burial rituals require family-led ceremonies with the deceased laid to soil of ancestors, clashing with sealed-body-bag practices and protective teams. Language and cultural gaps, higher wages for locally recruited responders, and suspicion of the response efforts hinder outreach. Calls for a more bottom-up, community-informed approach to complement medical measures in Bulambo-Isale and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の辺境地域、エボラ対策が慣習や儀式と衝突
triage.triage_reason: 6か月間で症例数11,000人超・死者5,000人超という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、ワクチン・特異的治療法が無く、武装勢力による紛争や地域住民の不信が対応を阻害しているため、深刻かつ拡大リスクの高い公衆衛生事案と判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く、ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない。武装勢力の活動する紛争地域であり、保健従事者への攻撃や埋葬儀礼との衝突により対応が難航しているため、国際的な支援と継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка смертельно опасного вируса может вскоре охватить весь мир
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak of a deadly virus could soon sweep the world.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak—originating in the Democratic Republic of Congo—has infected more than 11,000 people and caused over 5,500 deaths (case fatality about 50%). Cases have also been detected in Nigeria, Uganda, Kenya, and France. The World Health Organization does not rule out international spread; the current outbreak is described as the second-largest in Ebola history and spreading twice as fast as the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed over 11,000. There is no licensed vaccine; containment relies on isolation and rigorous contact tracing amid unstable security, population movement, and hard-to-reach areas. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi notes these factors hinder response, though global risk remains low. The United States has tightened entry rules for travelers from affected countries since 3 November, requiring a 21-day no-visit-to-DRC attestation. Incubation is 8–10 days; early symptoms include abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. France recently reported an imported Ebola case in a physician returning from DRC; contact tracing is underway.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスの発生が間もなく世界中に広がる可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を起点とするブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、感染者11,000人超・死者5,500人超（致死率約50%）、複数国への国際拡大と渡航制限が既に発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、米国）への波及に言及しているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。WHOは国際的拡大の可能性を否定していない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка смертельно опасного вируса может охватить весь мир: в ВОЗ бьют тревогу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of a deadly virus could engulf the entire world: WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected more than 11,000 people and caused nearly 5,500 deaths. The outbreak is the second-largest in Ebola history, with cases in Nigeria, Uganda, Kenya, and France. There is currently no vaccine. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi says instability, population movement, and hard-to-reach areas hinder containment; global risk remains low, but international spread is possible. The United States has tightened entry rules for travelers from affected countries: since November 3, travelers must certify they were not in the DRC in the prior 21 days, with penalties for false statements. CDC notes incubation of 8–10 days; early symptoms include fever, severe headache, loss of appetite, and sore throat, followed by abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスの流行が世界中に広がる可能性：WHOが警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したスーダンエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）が1万人以上感染・約5500人死亡と、エボラ史上2番目の規模の流行となっており、複数国への越境拡大と渡航制限（米国の入国規制強化）が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が発生源であり、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・米国は二次感染例または渡航制限の文脈で言及されているため、対象国リストに該当するDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。致死率の高さと国際的拡大の兆候から緊急のフルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Renewed DR Congo clashes force civilian flight, Ebola team evacuations
article.articleSummary: Renewed clashes between Congolese forces and the CRP rebel group in Djugu district, Ituri Province, have forced thousands of civilians to flee toward Bunia and disrupted Ebola response operations. The fighting, advancing toward Bunia, prompted evacuation of WHO and Africa CDC personnel; WHO staff evacuated from Akwe hospital after sheltering for days, and from Mongbwalu to Bunia amid renewed clashes. The Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has sickened nearly 12,000 and killed over 5,800 since its May 15 declaration; no vaccine or specific treatment is available. Despite CRP announcing a halt to its offensive, security remains volatile and humanitarian access is constrained; Ugandan-facilitated talks in Entebbe had sought a ceasefire. The WHO maintains the outbreak as a PHEIC, with insecurity hampering response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で戦闘再燃、民間人避難とエボラ対応チームの撤退
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと認定しているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが、武力衝突により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 武力衝突によりWHO・Africa CDCの職員が避難し、エボラ対応活動が阻害されている。致死率や患者数が非常に高く（約12,000人感染、5,800人以上死亡）、WHOはPHEICを維持している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal में TB के केस 13 हजार पहुंचे, CMHO मनीष शर्मा बोले- हॉटस्पॉट में बढ़ेगी ट्रेसिंग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB cases in Bhopal have reached 13,000; CMHO Manish Sharma said tracing will be intensified in hotspots.
article.articleSummary: TB cases in Bhopal, the capital of Madhya Pradesh, have surged to about 12,000–13,000 this year, up from roughly 10,000 last year—a rise of around 20–30%. CMHO Manish Sharma said hotspots will see intensified screening and contact tracing under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP). The city conducts regular camps via the Sanjeevani Clinic, with mobile X-ray units deployed at sites including prisons to identify presumptive TB and determine treatment needs. Preventive measures include TB preventive treatment (TPT) for contacts and BCG vaccination. Risk factors cited are malnutrition and low socio-economic status, with slums and poor ventilation contributing to transmission. Officials emphasize maintaining hygiene and nutrition to curb spread; completion of treatment does not preclude future TB if immunity wanes.

triage.headline_ja: ボーパールのTB症例が1万3000人に到達、CMHOマニシュ・シャルマ氏「ホットスポットでの追跡調査を強化」と発言
triage.triage_reason: TBはインドで流行性（風土病）の疾患であり、本記事は国家結核撲滅プログラム（NTEP）の通常の対策強化を報じるものであって、異常な急増や国際的拡大の懸念を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 結核は風土病であり、本記事は地方保健当局による通常の検診・追跡強化施策を報じる内容。シグナルとしての異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Meski Kena Influenza B, Shin Tetap Pimpin Persija Bekuk Sumsel United
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even though he contracted Influenza B, Shin still leads Persija as they defeat Sumsel United.
article.articleSummary: Influenza B diagnosed in Shin Tae-yong in Jakarta, Indonesia; influenza activity reported in Jakarta. Despite being unwell, Shin attended as Persija Jakarta defeated Sumsel United 7-0 in the League Cup 2025/26 group stage on 24 November 2026 at Stadion Sultan Agung, Bantul. Post-match, he acknowledged the illness, diagnosed by hospital doctors, and noted the broader surge of influenza in Jakarta. To prevent transmission to players and staff, he avoided the pre-match press conference and minimized direct contact. The article emphasizes ongoing influenza cases in Jakarta but provides no specific patient counts or laboratory details beyond the hospital diagnosis. Shin’s commitment underscores public health considerations around athletes continuing participation during respiratory outbreaks while taking precautions.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザBに罹患しながらも、シン監督はペルシジャを率いてスムセルUnitedを下す
triage.triage_reason: 個人（サッカー監督）のインフルエンザB罹患に関するスポーツ記事であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はサッカーチーム監督の個人的な疾病に焦点を当てたスポーツニュースであり、ジャカルタでのインフルエンザ流行については具体的な患者数や検査データが示されていない。公衆衛生イベントとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: سفالی انسٹی ٹیوٹ میں چوتھے دن بھی بچوں کو پولیو کی دو بوندیں پلائی گئیں
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even on the fourth day, two drops of polio vaccine were given to the children at the Safali Institute.
article.articleSummary: Two drops of oral polio vaccine were administered to several children on the fourth day of Bhagalpur's polio eradication drive, at the Safali Institute campus in Sarai. The event was inaugurated by Dr. Ovais Ali, retired Chief Medical Officer, Coal India Limited, with Prof. (Dr.) Farooq Ali, President of Safali Institute and former Vice-Chancellor, in attendance. He noted that India has been polio-free for about 15 years, but vigilance remains since cases occur in other countries. The ongoing 2026 Sub-National Immunization Campaign runs from 22 to 26 November to ensure no child misses vaccination, alongside routine immunization. Parents should vaccinate all children up to five years. Supervisors included Poonam Singh; Senior Sevika Anju Kumari; Noor Khatun; Ruksana; Leela Devi; Aditya Kumar.

triage.headline_ja: サファリー研究所で4日目もポリオワクチンの2滴投与が実施された
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ根絶に向けた定例のワクチン接種活動の報告であり、実際の感染症例の発生ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ビハール州での定期予防接種（Sub-National Immunization Campaign）の実施報告であり、ポリオ患者の発生や流行を示すものではない。インドは約15年間ポリオフリーであると記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: LIRAa de 4,7 coloca Coronel Fabriciano em situação de alto risco com infestação do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIRAa score of 4.7 puts Coronel Fabriciano in a high-risk situation with Aedes aegypti infestation.
article.articleSummary: Coronel Fabriciano's health surveillance reports a November 2026 LIRAa infestation index of 4.7% for Aedes aegypti, indicating high risk for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. The rapid index survey inspected 1,740 properties across all neighborhoods. Chácaras Contente (33.3%) and Santa Terezinha I (33.0%) recorded the highest infestation, followed by Professores (19%), Padre Rocha and Santo Antônio (16.6%), Sílvio Pereira II (15.5%), Caladinho do Meio (13.6%), Córrego Alto and Frederico Ozanam (13.3%), Manoel Maia (13%). Primary breeding containers are plant vases and water tanks (18% each), then garbage and cans (13.8%), tires (8.3%), buckets (7%), and caixas-d’água (5.5%). Many breeding sites are inside homes; the rainy, warm period favors proliferation. The municipality is intensifying actions—‘Mexa-se contra o Mosquito’, cleaning mutirões, and domiciliary visits. Residents should spend at least ten minutes weekly inspecting homes and yards, keeping water tanks covered, cleaning gutters, eliminating water-holding containers, and discarding tires, bottles, cans, and other debris to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: LIRAa指数4.7、コロネル・ファブリシアーノ市はネッタイシマカ蔓延で高リスク状態に
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の幼虫指数（LIRAa）に基づく予防的な公衆衛生対策の報告であり、実際の症例発生や流行の報告ではないため、現時点でのシグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル国内の一地方自治体（コロネル・ファブリシアーノ市）における蚊媒介感染症リスク指数の報告であり、実際の患者発生数や流行状況についての記述はない。地方自治体レベルの予防活動報告のため、国家レベルのverified_locationsには該当しないと判断。続報で実際の症例数増加等が報告されればWATCH以上に引き上げる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo encerra surto de sarampo após 12 semanas sem novos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Ends Measles Outbreak After 12 Weeks Without New Cases.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo ended after 12 weeks with no new transmissions. In 2026, 41 measles cases were recorded: 37 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André; all patients recovered. The last confirmed case had symptoms on August 28, 2026. Surveillance and contact tracing continue, with authorities urging maintained vigilance and vaccination. First-dose coverage with the measles-containing triple vaccine reached 96.9%, above the 95% target, while the second-dose coverage was 84.85%, below the ideal. Free vaccination is available at Basic Health Units. Schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; ages 15 months to 29 years should have two documented doses (min 30 days apart); ages 30 to 59 should have at least one; health workers should have two doses. Tatiana Lang D'Agostini, director of the Center for Epidemiological Surveillance, emphasized continued vaccination adherence.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ、麻疹の流行終息を宣言 新規症例なく12週間経過
triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイクは既に終息し新規症例もなく、全員回復済み。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はアウトブレイク終息の報告であり、継続中の公衆衛生上のリスクはない。ワクチン接種率向上の呼びかけが主な内容。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав Израиля: подозрение на заболевание лихорадкой Эбола после поездки в Конго не подтвердилось
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Israel's Ministry of Health: suspected Ebola fever after a trip to Congo has not been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: On 25 November 2026, Israel's Ministry of Health reported that laboratory analyses for a patient hospitalized yesterday with suspected Ebola fever produced negative results. The individual had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the initial suspicion arose from that travel history. Investigations were conducted in strict accordance with professional protocols and international recommendations for diagnosing highly hazardous infectious diseases. The ministry emphasizes that there is currently no confirmed Ebola case in Israel. Ebola is not transmitted via the airborne route; transmission occurs through direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with the patient's blood, bodily fluids, or secretions.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエル保健省:コンゴ訪問後のエボラ熱疑いは確認されず
triage.triage_reason: イスラエルでの疑い症例は検査の結果陰性と確定し、エボラ感染は否定された。対象国での実際の発生も確認されていない。
triage.notes: 疑い症例はイスラエルで発生し検査結果陰性で否定された。DRCでの実際のエボラ発生を示す記述はなく、対象国リストにイスラエルも含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Zoonose transmitida por gatos soma quase 1,5 mil diagnósticos humanos no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cat-transmitted zoonosis accounts for nearly 1,500 human diagnoses in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, a cat-transmitted fungal zoonosis caused by Sporothrix species, has infected 1,465 people in Rio Grande do Sul (RS) in 2026, according to state health authorities. The highest case load is in the Porto Alegre region; RS records 1,051 cases under investigation and 243 discarded. The ten cities with the most confirmed human cases in 2026 are Canoas (156), Porto Alegre (142), Alvorada (119), Viamão (98), Gravataí (88), Novo Hamburgo (74), São Leopoldo (63), Sapucaia do Sul (46), Rio Grande (35), and Pelotas (29). There have been 2,510 voluntary animal-notifications this year. In Guaíba, a feline outbreak with 338 positive animals coincides with 25 human infections; the city activated an emergency screening protocol at the Zoonoses Control Unit after a court ruling. Infected cats show facial, ear, and paw lesions; authorities urge not abandoning or burying ill animals. Preventive measures include indoor confinement for cats and PPE when handling soil and plants.

triage.headline_ja: ネコ媒介性人獣共通感染症、リオグランデ・ド・スルで人への診断数が約1,500件に達する
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスはブラジルで既知のネコ媒介性人獣共通感染症であり、症例数は増加しているが重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低く、地域当局が既存の対策（動物隔離・緊急検査プロトコル）で対応している段階のため、フルRRAには至らないが続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスは既知の風土病的人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、主にネコからの感染拡大が焦点。州当局による緊急スクリーニングプロトコルが既に稼働しており、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは低いと評価される。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les combats reprennent au cœur de l'épidémie d'Ebola, contraignant civils et soignants à fuir (SYNTHESE)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Fighting resumes at the heart of the Ebola outbreak, forcing civilians and healthcare workers to flee (Synthesis).
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, fighting resumed in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, forcing thousands of civilians to flee and prompting evacuation of Ebola responders as clashes between the Congolese army and the CRP rebel group led by Thomas Lubanga intensify in Djugu, Ituri—the epicenter of the current outbreak. Although the CRP announced a suspension of its offensive toward Bunia, security remains fragile, with the army alleging continued attacks on civilians and positions. Since Monday, thousands have fled toward Bunia, straining host communities and disrupting schools, markets, water, food, and healthcare access. UN movement restrictions in parts of Djugu hinder humanitarian work. The Ebola response near Ituri hospitals has been disrupted; staff evacuated from Akwe and Mongbwalu to Bunia. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has affected nearly 12,000 people and killed over 5,800 since May 15, with no approved vaccine or treatment. The outbreak remains a PHEIC due to insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：戦闘再燃によりエボラ出血熱流行の中心地で民間人と医療従事者が避難を余儀なくされる（総合）
triage.triage_reason: 既にPHEICとされているエボラ流行地で武力紛争が再燃し、対応体制が崩壊・医療従事者の避難を招いており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と管理困難性が顕著であるため。
triage.notes: 既にPHEICと宣言されている長期化中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、約12,000人感染・5,800人超死亡）が、武力紛争の再燃により対応継続が困難になっている状況。フルリスク評価（RRA）による状況の再確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RN chega a 19 casos confirmados de mpox em 2026; Natal concentra 15 registros - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Norte reaches 19 confirmed mpox cases in 2026; Natal accounts for 15 cases - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Norte reports 19 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, per Sesap, with data current to 23 November 2026. The state has 203 notifications, 128 discarded, and 10 under investigation. Natal accounts for 15 of the confirmed cases; São Gonçalo do Amarante has 2, Extremoz 1, and Mossoró 1. Of the 19 confirmed, 16 are men and 3 are women. Mpox is caused by the mpox virus and transmits mainly through direct contact with skin or mucous membrane lesions, or via contaminated objects such as clothing, towels, or sheets. Common symptoms include skin lesions (blisters, pustules, wounds), fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, body aches, and fatigue. Authorities recommend avoiding contact with suspected or confirmed cases, not sharing personal items, and frequent hand hygiene. Suspected cases should seek medical evaluation at a health unit.

triage.headline_ja: ヒオグランデ・ド・ノルテ州、2026年のmpox確定症例が19件に；ナタル市で15件集中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の既知流行病（mpox）の地域的な症例報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻性を示す情報はないが、継続的な症例発生状況として経過観察の対象とする。
triage.notes: 地方自治体保健局（Sesap）による定例的な症例報告。重症度や死亡例の言及はなく、既存のサーベイランス体制下での管理が継続されている様子。

article.articleHeadline: W.H.O Evacuates Ebola Response Team from DR Congo Hospital as Fighting Intensifies
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-25, the WHO evacuated its Ebola response team from a hospital in Akwe, Ituri Province, DR Congo, after intensified fighting forced workers to shelter for more than three days. Director-General Tedros said teams from WHO, DR Congo's Ministry of Health and partners were temporarily relocated pending security improvements, raising concerns about continuity of Ebola containment in affected communities. Ituri remains at the center of DR Congo's worst-ever Ebola outbreak, with 11,762 cases and 5,775 deaths reported by WHO. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo EBOV strain, for which no approved vaccines or treatments exist. Two candidate vaccines--ChAdOx1 (Oxford/Serum Institute) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna)--are expected to enter clinical trials in Ituri. Gavi announced an advance purchase commitment with Serum Institute/Serum Life Sciences to secure up to 1.5 million doses of ChAdOx1, subject to trials and regulatory approval. Security deterioration, including attacks since late October, continues to disrupt response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、戦闘激化によりDRCの病院からエボラ対応チームを避難
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行（11,762症例、死亡5,775人）が続く中、治安悪化によりWHO対応チームが避難を余儀なくされ、封じ込め活動の継続性に懸念が生じているため。
triage.notes: DRC・イトゥリ州における過去最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし）。治安悪化が対応活動を妨げており、ワクチン治験・Gaviの事前購入契約など国際支援の動きあり。

article.articleHeadline: Three civilians abducted in attack on Ebola screening centre in Morobo
article.articleSummary: Three civilians abducted after an armed attack on an Ebola screening centre in Morobo County, near the Democratic Republic of Congo border. The attack occurred the night between Sunday and Monday, with the centre vandalised; the whereabouts of the abductees are unknown. One abducted individual is described as a layman and aspiring priest/pastor. The attackers were suspected to be NAS rebels, according to Morobo County Commissioner Moro Isaac, who condemned the assault, warning that targeting health facilities endangers public safety and essential services. The Ebola screening centre is highlighted as critical for safeguarding communities across the Morobo border area. Isaac also cited ongoing security incidents, including abductions and shootings in the region, and called on armed groups to stop targeting civilians and infrastructure. A separate attempted abduction and shooting occurred in a neighbouring village on Tuesday evening.

article.articleHeadline: לאחר החשד למקרה אבולה בישראל: משרד הבריאון מעדכן
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following the suspected Ebola case in Israel: the Ministry of Health updates.
article.articleSummary: Israel's Ministry of Health announced that Ebola virus disease (EVD) tests for a patient hospitalized yesterday after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo were negative. There is no confirmed Ebola case in Israel at this time. Testing followed professional protocols and international guidelines for managing highly contagious diseases. The ministry emphasized that Ebola is not airborne and spreads via direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with contaminated blood, bodily fluids, or secretions. Authorities will continue to update the public and healthcare teams as needed and will provide further updates if the situation changes.

article.articleHeadline: Myrian Rios é internada após diagnóstico de Influenza A - Famosos & TV | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Myrian Rios is hospitalized after being diagnosed with Influenza A - Celebrities & TV | Portal do Holanda
article.articleSummary: 67-year-old actress Myrian Rios was hospitalized after a confirmed diagnosis of Influenza A. Symptoms started about a week earlier: sore throat, mild cough, and fatigue, worsening over days. In the early hours yesterday, she had a health crisis and sought medical care. Oxygen saturation levels were below expected and fluctuating, leading doctors to admit her for monitoring. She reassured fans and urged others with similar symptoms to seek medical help. The report does not provide lab specifics or treatment details, nor a hospital location. The update highlights precautionary inpatient observation given age and respiratory symptoms, and notes ongoing monitoring rather than a statement of full recovery.

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в Израиле - минздрав выступил с новым заявлением
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Israel - the Ministry of Health has issued a new statement.
article.articleSummary: Israel's Ministry of Health confirms no confirmed Ebola cases in the country after a patient hospitalized on return from the Democratic Republic of Congo for suspected Ebola tested negative in laboratory analyses conducted yesterday. The investigation followed international guidelines for high-consequence pathogens. There is no evidence of transmission in Israel; Ebola spreads by direct contact with blood, secretions, and other bodily fluids of a symptomatic infected person, not via airborne routes. The incubation period ranges from two to 21 days. Israelis returning from the DRC are advised to monitor their health for three weeks after travel and to seek medical advice if fever or other unusual symptoms develop, limiting contact with others and calling the Ministry of Health at 5400. Earlier reports noted a Tel Aviv hospital isolation of a suspected case at Ichilov Medical Center and warnings about potential importation from Africa.

triage.triage_reason: イスラエルで検疫された疑い患者は検査陰性と確定しており、エボラ感染の実際の発生は確認されていない。DRCでの流行自体への新規情報もないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Moradores de Cascavel recebem orientação sobre os "baldinhos" contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of Cascavel receive guidance on the 'buckets' to fight dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, Cascavel in western Paraná, Brazil, is deploying the Wolbachia method to fight dengue, with 6,073 Egg Release Devices (DLOs) across 17 neighborhoods, aiming to protect 215,318 people. The devices release Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti (Wolbitos) and are monitored by ovitrampas. If a DLO is displaced, residents should return it to its installed point or report to the Municipal Health Secretariat. The 17 neighborhoods are Brasmadeira, Cancelli, Centro, Floresta, Guarujá, Morumbi, Periolo, XIV de Novembro, Santa Felicidade, Interlagos, Esmeralda, Alto Alegre, Brasília, São Cristóvão, Cataratas, Cascavel Velho, Universitário. Wolbachia is a supplementary measure against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya; continued elimination of standing water, use of repellents, and installation of screens remain essential. In Niterói, RJ, Wolbachia reduced dengue by 89%. For reporting issues, contact (45) 3902-1343 or WhatsApp (45) 9113-0867.

triage.headline_ja: カスカベル市民、デング熱対策の『バルジーニョ(小型装置)』について説明を受ける

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : MSF amorce le transfert de la gestion du centre de traitement de Mongbwalu au ministère de la santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: MSF begins transferring the management of the Mongbwalu treatment center to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: MSF announced on 25 November 2026 the progressive transfer of management of the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) in Mongbwalu, Djugu district, Ituri province, to the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Public Health, with the transition effective 30 November. The 20-bed facility will maintain 10 beds for suspected cases and 10 for confirmed cases, as MSF seeks greater local/national ownership while redeploying resources to other urgent needs. The move does not mark the end of the outbreak; MDs warn that transmission persists with confirmed cases and deaths in Ituri, and that surveillance, testing, and access to care remain limited in some areas. Insecurity in Djugu, including clashes between FARDC and CRP, disrupts movement and humanitarian access. MSF remains engaged in the response elsewhere, supporting authorities and partners to meet affected communities’ needs.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ出血熱：MSFがモングバルの治療センターの運営を保健省へ移管開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、確定症例・死亡例が継続して報告されており、治安悪化によりサーベイランス・医療アクセスが制限されている。エボラはIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で高リスクに該当する。
triage.notes: MSFが治療センター運営を保健省に移管する一方、現地では伝播継続・死亡例報告あり、治安悪化（FARDCとCRPの衝突）により人道アクセスが制限されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Com proximidade do verão, Saúde de Maceió reforça orientações de prevenção contra o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With summer approaching, Maceió Health Department reinforces guidelines for preventing Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, the Maceió Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS) warns that with summer approaching, high temperatures and rainfall will boost Aedes aegypti, the mosquito transmitting dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. To curb transmission, SMS emphasizes preventive measures: regularly inspect indoor and outdoor areas to remove items that collect standing water, including plant pots, fridge trays, gutters, drains, open water tanks, bottles, and tires. Keep drains properly sealed; close toilets in rarely used areas; ensure water tanks are securely covered. Even small containers holding water can become breeding sites. Daniel Tomás Souza notes these simple, daily precautions as essential to interrupt the vector's life cycle. Dengue vaccination is available for people aged 10–14 at all city health units, but is supplementary and does not replace vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の到来を前に、マセイオ市保健局がネッタイシマカ対策の注意喚起を強化
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染者数や流行拡大の報告はなく、季節性の予防啓発に関する日常的な行政発表であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱を媒介するネッタイシマカへの季節的な予防策を呼びかける行政広報であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Jacareí realiza ações de combate à dengue nesta semana; veja cronograma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jacareí carries out dengue control actions this week; see the schedule.
article.articleSummary: Jacareí, Brazil conducts dengue control actions this week targeting the Aedes aegypti mosquito to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. The program spans multiple neighborhoods (including Jardim São Luís, Terras de Santa Helena, Jardim Elza Maria, Residencial São Paulo, Jardim Paulistano, Santa Cruz dos Lázaros, Jardim Leblon, and central areas) with house-to-house visits by Endemic Disease Control Agents, Cata-Treco bulky-waste removal, and targeted nebulization in locations with confirmed or suspected cases. On Saturday, November 28, a Dia D awareness event takes place at Mercadão Municipal from 9:00 to 13:00. Dengue vaccination is available for youths aged 10–14 at 19 health units. Citizens can report suspected breeding sites via 156, the online Atende Bem, or in person at Praça dos Três Poderes 73; verify entry with Vigilância em Saúde at (12) 3955-9623.

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo encerra surto de sarampo após 12 semanas sem casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Ends Measles Outbreak After 12 Weeks Without Cases.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak ends in São Paulo state after 12 weeks with no linked transmissions; last confirmed case had symptoms on August 28, 2026. In 2026, 41 cases were reported: 37 in São Paulo city (the capital), 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André; all patients recovered. Surveillance continues with case investigations and contact tracing. First-dose vaccination coverage (measles-containing triple vaccine) reached 96.90% statewide in September, above the 95% target, while second-dose coverage was 84.85%. The vaccine is free at Basic Health Units; schedule: first dose at 12 months, second dose at 15 months; ages 15 months–29 years should have two doses 30 days apart; ages 30–59 should have at least one dose; health workers require two doses. Rio Grande do Sul reports no measles circulation in 2026, with imported cases in 2024 (a child traveling to Asia) and 2025 (a travel-associated adult to the US) but no transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、12週間新規感染なしで麻疹流行の終息を宣言

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: The Ebola test results for the patient admitted to the hospital yesterday were negative.
article.articleSummary: An imported suspected Ebola case in Israel tested negative. As of 25 November 2026, the Health Ministry announced that Ebola tests for a patient admitted yesterday after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo were negative. No confirmed Ebola case has been diagnosed in Israel. Tests were carried out under professional procedures and internationally accepted guidelines for handling high-risk infectious diseases. Ebola is not transmitted through the air; infection occurs via direct contact with a symptomatic patient or through contact with their blood, body fluids, or secretions. The Ministry will continue to inform the public and healthcare workers about updates as needed and to monitor for any new cases linked to travel from Congo. The report emphasizes vigilance and that active transmission is not occurring domestically at this time.
