article.articleHeadline: যে কৌশলে ডেঙ্গু প্রতিরোধে সফল ব্রাজিলের বিজ্ঞানীরা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The approach Brazil's scientists used to successfully prevent dengue.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian scientists conducted a successful dengue-control trial in Belo Horizonte, southeastern Brazil, by releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes to block virus transmission. The 2020–2024 study, involving Emory, Yale, Brazil’s health ministry, and the U.S. NIH, released millions of Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes and screened about 5,700 children for dengue symptoms. In communities with Wolbachia mosquitoes, dengue positivity fell to 4% versus 14% in controls, translating to a 68.5% reduction in dengue and a 73.3% reduction in chikungunya infections. Wolbachia, a natural bacterium, impedes replication of dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever viruses in Aedes aegypti. Belo Horizonte faced its history’s worst dengue outbreak, underscoring the approach’s impact. Results were presented at an ASTMH conference in Maryland. The World Mosquito Program reports roughly 92% dengue reduction across nearly 1 million people in Aburrá Valley (Colombia) and Niterói (Brazil); Singapore has used a similar male-mosquito Wolbachia release since 2016. The long-term aim is a permanent local Wolbachia-carrying mosquito population, aided by releases and distributing eggs in food packaging to promote spread.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの科学者がデング熱予防に成功した戦略
triage.triage_reason: デング熱対策の研究成果・科学的進展を報じる内容であり、新たな発生・異常事態・公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はWolbachia感染蚊を用いたデング熱対策研究（2020-2024年、ベロオリゾンテ）の成果報告であり、流行拡大や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。過去の『史上最悪のデング流行』への言及はあるが、現在進行中のイベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, oltre 11.700 casi e 5.800 morti: nuovo piano internazionale e accelerazione sui vaccini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 11,700 cases and 5,800 deaths; new international plan and acceleration of vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 11,762 confirmed cases and 5,775 deaths as of 20 November, CFR 49.1%; 720 new infections and 388 deaths since 9 November. WHO Director‑General Tedros kept the Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Surveillance gaps persist: only 1,146 of 10,659 confirmed cases were in contact monitoring (11%). Reuters satellite estimates suggest more than 1,000 excess deaths in Bunia, Ituri, early November, though attribution to Ebola remains uncertain. A continental plan from WHO and Africa CDC outlines 15 pillars over six months, with funding of about $1.576 billion through May 2027. DR Congo expanded treatment/isolation to >2,000 beds; safe burial teams to 114; laboratories to 30; testing capacity >5,000 tests/day; >60,000 samples analyzed. Gavi signed an advance purchase for ChAdOx1 BDBV with Serum Institute/Life Sciences for up to 1.5 million doses; regulatory steps urged; Ervebo stockpile doses allocated; efficacy against Bundibugyo unproven.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：感染者11,700人超・死者5,800人超 ― 新国際計画とワクチン対応の加速
triage.triage_reason: WHOによりPHEICが維持されている大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行であり、致死率約49%、国際的な資金拠出・ワクチン対応が進行中でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを維持しており、監視体制の不備（接触者追跡率11%）やブニア周辺での超過死亡（Ebola起因は未確定）など懸念材料あり。新規ワクチン調達や国際的資金計画が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Evacuates Ebola Response Team From DR Congo Hospital As Fighting Intensifies
article.articleSummary: WHO evacuated its Ebola response team from the Akwe hospital in Ituri Province, DR Congo, as intensified fighting forced staff to shelter for more than three days. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said personnel from WHO, the DRC Health Ministry and partners were evacuated under challenging security conditions, with relocation continuing until the situation improves. Ituri is at the center of DR Congo’s worst-ever Ebola outbreak, which has recorded 11,762 cases and 5,775 deaths. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccines or treatments exist; two candidates—ChAdOx1 (Oxford/Serum Institute of India) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna)—are entering clinical trials in Ituri. Gavi announced an advance purchase commitment to secure up to 1.5 million doses of ChAdOx1 should trials prove successful and regulatory approval follow. The incident underscores challenges of responding to concurrent conflict and disease.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、戦闘激化によりDRCの病院からエボラ対応チームを避難
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行（11,762症例、5,775死亡）が継続中で、治安悪化によりWHO対応チームが避難するなど公衆衛生対応に重大な支障が生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、治安悪化が対応をさらに困難にしている。Gaviによるワクチン事前購入確約など国際支援の動きあり。続報でワクチン臨床試験・治安状況の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: "Ressurgimento da epidemia": após queda histórica, novas infecções de HIV podem voltar a crescer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Resurgence of the Epidemic": After a historic decline, new HIV infections may rise again.
article.articleSummary: UNAIDS warns of a potential HIV/AIDS resurgence amid sharp cuts in international funding and rights-restrictive campaigns eroding prevention and treatment services. Global 2025 HIV infections reached 1.2 million, down 42.9% since 2010, but reduced testing, prevention outreach, and treatment initiation threaten higher transmission and AIDS-related morbidity and mortality. Winnie Byanyima warned of a likely reversal by 2027, with some regions already seeing increases; elimination of HIV transmission by 2030 remains off track, as 2025 targets implied 200,000 infections annually, yet actual figures are higher. Regional rises include Latin America (+25% since 2010), Eastern Europe & Central Asia (+17%), and North & East Africa (+78%). Brazil is among 21 countries with >20% rise since 2010; 2024 new cases were 39,200, and ~1.7 million Brazilians live with HIV. Globally ~40 million people live with HIV. PrEP use declined sharply, with only 2.6 million of the >20 million needing PrEP having access in 2025; Brazil’s PrEP uptake grew 32% (SUS since 2018).

triage.headline_ja: 「エピデミックの再燃」：歴史的減少の後、HIV新規感染が再び増加する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 国際資金削減とPrEP普及率低下によりHIV感染再拡大のリスクが指摘されており、長期的曝露・流行しやすさ・外部支援の必要性というWPRO基準に該当し、社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事はUNAIDSによるグローバルなHIV動向報告であり、ブラジルは新規感染増加国の一例として具体的データ（2024年新規感染39,200件、約170万人がHIVと共に生活）が示されている。急性のアウトブレイクではなく政策・資金動向に関する中長期的リスク情報であるため、フルRRAの要否は続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Londrina registra alta de testes positivos para Covid-19 em novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Londrina records an increase in positive COVID-19 tests in November.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Londrina, Brazil, shows a sharp increase in positive test results in November. Data from the Municipal Health Secretariat show 250 positive results by November 16, up from 52 in October, about a 380% rise. October logged 354 disease-related notifications with 52 positives (≈14.7% positivity). In the first 16 days of November, 351 notifications yielded 250 positives (≈71.2%). Despite similar notification counts, the share of positives is far higher in November's early period. Health authorities advise residents with respiratory symptoms to seek care at a Basic Health Unit (UBS); mask-wearing is recommended for symptomatic individuals to reduce transmission. Vaccination remains a key protective measure, especially for the elderly, pregnant individuals, children, and people with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナ市、11月にCOVID-19陽性検査が急増
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市での陽性率上昇報告であり、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はないが、COVID-19の流行性を考慮し経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの統計報告であり、重症度（入院・死亡）の情報が欠如しているため、フルRRAへの移行は現時点では不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose: doença transmitida por gatos já infectou mais de mil pessoas no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis: a cat-transmitted disease has infected more than a thousand people in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reports 1,465 human cases of sporotrichosis in 2026, concentrated in the Porto Alegre metropolitan area. Canoas leads with 156 cases, followed by Porto Alegre (142) and Alvorada (119). Across the state, 1,051 notifications are under investigation and 243 have been discarded; 2025 saw 1,960 confirmed human cases. In Guaíba, a cat outbreak prompted an emergency plan, with 338 animal cases and 25 human cases recorded; surveillance, prevention, and control measures were implemented, including a triage protocol at the zoonosis control unit. statewide, 2,510 animal notifications were logged in 2026. Sporotrichosis is caused by Sporothrix fungi found in soil, plants, and organic matter; in humans, skin lesions and possible nasal mucosa involvement can occur, while cats commonly present facial, ear, and paw lesions. Prevention emphasizes diagnosis, treatment, neutering, indoor containment, PPE, and cautious handling of soil and animals.

triage.headline_ja: スポロトリコーシス：猫媒介性疾患がリオグランデ・ド・スル州で1000人以上に感染
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部で猫媒介性真菌症（スポロトリコーシス）の症例数が多いが、同州では例年発生している既知の風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、継続監視とする。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスはリオグランデ・ド・スル州で毎年報告される風土病的人獣共通感染症であり、2025年には1960例、2026年は1465例（調査中含む）報告。重症度は主に皮膚病変で低く、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは限定的。地方自治体レベルでの対応（緊急計画、監視強化）が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'insécurité à Djugu compromet la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Insecurity in Djugu undermines the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of November 25, 2026, security concerns in Djugu, Ituri, in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, are undermining the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response across all pillars. Public-health specialist Dr. Ular Mananu warns that epidemiological surveillance teams cannot access some zones to monitor virus circulation; contact tracing is hampered, delaying identification of exposed individuals. Screening and sampling are impeded by limited access and challenges transporting specimens to laboratories. Case management is further affected as patients who test positive cannot be safely transferred to treatment centers when facilities are near fighting. The statement highlights how insecurity around Djugu disrupts detection, isolation, and care, risking continued transmission. The report provides no specific case counts or laboratory-confirmed data.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：ジュグでの治安悪化がエボラ対応を妨げている - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州ジュグでエボラ出血熱の対応が治安悪化により妨げられており、感染追跡・検体輸送・患者搬送が困難化し、感染拡大リスクが高まっているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数や検査確定データを示していないが、既知のエボラ流行地域における治安悪化が対応能力を著しく損なっている状況を報告している。続報での症例数・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Satellites, One Health and the fight against climate-sensitive diseases
article.articleSummary: Satellite-based Earth observation, integrated with One Health, enables early detection and proactive response to climate-sensitive diseases. As climate variability, urbanisation, land-use change and globalisation reshape ecosystems, warning signals such as warming coastal waters, heavy rainfall, standing water and smoke can be detected from orbit weeks to months before illness. Waterborne diseases—cholera, cryptosporidiosis, and HAB-related illnesses—are linked to rainfall, turbidity, and water temperature; Bangladesh coastal regions and drinking-water supplies are highlighted with MODIS ocean color and sea-surface temperature, with HABs monitored by Sentinel-2. Vector-borne diseases—malaria, dengue, Zika, West Nile—are influenced by temperature and moisture; Landsat, Sentinel-2 and GPM map habitats and predict risk, with malaria control in Myanmar and West Nile forecasts in the U.S. Airborne threats from wildfire smoke and dust storms are tracked by TROPOMI, MODIS, VIIRS, aiding public health in North America and Australia. Future risk maps and AI-enhanced forecasts will strengthen preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 衛星技術、ワンヘルス、そして気候感受性疾患との闘い
triage.triage_reason: 特定の急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、衛星観測技術と気候変動感受性疾患の予測・監視手法に関する一般的な技術解説記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、衛星データを用いた疾病予測・監視技術の紹介が主題。ミャンマーのマラリア対策とバングラデシュの水系感染症監視が事例として言及されているが、いずれも具体的なアウトブレイク報告ではない。米国・オーストラリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congress, CPI criticise Puducherry government over failure to control dengue cases
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Puducherry draws political fire as Congress and CPI criticize the AINRC-BJP government over its response. On 25 November 2026, former Chief Minister and Congress leader V. Narayanasamy accused the government of lethargy and failure to implement precautionary measures, noting four dengue deaths so far and warning that proper fever testing in rural areas is lacking, potentially underestimating cases. He faulted Chief Minister N. Rangasamy, who also heads the Health portfolio, for hospitals’ unpreparedness to handle the surge. The CPI’s A.M. Saleem said the deceased were all young, with delays in diagnosis and insufficient treatment cited. He urged the Health Department to act and stock adequate medicines to manage dengue. The criticism highlights gaps in testing, diagnosis, and supply chains amid the ongoing dengue cases in Puducherry.

triage.headline_ja: コングレス党とCPIがプドゥチェリー政府のデング熱対策失敗を批判
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による死亡者が発生し、検査・診断・医薬品供給の不備が政治問題化するなど社会的関心が高く、WPRO基準の重症度・感染拡大しやすさに該当するため。
triage.notes: プドゥチェリー（インド）における季節性デング熱流行で、死亡4例と医療体制の不備が政治的批判を招いている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo declara fim do surto de Sarampo na capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo declares end of the measles outbreak in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state is declared over after three months with no new cases, with transmission considered ended. The last notification occurred on August 28. A total of 41 measles cases were confirmed in São Paulo state in 2026, of which 37 were in the capital city. All individuals diagnosed recovered. Nationwide, Brazil reported 70 measles cases in 2026, all imported or linked to infections acquired outside the country. The decision follows the surveillance protocol that marks the outbreak as closed after three months without new cases. The Secretaria Estadual da Saúde states vaccination is the primary protective measure, and the Ministério da Saúde continues to monitor the situation across the country. The outbreak's status underscores vaccination as the main protection and ongoing national monitoring by the Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、州都における麻疹アウトブレイクの終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: アウトブレイクは既に終息が宣言されており、全例回復、新規感染拡大の懸念もないため、フルRRAの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はアウトブレイク終息の報告であり、新規発生や拡大のリスクは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : une école suspend les activités scolaires pendant 21 jours - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: a school suspends classes for 21 days - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 25 November 2026, in Kisangani, Tshopo, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a Catholic-affiliated school, Institut Kalindula, suspended classes for 21 days following the death of an Ebola case—a secretary at the school. The suspension, decided by health authorities about a week earlier and agreed with the provincial Ministries of Education and Health, aims to allow the response team to decontaminate the school and to trace and monitor contacts. Parents were asked to keep children home during the period and to report any suspicious signs to nearby health facilities or to the medical teams mobilized for the Ebola response. The decision comes after earlier verbal announcements by RTNC and certain online media, which caused hesitation by the school's prefect until official notification was issued.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州のエボラ出血熱：ある学校が21日間授業を停止 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるコンゴ民主共和国での死亡例確認と学校閉鎖措置があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 致命的なエボラ症例が確認され、濃厚接触者調査・学校消毒等の対応が進行中。感染拡大や支援要請の有無については続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: GAVI and SII: Vaccine deal signed for Ebola outbreak response
article.articleSummary: GAVI and Serum Institute of India (SII) have signed a vaccine deal to bolster response to the current Ebola outbreak. The outbreak has so far reported more than 11,600 cases and over 5,700 deaths, most in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). It is driven by a rare Bundibugyo species of Ebolavirus, for which no vaccine is available yet. ChAdOx1 BDBV is one of two Bundibugyo vaccine candidates WHO has recommended for clinical testing in the ongoing outbreak. If the candidate secures regulatory approvals and WHO SAGE policy guidance, Gavi's advance purchase commitment would enable rapid distribution of doses to affected populations. SII has manufactured the drug substance for more than half a million doses to enable rapid access. The vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, was developed by the Oxford Vaccine Group with support from global health partners and uses the same viral vector platform as the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: GAVIとSII、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応のためのワクチン供給契約に署名
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（まれなブンディブギョ種）アウトブレイクが11,600例超・死亡5,700例超と深刻化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン供給契約に関する内容だが、背景として11,600例超・死亡5,700例超という深刻なコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ種）アウトブレイクが継続中であることを示す。インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Governo do Maranhão orienta profissionais sobre notificação da Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maranhão State Government guides professionals on Mpox reporting.
article.articleSummary: Maranhão State Government, via the SES, held the web seminar Mpox - Notification on 24 November 2026 to improve identification and rapid registration of suspected Mpox cases. The virtual event brought ambulatory and hospital care teams, Epidemiological Surveillance, Primary Health Care, Hospital Epidemiology cores, and laboratories. It covered laboratory confirmation and discard criteria, immediate notification in e-SUS Sinan, definitions of suspected and probable cases, and timely closure of notifications with patient monitoring to outcome. Karina Braga emphasized that prompt reporting enables surveillance from suspicion to resolution. Epidemiological update: by November 2026, Maranhão recorded 33 Mpox notifications; 8 confirmed, 8 under investigation, 17 discarded; no deaths. Confirmed cases are male, aged 30–40, residents of São Luís and São José de Ribamar, with multiple sexual partners. Control actions include immediate compulsory notification, contact tracing, diagnostic timing, genomic surveillance, and continuous monitoring; isolation and vaccination of priority groups. Public guidance: seek care for skin/mucosal lesions, fever, or swollen lymph nodes and isolate at home.

triage.headline_ja: マラニョン州政府、Mpox届け出に関する専門職向け説明会を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マラニョン州でMpoxの届け出体制強化のための研修が行われたという行政的な内容であり、現時点では確定8例・死亡0例と重症度は低いが、性的接触によるヒト-ヒト感染が継続している点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生の報告ではなく、既存のMpoxサーベイランス強化のための行政研修に関する内容。確定例は性的接触を介した感染であり、クラスターとしての継続監視は必要だが、重症度・規模ともに限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Escola e AABB passam por desinfecção após surto de sarna em Divinópolis - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School and AABB undergo disinfection after scabies outbreak in Divinópolis - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil reports a human scabies outbreak centered at Escola Municipal Sidney José de Oliveira and the Associação Atlética Banco do Brasil (AABB). As of November 25, 2026, 15 cases have been confirmed, with more than 40 under investigation. Municipal cleaning by Emop occurred in the morning, followed by Health Surveillance disinfecting the premises; activities at the two sites were suspended on November 25 to enable sanitation and protective measures for students and staff. An intersectoral committee chaired by Mayor Janete Aparecida, including Health, Education, Social Development, Prosecution, and Communications, conducts daily monitoring to coordinate response and ensure transparency. Families are advised not to send children with symptoms of scabies or COVID-19 to school and to seek assessment and treatment at the nearest health unit. The City will provide daily updates on the situation.

triage.headline_ja: ジヴィノーポリスで疥癬の集団発生後、学校とAABBが消毒作業を実施
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬（Scabies）はヒト-ヒト接触で感染しやすく学校施設での集団発生が確認されているが、重症度・国際的拡大の懸念は低く、地域行政が主体的に対応しているため、フルRRAには進まず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症化や死亡例がない局所的な皮膚疾患であり、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態としての懸念は低い。市当局（市長主導の委員会）が消毒・監視・治療勧告を迅速に実施しており、現時点では地域内で管理可能と判断される。続報（COVID-19併発や感染拡大の有無）に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: GHS Director-General urges port health staff to uphold integrity in Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service Director-General Dr. Samuel Kaba Akoriyea urged Port Health staff to uphold professionalism, integrity and vigilance in Ebola preparedness during a two-day infection prevention and care training at Accra International Airport on 24 November 2026. Staff from Accra International Airport and Tema Port attended to strengthen their capacity to detect and respond to potential Ebola cases at points of entry. Akoriyea cautioned against bribery and misconduct that could undermine public confidence, noting Port Health personnel are the country’s first line of contact for travelers and must be equipped to identify health risks. He urged teamwork, knowledge sharing and full use of the training, and highlighted the availability of clinical psychologist support to help staff cope with job pressures. The GHS aims to bolster port readiness to protect public health from emerging infectious threats.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健サービス長官、港湾衛生職員にエボラ対策における誠実性の保持を要請
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ症例発生の報告ではなく、空港・港湾における予防訓練・意識啓発に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ発生事例ではなく、ガーナ保健当局による港湾健康スタッフ向けのエボラ対応訓練・意識啓発活動に関する内容。症例報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kwilu : Lancement d'une campagne contre la peste de petits ruminants à Gungu - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwilu: Launch of a campaign against small ruminant plague in Gungu - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Small ruminant plague (peste des petits ruminants, PPR) vaccination campaign launched in Gungu, Kwilu province, southwestern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The National Agricultural Development Program (PNDA) via its Technical Operator unit kicked off a 20-day drive targeting the sectors of Gungu, Lukamba, Kilamba and Mungindu to vaccinate goats and sheep, aiming to eradicate the disease and safeguard livelihoods that rely on livestock for schooling, healthcare, and other needs. The effort is led by Gumanda Makanda, territorial livestock and fishing inspector. The initiative highlights that PPR can also affect humans, especially children. In line with President Tshisekedi's vision and the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock, the campaign includes collaboration with Veterinaires Sans Frontieres (VSF) Belgium, which will supply a new European-origin stock of roosters and bucks for crossbreeding to diversify and improve livestock. Population urged to bring animals for vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: クウィル州：グング地区で小反芻獣疫（PPR）対策ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（ヤギ・ヒツジ）を対象とした予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始報告であり、実際の疾病流行や人への感染症例の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はPPR（家畜の疾病）に対する予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始を報じるもので、実際のアウトブレイクや人への感染例は報告されていない。人への影響の可能性に言及があるが具体的症例データはなし。VSFベルギーとの協力による家畜改良事業も含まれる通常の獣医学的活動。

article.articleHeadline: Alta na positividade da Covid no ES acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19 positivity in Espírito Santo raises alarm.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 has reached the highest positivity rate of 2026 in Espírito Santo, Brazil, with about 32% of tests positive in the latest week (Jan 4–Nov 21). Lacen-ES reports 1,296 COVID-19 positives this year, including 303 cases among people 61+ (23.4%). Positivity has risen in recent weeks, alongside higher testing volume. A pneumologist warns the virus still circulates and poses risks even for the vaccinated or previously infected, including possible reinfection. Symptoms include cough, fever, sore throat, congestion, body aches, and fatigue, but these overlap with other respiratory infections. Red flags—shortness of breath, chest pain, worsening symptoms, or declining oxygen saturation—require immediate medical evaluation. With year-end gatherings, authorities urge vaccination per the Ministry of Health, testing for respiratory symptoms, masking for symptomatic individuals, and avoiding close contact with the elderly and immunocompromised.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリトサント州でCOVID-19陽性率上昇、警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19陽性率の季節的上昇を報じる通常の公衆衛生情報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、国際的関心や緊急対応の必要性も認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。既知の病原体(COVID-19)による季節的な感染拡大であり、新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சலுக்கு பள்ளி மாணவி பலி: தொடரும் உயிரிழப்புகளால் பொதுமக்கள் அச்சம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Schoolgirl dies of dengue fever: Public fear as dengue deaths continue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever has claimed three lives in Puducherry this month as transmission rises. Nishitha, 16, daughter of Mahesh and Kavitha from Noanankuppam, contracted dengue and died after blood tests at Puducherry Government Hospital confirmed the infection and she received intensive care. Earlier in the month, Mohammed Irfan, 22, of Anita Nagar, and Harini, 19, from the Moolakkulam-Pichavarampet area, also died from dengue after presenting with fever. The rising fatalities have sparked public fear and calls for intensified dengue prevention. Health authorities, led by the Health Secretary Kumar, held a meeting with the Director of Health and other officials to discuss containment measures and the establishment of special camps to curb the spread of dengue.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱で女子学生死亡：死亡者続出に住民不安
triage.triage_reason: プドゥチェリーでデング熱による死亡が複数発生し住民の不安が高まっており、保健当局も対策会議を開催するなど行政の関心も高いため、WPRO基準（重症度・流行継続性）と社会的関心の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド南部で季節性に流行する疾患であり、IHR上の『異常性』は低いが、複数の死亡例と住民の不安、行政の対応会議が確認されるためスクリーニング基準に該当。地域限定の流行として続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Urgence en RDC : les humanitaires fuient l'Ituri face aux combats et à Ebola, tandis que le Soudan saigne et Ramaphosa sauvé par la justice - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency in the DRC: humanitarian workers flee Ituri in the face of fighting and Ebola, while Sudan bleeds and Ramaphosa saved by the judiciary - Cameroun24.net news updates
article.articleSummary: In DR Congo’s Ituri province, Ebola response operations are disrupted as humanitarian workers are evacuated from Akwe and Mongbwalu to Bunia amid intensified fighting in Djugu. Since the outbreak began in May, the UN’s OCHA records about 170 attacks on Ebola responders and facilities, with more than 60 targeting aid groups; Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for over two-thirds of the more than 11,800 confirmed cases and 5,800 deaths. In the past week, over 30,000 people have fled the violence, hindering access and surveillance. In Sudan, air strikes and drone attacks killed at least 14 civilians and wounded 15 in Ed Damazin and Er Roseires, Blue Nile state; 28 women and girls were abducted, and 15 cases of sexual violence against minors were reported in three days. Zanzibar’s Nungwi coast suffered a major fire destroying six hotels, four restaurants and about 40 shops; 183 tourists were evacuated safely. South Africa’s Western Cape High Court voided the Phala Phala report, ending impeachment proceedings against President Ramaphosa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:緊急事態 ― イトゥリ州では戦闘とエボラ出血熱により人道支援従事者が撤退、スーダンは流血、ラマポーザ大統領は司法判断により救済
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で確認症例11,800超・死亡5,800超という大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、武力紛争により対応要員・施設への攻撃（約170件）が発生し人道アクセスが妨げられている。公衆衛生上深刻かつ対応能力に懸念があるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州のエボラ流行と武力紛争による対応中断を主題としている。スーダン（Blue Nile州の空爆）、タンザニア（ザンジバルの火災）、南アフリカ（大統領弾劾関連の司法判断）は同一記事内の別イベントであり、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。30,000人が避難民化し監視・対応能力が著しく低下している点は国際的拡大リスクを示唆するが、周辺国への越境拡大は明記されていないため travel_trade_restriction は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Avanço da mpox em São Paulo preocupa população LGBTQIA+ e expõe vulnerabilidade de pessoas em situação de rua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of mpox in São Paulo concerns the LGBTQIA+ population and exposes the vulnerability of people experiencing homelessness.
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreak intensifies in São Paulo, Brazil, with the state recording 533 cases in 2026, leading national figures. Nationwide, Brazil documented 627 mpox cases in November (as of November 23), up 103.6% vs October. São Paulo has begun distributing 1,000 vaccine doses, 600 of which go to the capital; the Ministry of Health also secured 25,000 more doses to bolster inventories. Activist Heitor Werneck highlights the compounded vulnerability of people experiencing homelessness and LGBTQIA+ communities, stressing barriers to healthcare, information, food security, and housing as hampers to prevention and isolation. Vaccination prioritizes people living with HIV with immunosuppression, PrEP users, lab personnel exposed to the virus, and contacts at medium/high risk after health service evaluation. Mpox can affect anyone regardless of sexual orientation. Mpox spreads mainly through close contact and skin lesions, causing fever, muscle pain, malaise, and lesions; authorities urge widespread access, information, and dignified care.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでのmpox感染拡大、LGBTQIA+コミュニティに懸念、路上生活者の脆弱性が浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州を中心にmpox症例が前月比103.6%増と急増しており、ヒト-ヒト感染が継続する脆弱集団（ホームレス、LGBTQIA+）への影響と社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州における2026年のmpox症例急増（前月比103.6%増）とワクチン配布状況、脆弱集団（ホームレス、LGBTQIA+）への影響を報じている。重症度や死亡例、国際的拡大の具体的言及はないが、感染拡大の継続性と社会的関心の高さからPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Second 'shawarma' food poisoning outbreak in five months hits Bhiwandi; 78 hospitalised
article.articleSummary: 78 people hospitalised as of Wednesday in Bhiwandi, Thane district, after a suspected shawarma-linked food poisoning; 74 remain in Indira Gandhi Memorial Sub-District Hospital, with 2 discharged. The AK Shawarma stall in the Vanjarpatti area is implicated, with many cases from the same families (38 men, 22 women, 14 children). Two children are seriously ill and shifted to Thane Civil Hospital; a two-month-pregnant woman is among those affected. Initial symptoms include vomiting, diarrhoea and abdominal pain; vomit and stool samples have been sent for chemical and microbiological testing to confirm the cause. The stall was demolished by BNCMC; the vendor is untraceable. FDA inspections of other area establishments are underway amid concerns about street-hawker regulation and localised vending hubs. Police have registered a case against the AK Shawarma owner under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, with the owner on the run. This would be the second major shawarma-linked outbreak in five months, following a June Khadupada incident with over 100 ill.

triage.headline_ja: 5ヶ月で2度目のシャワルマ食中毒がビワンディを襲う、78人入院
triage.triage_reason: 局地的な食品由来の食中毒事案であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、5ヶ月で2度目の発生という再発パターンと原因物質（検査中）が未確定であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事案は細菌性食中毒（シャワルマ関連）であり、病原体によるヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはない。地元FDA・警察が対応中で、検体の検査結果待ち。5ヶ月以内に同様の事案（6月のKhadupada、100人以上罹患）が発生しており、屋台衛生管理の構造的問題を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Российские ученые выяснили, где зародилась чума
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian scientists have determined where the plague originated.
article.articleSummary: Russian researchers from the A. N. Severtsov Institute of Ecology and Evolution, Russian Academy of Sciences, trace the origin of Yersinia pestis (plague) to mutations of another microbe in Mongolian tarbagan marmot blood. The direct precursors were Yersinia pseudotuberculosis, the agent of intestinal pseudotuberculosis. Lead author Viktor Suntov notes that expanding tarbagan populations across their historic range—in Mongolia, China, parts of Russia (Buryatia, Zabaykalsky Krai) and Central Asia—set the stage for cross-species adaptation. The flea Oropsylla silantiewi, the tarbagan’s most common parasite, played a crucial role. During the Sartan cold spell, flea larvae living in burrows moved to new hosts, entering through ears, noses, mouths and even anuses, delivering bacteria into blood. In the new environment, the bacteria mutated into the plague bacillus, which then spread via fleas to other animals, and subsequently to humans and rats, fueling historical epidemics in Asia, Europe and North Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの科学者たちがペストの起源を解明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペスト菌の起源に関する歴史的・進化生物学的研究の報告であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）の進化的起源に関する学術研究であり、現在の症例発生や公衆衛生イベントについての報告ではない。発生地域として挙げられている国（モンゴル、ロシア、中国）は歴史的・地理的文脈での言及であり、対象国リストのChinaも現行イベントの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases surge; 9 deaths recorded
article.articleSummary: 1,289 dengue infections and nine confirmed deaths in Mandaue City, Cebu Province, Philippines, as of Nov. 23, 2026; one death remains under investigation. The 2026 tally more than doubles 2025’s 520 cases and three deaths. The City Health Office (CHO) reports hospital strain, with Mandaue City Hospital operating as a Level 1 infirmary (25 beds) and providing 24/7 service, referring severe cases to larger facilities. Dengue fast-lane services are available at barangay health centers, satellite OPD clinics, and the hospital. BHERTs assist patient transport; OpCen coordinates referrals. CHO urges fever assessment on day one and close home monitoring for mild cases; warning signs—persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, lethargy/restlessness—mandate hospital care. Emphasis on sustained 4S prevention (search/destroy breeding sites) and the 4 o'clock habit, plus DepEd collaboration and school interventions.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例が急増、9人の死亡が確認される
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ州マンダウエ市でデング症例が前年比倍増（1,289件、死亡9件）し、病院機能にも負荷がかかっており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 季節性・地域的なデング熱の急増事例。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、前年比の大幅増加と医療体制への負荷が確認されるため経過を含めフルRRAでの確認を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Families say they cannot locate bodies of relatives in Ebola-hit Congo city
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, ongoing as of 25 November 2026. Beni has seen the most new Ebola cases since early November, about one-fifth of infections in that period; more than 1,000 infections and around 650 deaths in the city since the outbreak began in May. Dozens of residents cannot locate relatives’ bodies at the main hospital morgue, and some say loved ones have been buried without their knowledge. Burial teams, usually Red Cross, handle the dead to reduce transmission. Families report being asked to provide coffins, and in some cases told that bodies had already been transferred to the morgue or buried, with records not clearly confirming. Bodies are decomposing, hindering locating efforts. The incidents deepen mistrust of health facilities amid an outbreak in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ(エボラ被害)都市で家族が親族の遺体を見つけられないと訴え
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州ベニで5月以降1,000例超・死亡650人規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、遺体管理を巡る住民の不信感も深刻化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は遺体の所在不明や埋葬への不信感に焦点を当てているが、背景にはベニでの大規模エボラ流行（5月以降1,000例超、死亡約650人）があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と地域内拡大リスクが示唆される。渡航・貿易制限の有無については記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry urges vigilance against new COVID-19 variant
article.articleSummary: On 24 November, the Ministry of Health urged vigilance against COVID-19 after a SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 was designated by the WHO as a variant under monitoring. The WHO assessment as of 19 November noted PJ.2.1’s rising share in sequencing samples in some countries, but there is no evidence of greater severity or transmissibility. Global risk is low. The MOH’s Preventive Medicines department warned that winter-spring conditions, along with increased travel and gatherings around year-end and the Lunar New Year, could raise respiratory infection risk, especially in enclosed, crowded, poorly ventilated spaces. High-risk groups include older adults, pregnant women, those with underlying conditions or immunosuppression. Precautions: wear masks in healthcare facilities, on public transport, and in crowded venues; practice hand hygiene and ventilation; seek medical advice for fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, or fatigue; seek urgent care for shortness of breath, chest pain, altered consciousness, or worsening symptoms. Routine surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、新型COVID-19変異株への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下変異株に指定したPJ.2.1について注意喚起しているが、重症度・感染力の増加の証拠はなく、WHOのグローバルリスクも低いと評価されている。情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: WHOはPJ.2.1について重症度・感染性の増加の証拠なしとしており、ベトナム保健省は季節的・年末年始の人流増加に伴う一般的な呼吸器感染症対策を呼びかけているに過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: CPI(M) urges Tiruppur administration to conduct special medical camps to control dengue
article.articleSummary: Two dengue-related deaths were reported in October in Dharapuram and Palladam, with rising fever and cough cases across October–November in Coimbatore, Tiruppur and Erode districts. CPI(M) has urged Tiruppur district administration to conduct special medical camps to curb dengue and to accelerate public-health actions, including cleaning drains, removing garbage, and intensified fumigation for mosquito control. The demand was raised at a party meeting chaired by K. Rangaraj and attended by K. Kamaraj. Separately, on November 25, the Tiruppur district administration instructed factories to maintain cleanliness and hygiene in work areas and workers’ quarters; stagnant water should be removed to prevent mosquito breeding; awareness programs should be stepped up; workers with flu-like symptoms should be referred immediately to government hospitals or PHCs for treatment. The article notes the spread of dengue and malaria and underscores urgent public-health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: CPI(M)、ティルプル行政当局にデング熱対策の特別医療キャンプ実施を要請
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州ティルプル地区等でデング熱関連死亡例が報告され、発熱・咳症例が増加しており、行政・政党双方が対策を講じている。ベクター媒介感染症としての拡大可能性と社会的関心の高さからピックアップ対象とする。
triage.notes: インド・タミルナードゥ州ティルプル、コインバトール、エロード地区における季節性デング熱・マラリアの地方的発生。死亡例2件報告だが規模は限定的で、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は認められない。地元行政による防疫対策（清掃・燻蒸等）が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Alertaron por una nueva variante de Covid y pidió reforzar la vacunación - Sin Mordaza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warned about a new COVID-19 variant and urged expansion of vaccination coverage.
article.articleSummary: A new Omicron-derived COVID-19 variant circulating in Argentina is highly contagious but generally mild in vaccinated individuals with no major risk factors. Three current hospitalizations include a 58-year-old man with multiple comorbidities and two children whose mothers were unvaccinated during pregnancy, leaving them without maternal antibodies. Infectious disease specialist Hugo Pizzi urges at-risk groups—diabetes, morbid obesity, chronic asthma, heart disease, and immunodeficiency—to maintain vaccination schedules; he advocates annual vaccination for fragile individuals and keeping up to influenza and pneumococcal immunizations, noting vaccines are free. Vaccines, including Argentina’s Arvac, remain protective against the new variant. Separately, dengue concerns loom as warm weather favors the Aedes vector; cases have appeared in several provinces, with travelers arriving from abroad. For Brazil travel, yellow fever is lifelong vaccinated; consider dengue vaccination and precaution with water, ice, and food. Immunocompromised persons should consult their doctor about dengue vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株について警告、ワクチン接種強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンで発生しているCOVID-19新変異株は軽症例が中心で、対象国（アルゼンチンは対象外、ブラジルは渡航情報の言及のみ）に該当する重大事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンにおけるCOVID-19新変異株とデング熱注意喚起であり、ブラジルは渡航者向け情報として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi logs over 1200 dengue, 390 malaria cases this year till date: MCD
article.articleSummary: Delhi’s MCD reports as of November 21, 2026: dengue 1,258 cases, malaria 398, and chikungunya 40, with zero deaths this year. In the week ending Nov 21, dengue 36 cases, malaria 12, chikungunya 0. November totals: dengue 175, malaria 43, chikungunya 1. Cumulatively, Delhi has had over 1,200 dengue and nearly 400 malaria cases, amid ongoing vector control measures. No disease-related fatalities have been reported in 2026. The report notes extensive outreach: over 3.9 crore house visits, spraying 42.3 lakh houses, and about 2.3 lakh houses showing mosquito breeding. Compliance actions include 1.5 lakh legal notices and more than 31,000 prosecutions. In the latest week, 9.6 lakh visits were conducted, 1.1 lakh houses sprayed, and roughly 1,100 notices issued. Public health measures continue to target mosquito breeding to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで今年に入り登録デング熱症例1200件超、マラリア390件：MCD
triage.triage_reason: 例年の季節性媒介蚊感染症の統計報告であり、死亡者なし・既存の対策が継続中であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 死亡例ゼロで、既存の媒介蚊対策（散布・訪問・法的措置）が通常業務として報告されている定例統計記事。

article.articleHeadline: Mina do Ibirá é interditada temporariamente em Pouso Alegre após laudo apontar presença de bactéria na água
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ibirá Mine is temporarily closed in Pouso Alegre after a report indicated the presence of bacteria in the water.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli detected in a water sample collected on 23 November 2026 at the Ibirá Mine, Rua João Pinto de Freitas 115, Nhá Chica, Pouso Alegre, in Southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, rendering the sample non-potable. Sanitary and Environmental Surveillance of Pouso Alegre temporarily closed the Ibirá Mine for cleaning and retesting under State Law 13.317/1999. The Municipal Laboratory Report No. 260601000385 confirmed E. coli presence, with results unsatisfactory against potability standards. The site will reopen only after cleaning, a new sampling, and issuance of a satisfactory report. Until then, the public is advised not to use or consume water from the mine for drinking, hygiene, or food preparation. Individuals experiencing diarrhea or vomiting should seek care at the nearest Basic Health Unit (UBS).

triage.headline_ja: イビラ鉱泉、水質検査でバクテリア検出のためポウゾ・アレグレで一時閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一水源での大腸菌検出による予防的閉鎖であり、症例報告や広範な公衆衛生への影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体が水源を予防的に閉鎖し再検査を実施する対応であり、人的被害の報告はない。Brazilは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベントの性質上国際的な懸念事項には該当しないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Miguel Huamán critica gestión sanitaria ante colapso de camas UCI por dengue: "Algo está fallando o la cabeza está dirigiendo mal"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miguel Huamán criticizes health management in the face of ICU bed collapse due to dengue: "Something is failing or the leadership is directing poorly."
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, Peru reports over 122,000 dengue cases and 117 deaths, with ICU capacity collapsing to zero beds. Miguel Huamán Cornejo, head of the Health Commission in the Chamber of Deputies, criticized the government’s dengue response and urged urgent measures, including declaring a sanitary emergency in Lima Metropolitan Area, Callao, Ancash, Lambayeque, La Libertad, and Piura. He backs an interpellation of Health Minister Luis Dyer over dengue preparedness and over a defective batch of serum imported from China. He criticized decentralization as disastrous due to medicine shortages and data gaps, urging streamlined direct purchases and fewer regional bureaucratic hurdles. Huamán also noted that the Ministry of Health leadership and Cenares executives did not attend a prior Health Commission session.

triage.headline_ja: ミゲル・ワマン議員、デング熱によるICU病床崩壊を受け保健行政を批判：「何かが失敗しているか、指導部の采配が悪い」
triage.triage_reason: 深刻なデング熱流行とICU病床崩壊が報告されているが、発生国はペルーであり、CEPR監視対象国リストに含まれないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はペルーにおけるデング熱流行とICU崩壊、中国製血清の不良ロット問題を扱っているが、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。中国は血清の輸入元として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ viêm phổi ở trẻ nhiễm virus RSV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Risk of pneumonia in children infected with RSV.
article.articleSummary: RSV infection caused pneumonia in an infant in Hanoi, Vietnam. H.T.L., born in 2026, was admitted to Ha Dong General Hospital after testing RSV-positive with fever of 39°C, cough, wheeze, and irritability. Chest X-ray confirmed pneumonia; the child was hospitalized for monitoring and treatment. RSV is a common respiratory pathogen in children under 2, transmitted via droplets, direct contact with secretions, or contaminated surfaces. Initial symptoms resemble a cold—nasal discharge, congestion, sneezing, fever—and can progress to bronchiolitis, pneumonia, or respiratory failure. High-risk groups include prematurity, infancy under 6 months, congenital heart disease, chronic lung disease, or immunodeficiency. Management is primarily supportive; antibiotics are ineffective against RSV unless a bacterial coinfection is present. Prevention includes hand hygiene, cleaning surfaces and toys, avoiding crowded places, masking during illness, and maternal RSV vaccination to confer passive immunity to newborns via placenta.

triage.headline_ja: RSV感染児における肺炎リスクの警告
triage.triage_reason: RSVはありふれた小児呼吸器病原体であり、単一症例の報告で異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 単一の乳児症例に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Vacaciones en Brasil: ¿hay que vacunarse contra la fiebre amarilla antes de viajar?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Holidays in Brazil: Do you need to get vaccinated against yellow fever before traveling?
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccination is not required for entry into Brazil for Argentine travelers, but authorities urge staying up to date and emphasize vaccination for destinations with recommendations. The Argentine Health Ministry lists several Brazilian states/regions as risk zones: Rio de Janeiro (city/state), São Paulo, Santa Catarina (including Florianópolis), Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Bahia, Minas Gerais, and areas near the Amazon. Vaccination is not routinely advised for Ceará, Pernambuco, Alagoas, Sergipe, Paraíba, Rio Grande do Norte, and others. Dose timing: administer at least 10 days before entering risk areas; a single dose provides lifelong protection. Eligible: 9 months to 59 years without prior immunization. Higher-risk groups (60+, pregnant, 6–8 month infants, immunodeficiencies or on immunosuppressants, allergy to vaccine components) require medical evaluation; those with contraindications should avoid active-transmission destinations. Other precautions: repellents, light clothing, nets/air conditioning, and seek medical care for fever or related symptoms promptly, as there is no antiviral treatment for yellow fever.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル旅行：渡航前に黄熱病ワクチン接種は必要か？
triage.triage_reason: 新規の症例発生や流行拡大を報じる記事ではなく、アルゼンチン人向け渡航前の黄熱病ワクチン接種に関する一般的な渡航情報・啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内のリスクエリア（既存の流行地域）を列挙した渡航ガイダンスであり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。既知の黄熱病流行地域情報であり、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: ¡Contra el zancudo! Fumigan viviendas del barrio Candelaria, en Managua | TN8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Against the mosquito! They fumigate homes in the Candelaria neighborhood, in Managua.
article.articleSummary: In Managua’s Candelaria neighborhood (District I), about 160 homes were abatized and fumigated to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. The Roberto Herrera Health Center oversees 88 neighborhoods, emphasizing the need for homeowners to allow entry to health brigades, which are properly identified. The operation combines indoor residual spraying to kill adult mosquitoes with a measure described as a herbicide to prevent the aquatic breeding stage, targeting the vector that transmits the diseases. The effort aims to protect more than 4,000 residents living in this coastal area of the city. Brigades conduct monthly visits; between visits, families are urged to maintain cleanliness and remove waste to eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Community members highlight daily cleaning and shared responsibility in preventing disease.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊に対抗！マナグアのカンデラリア地区で住宅を燻蒸消毒
triage.triage_reason: ニカラグアの一地区における日常的な蚊媒介感染症の予防活動（燻蒸・清掃啓発）であり、対象国（フィリピン等）での発生は確認できず、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 53 hospitalised following Suspected food poisoning in Thane
article.articleSummary: 53 people, including 17 children and 25 women, were hospitalised in Thane district, Maharashtra, after consuming shawarma from a roadside eatery in Bhiwandi—suspected food poisoning. They are undergoing treatment at Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital and are currently stable. A case was registered on Tuesday against the eatery owner under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Food and Drug Administration regulations at Nizampura police station; the accused is absconding. The report notes a single-venue incident with a high patient load; investigations are underway to identify the contamination source and confirm the etiologic agent. The article does not provide laboratory confirmation details or information on outcomes beyond hospitalisation.

article.articleHeadline: Three flu strains circulate at once, sparking limit-up rally in China's A-share anti-flu stocks -- BigGo Finance
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains are circulating in China during the epidemic season: A(H1N1) 56.2%, A(H3N2) 15.5%, and B/Victoria 28.3% among positive samples (as of Nov 15, 2026). Sentinel surveillance shows influenza-like illness at 4.5% of outpatient/ER visits, with a 22.5% flu-positivity rate across samples from 216 hospitals; Chinese CDC cautions the season is underway. End-market impact: A-share anti-flu stocks jump, with Kangzhi and Handi up the 20% daily limit; Tiansheng, Shuanglu, Guilin Sanjin, and Panlong up about 10%; vaccine-related names Hualan Vaccine and Jindike up over 5%. Consumer demand spikes: baloxavir marboxil up 97% and oseltamivir up 77% nationwide; Beijing sees even larger gains (baloxavir 251%, oseltamivir 186%). Supply-chain notes from Sunshine Lake Pharma: no nationwide shortages, brief localized gaps possible; Oseltamivir production base is the world’s largest, with 3.6 billion sachets and 3 billion capsules annually. North leads regional demand, with shifts toward pharmacies and home treatment.

article.articleHeadline: 瑞普生物斩获非洲猪瘟新型疫苗临床试验批件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ruipu Bio Wins Clinical Trial Approval for a Novel African Swine Fever Vaccine
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-25, Ruipu Bio (stock code 300119) announced that its novel recombinant adenovirus vector live vaccine against African swine fever (ASF), developed in collaboration with Huazhong Agricultural University, Wuhan Keqian Biotech, and Hefei Oriental Diwei Biopharmaceuticals, has received the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs’ clinical trial approval (batch 2026067) to conduct trials at designated sites. ASF is a Class I animal disease in China with high mortality, posing a major threat to the domestic pig industry; there is currently no approved ASF vaccine in the country. The project began in 2023, with Wuhan Keqian Biotech leading the clinical work. The company emphasizes that trial approval is an R&D milestone; further clinical trials, registration, and a New Veterinary Drug Certificate and product approval number are required before market entry. Given ASF’s complex immune mechanism, trial failure risk exists, and short-term earnings are unlikely to be impacted. If successful, the vaccine would broaden Ruipu’s swine disease vaccine portfolio and strengthen its competitive position in swine health."

article.articleHeadline: Nova atualização: em alta, casos de sarna humana somam 233 em Nova Andradina -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New update: rising human scabies cases totaling 233 in Nova Andradina
article.articleSummary: Nova Andradina region reports a surge in human scabies cases, reaching 233 confirmed infections as of November 25, 2026, according to the Municipal Health Secretariat. This follows counts of 103 on November 23 and 185 on November 24. Scabies is a highly contagious skin disease transmitted mainly by direct, prolonged skin-to-skin contact. Symptoms include intense itching, especially at night, small skin lesions, irritation, redness, and rashes. Health authorities urge residents with suspected infection to visit the nearest health unit for evaluation and appropriate treatment. Prevention emphasizes not sharing clothing, towels, or bed linens; wash personal items as advised and avoid direct contact with infected individuals until cleared. The figures reflect those who sought care; undiagnosed cases could be higher. Scabies is transmitted person-to-person and is not related to animals.

article.articleHeadline: Prime Food Processing Recalls Dried Croaker Fish and Dried Herring Fish for Botulism Risk: 425 Cases of Uneviscerated Fish Sold at Asian Grocery Stores in 31 States, the Second Recall of the Same Herring Product Since June
article.articleSummary: Prime Food Processing LLC recalls 425 cases of dried fish (200 croaker and 225 herring) due to uneviscerated fish that can carry Clostridium botulinum, sold at Asian grocery stores in 31 states including Washington. FDA notices posted Nov 23, 2026; New York inspectors found the issue during routine testing, tracing the product to an imported Vietnamese source. Croaker: AF1340 (lot 24302, exp 06/24/27) and AF1420 (lot 24215, exp 02/03/27); Herring: AF4110 (lot 25180, exp 12/28/27). The same herring product was recalled in June 2026 (lot 26020, 69 cases, 17 states). No illnesses have been reported. Botulism symptoms can start 12–36 hours after ingestion and require emergency care; toxins, not infections, are produced. Do not eat; return to store for refund or discard. For questions, call 718-963-2323.

triage.notes: 原料がベトナム産と記載されているが、ベトナム国内での発生事案ではなく米国内の製品リコールのため対象国としては計上しない。発症報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Médico alerta para risco de hepatite C em salões e espaços de estética
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor warns of the risk of Hepatitis C in beauty salons and aesthetic spaces.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis C transmission risk linked to cutting and piercing instruments in beauty salons and aesthetic spaces in Acre, Brazil, highlighted after a patient developed hepatitis C following a manicure. Infectious disease specialist Thor Dantas warns that reuse of unsterilized tools can spread the virus during manicures, pedicures, barbershops, piercings, and tattoos. Autoclave sterilization is the only safe method; heat ovens or alcohol do not suffice. Public guidance includes verifying sterilization practices, insisting on autoclave-equipped facilities, and, when possible, bringing personal tools. Dantas notes Acre has one of the world’s highest prevalences of hepatitis C and that untreated infection can lead to cirrhosis and liver cancer. Recommendations call for stronger health inspections, a public policy to improve small salons’ access to autoclaves, and funding to formalize the sector.

triage.notes: 美容・衛生慣行に関する注意喚起記事であり、アウトブレイク発生を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Región Amazonas reporta seis fallecidos por dengue y 3,280 casos de este mal en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonas Region reports six deaths from dengue and 3,280 cases of dengue in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Amazonas region in Peru reports 3,280 notified dengue cases and six deaths in 2026, with transmission nearly doubling versus 2025 and deaths about five times higher. Tomás Pershing Bustamante Chauca, director of Epidemiology, Prevention and Control of Diseases for Diresa Amazonas, disclosed the figures. Bagua, Utcubamba and Condorcanqui provinces account for over 90% of cases, led by Bagua; additional cases occur in Balsas (Chachapoyas Province) and along the Pedro Ruiz corridor in Bongará. About 600 patients have been hospitalized, including a pregnant woman from Utcubamba with severe dengue and a twin pregnancy, transferred to Lima for specialist care coordinated by Virgen de Fatima Hospital in Chachapoyas. Officials warn that increased rainfall linked to El Niño could boost Aedes aegypti breeding and disease spread. A dengue vaccination campaign began in Bagua targeting 10–20-year-olds in schools, with families urged to remove water-collecting containers and keep homes clean.

article.articleHeadline: Kazakhstan reports 14 imported cases of dengue fever since start of 2026
article.articleSummary: Kazakhstan reports 14 imported dengue fever cases in 2026, identified among travelers returning from abroad, including the Maldives, Vietnam, India, Dubai, and Indonesia. In Almaty, seven dengue cases are from Maldives travelers; two from Vietnam; one each from India and Dubai. In Astana, cases involve returnees from Vietnam and Indonesia; Kostanay region has one case linked to Vietnam. As of 2026-11-25 briefing, no new dengue cases were reported in November. Separately, five imported malaria cases have been confirmed in 2026—four in Almaty and one in Astana, with four due to Plasmodium falciparum and one to Plasmodium vivax; all malaria cases are laboratory-confirmed. Authorities urge travelers to prepare before travel and observe precautionary measures, highlighting vigilance for imported infections.

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情爆發逾六個月，無國界醫生籲加強應變資源
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has lasted over six months; Doctors Without Borders urges strengthening of emergency response resources.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has persisted for over six months, with more than 10,000 confirmed cases and over 4,900 deaths (CFR 48.2%) as of 28 Oct 2026, per INSP. Eight provinces are affected; this is the largest outbreak in DRC’s history, about twice the scope of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The flare has spread beyond borders to Kenya and Nigeria with confirmed cases. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) has mobilized about 2,900 staff and €64.6 million (~US$70 million) in funding, yet response systems show critical failures: shortages of supplies, inadequate training and salaries, limited alert communications, and fuel shortages hindering ambulances. MSF operates eight Ebola Treatment Centers across five provinces, 348 beds, and three rapid-response teams, while supporting vaccination and research via the BRAVO study to evaluate ERVEBO vaccine against Bundibugyo virus. The ICG has allocated 70,000 ERVEBO doses of the 500,000 requested. MSF calls for expanded funding and an Emergency Response Fund to accelerate care, surveillance, and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が6か月以上継続、国境なき医師団が緊急対応資源の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（1万人超感染、致死率48.2%）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるがサマリーでは言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: African Union, WHO estimate cost of Ebola response in Africa at nearly $1.6 billion
article.articleSummary: As of November 25, 2026, Africa CDC and WHO project nearly $1.6 billion to combat the Ebola outbreak in Africa from November 2026 to May 2027. The plan emphasizes stronger surveillance, earlier case detection, expanded health facility capacity, preventive measures, and cross-border cooperation. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is the largest on record, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the epicenter: over 11,700 confirmed cases and more than 5,700 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9%). It has been detected in eight provinces, notably Ituri and North Kivu. Ongoing armed conflict, mass displacement, and limited access to care hamper response. WHO rates the public health risk as very high in the DRC and high in Kenya and Nigeria, all with reported cases. The outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern in May, a designation that remained on November 18.

article.articleHeadline: Денге и тропическая малярия: какие опасные инфекции привозят туристы в Казахстан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and tropical malaria: which dangerous infections are tourists bringing into Kazakhstan.
article.articleSummary: Since the start of 2026, Kazakhstan has recorded 14 imported dengue fever cases and 5 imported malaria cases, all acquired abroad. Dengue infections were concentrated in Almaty (7 cases), with travellers returning from the Maldives (7), Vietnam (2), and single cases linked to India and the United Arab Emirates (Dubai). In Astana, dengue was detected in arrivals from Vietnam and Indonesia; Kostanay region reported one case in a traveler returning from Vietnam. No new dengue cases were reported in November 2026. The five malaria cases were split between Almaty (4) and Astana (1). Four cases were tropical malaria (Plasmodium falciparum), and one was a three-day (tertian) malaria. All malaria cases were laboratory-confirmed, with most infections linked to travel to Uganda, Ghana, Gabon, and Zanzibar; one patient arrived from Vietnam. Authorities reiterate pre-travel precautions and adherence to preventive guidance.
