article.articleHeadline: Auga baimė dėl viruso protrūkio: miršta pusė užsikrėtusiųjų, vaistų nėra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of a virus outbreak grows: half of those infected are dying, there are no medicines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists since spring, with official figures showing over 11,000 infections and about half of those infected dying. It is the deadliest of DRC’s 17 outbreaks and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (≈11,000 deaths). The outbreak has reached 8 of 26 provinces. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi warns of potential spread to other continents, while response is hampered by security, population movement, and hard‑to‑reach areas. A UK citizen has been infected; a healthcare worker was flown home for treatment. National toll this year is about 6,000 deaths, but Reuters’ satellite cemetery analysis indicates many unregistered deaths; Mongbvalu cemetery shows ~25% excess mortality, with hundreds of unrecorded graves elsewhere. Many deaths go unreported due to mining-town migration and burial practices. Early cases resembled malaria/typhoid; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for this strain, and true outbreak size may be two to four times the official data.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス流行への恐怖が拡大：感染者の半数が死亡、治療薬はない
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（感染者11,000人超、致死率約50%）であり、複数国際基準・IHR基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、アンゴラ・英国は感染者の渡航先・輸入症例として言及されているのみで対象国リストに含まれないため除外。衛星墓地分析により公式統計より実際の死者数が多い可能性が指摘されている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança em 21 estados no Brasil; Mais de 100 mil casos são registrados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Advances in 21 Brazilian States; More Than 100,000 Cases Recorded
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity in Brazil is rising in 21 states (up from 17), with 135,378 influenza-like illness cases linked to the disease reported through November 16, 2026. Despite the uptick, severe cases remain at low risk nationwide. Rio de Janeiro is the sole state with severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) at an alert level, showing a six-week upward trend; SRAG increases are driven by SARS-CoV-2, metapneumovirus, influenza A and B. The SRAG rise appears regional elsewhere. The update adds Amazonas, Maranhão, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio Grande do Norte, Sergipe and Tocantins to the list; Alagoas and Roraima left. Private-sector SARS-CoV-2 positivity has grown for 11 weeks. Vaccination efforts include the dispatch of over 1.41 million additional COVID-19 doses to ten states, notably São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Minas Gerais.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19、ブラジル21州で拡大中；10万件以上の症例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19が21州に拡大し症例数は多いが、重症例は全国的に低リスクとされており、季節性呼吸器感染症の通常の季節変動の範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: COVID-19、メタニューモウイルス、インフルエンザA/Bが混在するSRAG増加であり、既存の季節性呼吸器疾患サーベイランス報告の範疇。重症化率は低く、ワクチン追加配布など通常の公衆衛生対応が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: SMS Natal reforça vigilância diante do aumento de notificações no Brasil - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Natal's Municipal Health Secretariat strengthens surveillance in light of the increase in notifications in Brazil - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Natal, Brazil: as of November 21, 2026 (week 46), Natal’s Municipal Health Secretariat, via the Health Surveillance Department and Epidemiological Surveillance Sector, recorded 96 suspected mpox notifications in 2026, up from 23 in all of 2025. Of the 2026 notifications, 15 are laboratory-confirmed, 62 ruled out, 17 inconclusive or not lab-confirmed, and 2 under investigation. Mpox is caused by the Monkeypox virus (Orthopoxvirus, Poxviridae) and spreads mainly through close contact with infected individuals, especially via skin lesions, body fluids, and secretions. Symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions that crust, fever, headache, myalgia, chills, lymphadenopathy, and fatigue. Most cases are mild to moderate. Authorities emphasize vigilance ahead of large gatherings (Carnatal, Halleluya Natal, year-end events) and preventive measures. Diagnosis requires molecular testing or genetic sequencing; isolation continues until lesions heal and new skin forms, with avoidance of sharing personal items. Reference units: Pajuçara, Panatis, Mãe Luiza, Felipe Camarão; UPAs available.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：ナタール市保健局、ブラジルでの報告数増加を受けて監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ナタール市で2026年の疑い報告が前年比で大幅増加しているが、重症例・死亡の記載はなく、既知の流行性疾患（Mpox）の地域内増加であるため、国際的な新規性・重大性は限定的。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ナタール市の自治体保健局による監視強化の発表であり、全国規模のアウトブレイクや重症例急増を示す情報はない。大規模イベント前の予防的対応として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: CHOLERA OUTBREAK CONFIRMED IN CHIPATA, KASENENGWA - Zambia 24
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak confirmed in Chipata and Kasenengwa districts, Eastern Province, Zambia, with nine cases reported as of 24 November 2026. The index case, a 44-year-old man, sought care at Kamulaza Rural Health Centre on 21 November with acute watery diarrhoea and died the following morning; laboratory testing detected Vibrio cholerae. Of the nine cases, three are in Chipata and six in Kasenengwa. Investigations link all patients to a funeral held for an 80-year-old woman on 21 November. The Public Health Emergency Operations Centre has been activated, an Incident Management Team appointed, and District Rapid Response Teams dispatched. The Provincial Health Office has recommended declaring the outbreak to facilitate coordinated response mechanisms. Ongoing investigations and response are in place to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チパタ、カセネングワでコレラ感染拡大が確認される - Zambia 24
triage.triage_reason: ザンビア東部州でコレラのアウトブレイクが確認され死亡例も発生、公衆衛生緊急対応センターが活動を開始しており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 9症例、1死亡例（指標症例、44歳男性）。葬儀参列者間での共通曝露が疑われている。州保健局がアウトブレイク宣言を推奨し、緊急対応チームが派遣済み。国境を越えた拡大リスクや外部支援の必要性については現時点で記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Fighting in eastern Congo forces Ebola workers to evacuate,...
article.articleSummary: Fighting in eastern Congo forces Ebola response teams to evacuate as clashes north of Bunia in Ituri province disrupt outbreak containment. As of 25 November 2026, Congo's Ebola outbreak has infected more than 11,700 people and killed over 5,700 across eight provinces—the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks. Direct contact with blood or bodily fluids drives transmission; containment hinges on rapid isolation, exposure monitoring, and safe burials. About a dozen people, including two WHO personnel and Congolese health officials, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped in Akwe amid heavy crossfire. WHO also moved Mongbwalu teams to Bunia; blocked roads hinder delivery of supplies and movement of patients. In North Kivu, attacks displaced over 20,000 people, complicating contact tracing. CRP rebels suspended advances toward Bunia; government forces reportedly pushed back, but security remains volatile. Mongbwalu is where the outbreak was first detected in May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部での戦闘によりエボラ対応要員が避難、感染拡大が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（感染者11,700人超、死者5,700人超）が進行中であり、武力紛争により対応活動が阻害されている。IHR基準を複数満たし、国際支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州ブニア北部の戦闘によりWHO職員・保健当局者が避難。北キブ州でも2万人以上が避難民となり接触者追跡が困難化。本流行は同国17回のエボラ流行の中で最も死者数が多い。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Goiânia espalha 16,6 mil armadilhas contra a dengue pela cidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiânia City Hall deploys 16,600 dengue traps across the city.
article.articleSummary: Dengue traps deployed across Goiânia: the city’s Health Department reports 16,528 dengue-focused traps in operation, part of a planned 25,000 units. The In2Care stations (9,928 active out of 15,000) lure female Aedes aegypti and deliver piriproxyfen (larvicidal growth regulator) and Beauveria bassiana fungus to affect larvae and adults. An additional 6,600 Inestrap devices with adhesive surfaces are active in other districts. Maintenance cycles run every eight weeks, with mobile trap islands planned to be deployed in transmission hotspots during peak epidemics. Geographically, In2Care operates in Southwest, Northwest, North, South, and East districts; Inestrap serves East, West, and Campinas-Centro. The epidemiological picture shows dengue cases rising from 29,758 to 36,617 in the first 46 weeks, a 23% increase, with dozens of deaths; chikungunya also shows sharp rises. Traps complement house-by-house inspections and source reduction by health workers.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアニア市役所、市内にデング対策トラップ16,600個を設置
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例が前年比23%増加し死者も発生しているが、これは既存の媒介対策活動の報告であり新規の異常事態ではないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は媒介対策（トラップ設置）が主題で、デング・チクングニア症例増加は背景情報として言及されている。ブラジルは例年デングが流行する国であり、今回の増加が特異的に異常かどうかは記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Com 379 casos prováveis de chikungunya, bairro Tomba recebe mobilização contra mosquito no dia 5 - Acorda Cidade - Portal de notícias de Feira de Santana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 379 probable cases of Chikungunya, Tomba neighborhood receives mosquito-control mobilization on the 5th - Acorda Cidade - Feira de Santana News Portal
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Brazil – The Tomba neighborhood is mobilizing around arbovirus prevention with 136 probable dengue and 379 probable chikungunya cases in 2026 through Nov 24. The Week of Mobilization against Dengue runs Nov 23–28, with Dia D on Dec 5, 8:00–14:00 at Praça do Tomba. Activities include home inspections, larviciding, and focal treatment to eliminate breeding sites; Operação Bota-Fora provides disposal points and public collection for sofas, beds, mattresses, tires, and other items that can hold water. Inspections target tire shops, junkyards, construction depots, and vacant lots. Health-education blitzes, street walks, and blood-sample collection for diagnostic testing are planned. Tomba is a high-incidence, priority area, requiring persistent vector control to prevent arboviruses transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱の疑い379例、トンバ地区で12月5日に蚊対策動員実施 - Acorda Cidade（フェイラ・デ・サンタナ）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地区における例年のデング・チクングニア媒介蚊対策活動の報道であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による恒例の蚊媒介性疾患（デング・チクングニア）対策キャンペーンの告知記事。重症度や死亡者数についての言及はなく、地域保健当局が自力で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Synbiotic Diets Boost Whiteleg Shrimp Survival Against Vibrio Infection in
article.articleSummary: Whiteleg shrimp (Penaeus vannamei) reared in a closed recirculating aquaculture system in Indonesia showed improved survival against Vibrio parahaemolyticus following synbiotic feeding. In AHPND-challenge trials, shrimp fed a Halomonas alkaliphila synbiotic diet (diet H; 10^9 CFU/kg) reached 67 ± 7% survival, while those fed Bacillus cereus synbiotic diet (diet B; 10^8 CFU/kg) reached 63 ± 13% survival, versus 21 ± 7% for the commercial feed control (diet C) after injection with V. parahaemolyticus. The regimens enhanced growth, total biomass, and productivity, and yielded a more balanced gut microbiome with a lower relative abundance of potentially harmful bacteria post-challenge. Histology showed preserved hepatopancreatic architecture; immune gene expression increased for anti-lipopolysaccharide factor a (ALF-a), prophenoloxidase (proPO), and lectin in synbiotic groups. Conducted by Bandung Institute of Technology, Indonesia, the study supports synbiotic approaches as viable alternatives to standard feed for improving AHPND resistance in closed RAS.

triage.headline_ja: シンバイオティック飼料がバナメイエビのビブリオ感染に対する生存率を向上
triage.triage_reason: これは水産養殖における研究報告であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 研究室/養殖場での実験報告であり、ヒト感染症のシグナルではない。エビ養殖業界向けの技術的研究内容。

article.articleHeadline: Fighting in eastern Congo forces Ebola workers to evacuate, threatening outbreak response
article.articleSummary: Fighting in eastern Congo has disrupted Ebola response, forcing workers to evacuate and hindering access to patients. In Ituri province, Bunia and Akwe areas affected; Mongbwalu team moved to Bunia. About a dozen people, including two WHO personnel and Congolese health officials, evacuated after three days trapped in Akwe amid crossfire. Roads blocked, delaying delivery of supplies, patient transfers, and safe burials. The Congo Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has infected more than 11,700 people and killed more than 5,700 across eight provinces—the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of the sick or deceased; containment requires rapid isolation, exposure monitoring, and safe burials. In North Kivu, attacks displaced over 20,000, hampering contact tracing. Some teams are returning; WHO operations in Bunia continuing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部での戦闘によりエボラ対応従事者が避難、アウトブレイク対応が脅かされる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に加え、紛争による対応中断が流行拡大・管理不能のリスクを高めており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模（感染者11,700人超、死者5,700人超）のエボラ流行が継続中。武力紛争によりWHOを含む対応チームが避難を余儀なくされ、接触者追跡・安全な埋葬などの対策が妨げられている。北キブ州では20,000人超が避難民となり、対応がさらに困難化。紛争地域での保健対応という性質上、情報不足な点（渡航制限の有無等）もあるが、既存の深刻な流行状況と対応中断のリスクからPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Primer brote de lengua azul en México: Otro peligro ganadero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Bluetongue outbreak in Mexico: Another threat to livestock.
article.articleSummary: Mexico reports its first bluetongue (BTV) outbreak in Puebla state, beginning 6 November 2026 and confirmed 18 November on a ranch in Francisco Z. Mena, near Poza Rica, Veracruz. Fourteen of 56 susceptible sheep tested positive and eight died. The virus is serotype BTV-18; Brazil recorded BTV-18 in 2015. Bluetongue is transmitted by Culicoides biting midges and poses no risk to humans. Other transmission routes, rarely, include semen and placenta. In sheep, infection causes fever, oral and nasal ulcers, salivation, swollen lips and tongue, lameness, weakness, and possibly cyanosis; cattle may show higher infection rates and variable signs; goats often little or no symptoms. Vaccination against the detected strain is recommended; Senasica oversees reporting. No control measures had been applied on the Puebla farm yet; programs highlight rapid diagnosis, culling, disinfection, vector control, movement control, and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ初のブルータング発生：畜産に新たな脅威
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ヒトへのリスクなし）であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル）は参考記述のみで実際の発生国ではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事例はメキシコ（プエブラ州・ベラクルス州）での家畜（羊）のブルータング発生であり、ヒトへの感染リスクはない。ブラジルは2015年の過去事例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。メキシコ自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Goiânia instalou 16,6 mil das 25 mil armadilhas contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiânia installed 16,600 of the 25,000 dengue traps.
article.articleSummary: Goiânia, Brazil, has 16,528 dengue traps in operation toward a 25,000-network goal (66.1% complete); 8,472 traps remain to be installed in areas selected by mosquito presence and disease activity. The In2Care stations (9,928 of 15,000) attract female Aedes aegypti to a water-containing receptacle where contact with piriproxifen larvicide impedes larval development and can spread to other breeding sites; Beauveria bassiana fungus also targets adults. Inestrap traps (6,600 of 10,000) rely on adhesive surfaces to capture mosquitoes. Stations are spread across five health districts, with neighborhoods listed. Maintenance uses eight-week cycles; plans for mobile trap islands to target high-transmission areas were announced. A June 2026 purchase authorized 4,200 In2Care stations and 45,000 bioactive refills for R$6.234 million. Dengue cases rose 23% in weeks 1–46 of 2026 (36,617 cases; 37 deaths) versus 2025; chikungunya rose to 803 cases with one death. A 2021 field study suggested fewer eggs/larvae where traps were present, supporting the strategy.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアニア市、デング熱対策トラップ2万5000基のうち1万6600基を設置
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ゴイアニア市における日常的なデング熱ベクター対策(トラップ設置)に関する記事で、症例数は前年比23%増（37死亡）だが、これはブラジルの季節的・地域内流行の範囲内であり、突発的な異常事態とは言えない。継続的なベクター媒介感染症の拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ゴイアニア市の蚊トラップ設置進捗を報じる行政広報的内容。デング熱（36,617例、37死亡）とチクングニア熱（803例、1死亡）の季節的増加に言及しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、地域の持続的ベクター対策の一環として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Fighting in Eastern Congo Forces Ebola Workers to Evacuate, Threatening Outbreak Response
article.articleSummary: Escalating fighting in eastern Congo between government forces and the CRP rebels has forced Ebola response workers to evacuate and blocked roads to affected communities, hindering containment. The deadly Congo Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has infected more than 11,700 people and killed over 5,700 across eight provinces, with Bunia in Ituri serving as a major response hub. WHO Ebola incident manager Dr. Catherine Smallwood said teams were evacuated from Akwe after three days under crossfire, and Mongbwalu staff were moved to Bunia. Blocked routes disrupt delivery of supplies, patient transfers, and safe burials; a humanitarian team reported gunfire and UN escorts. In North Kivu, more than 20,000 people have been displaced, complicating contact tracing. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids, underscoring the urgency of rapid isolation, exposure monitoring, and safe burials. Some local teams are cautiously returning to work as security allows.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部での戦闘によりエボラ対応要員が避難を余儀なくされ、アウトブレイク対応が危機に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,700人感染・5,700人死亡という大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、武力紛争により対応活動が妨げられ封じ込めが危機的状況にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月宣言、8州に拡大、死者5,700人超）に対し、武力紛争（政府軍とCRP反政府勢力）が対応活動を妨害し、医療要員の避難や物資輸送の遮断、安全な埋葬の実施困難など、封じ込めの危機的状況が続いている。北キブ州では2万人以上が避難民となり接触者追跡も困難化。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : les mesures barrières contre le virus Ebola préconisées par l'école d'une commune - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: Barrier measures against the Ebola virus recommended by a commune's school - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, a primary school in the N'Djili commune has recommended barrier measures against the Ebola virus to limit the outbreak. Measures emphasize hand hygiene, avoiding contact with bodily fluids, and rapid isolation of ill individuals. Students are instructed to avoid touching blood, saliva, sweat, vomit, feces, and urine of an infected person. Handwashing stations have been installed outside classrooms to enable washing after using facilities and before meals. Although the outbreak has not yet reached Kinshasa, through these students the school aims to raise awareness among their families. The initiative highlights basic infection control as part of school-based community outreach.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ:ある行政区の学校がエボラウイルスに対する予防措置を推奨
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が継続する中、首都キンシャサの学校が予防的バリア対策を講じている点は、大都市への拡大リスクを示唆し、IHR基準にも複数該当するためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサの一学校による予防啓発活動を報じたもので、キンシャサ市内での感染確認は明記されていない。ただしDRC国内で進行中のエボラ流行の文脈下での動きであり、大都市への波及リスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : une baisse considérable des ventes de viande dans les boucheries suite à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: a substantial drop in meat sales in butcher shops following Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is driving a sharp drop in meat sales in Beni’s butcheries. In Beni town, vendors report fear-related declines in customer traffic: Ramazani Ngbake says he previously sold up to two large goats daily, but sales have collapsed. Julie Kombi notes a fall from about 50 kg of meat daily in May 2026 to roughly 25 kg now, as customers have less money and worry about Ebola. Joseph Dibwesa, coordinator of the local butchers association, assures the public that meat is controlled and certified by veterinarians. The downturn occurs amid ongoing Ebola transmission in Nord-Kivu, with awareness campaigns and hygiene/barrier measures at public sites, including the Beni urban slaughterhouse, to strengthen the response and protect the community.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラの影響で食肉店の売上が大幅減少 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・北キブ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行による社会経済的影響（食肉販売の急減）を報じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 記事自体は経済的影響（食肉販売減少）が主題だが、北キブ州での継続的なエボラ感染拡大を裏付ける内容であり、既知の進行中アウトブレイクの一環として重要視すべき。詳細な症例数や死亡者数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil's New Weapon Against Dengue
article.articleSummary: Brazil's four-year Evita Dengue project in Belo Horizonte released Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti across 58 school-adjacent neighbourhoods, with 29 intervention areas and 29 controls, involving 5,757 children aged 6–11. From 2020 to 2024, infections from dengue and chikungunya dropped by 68.6% overall in intervention areas, including a 68.5% reduction in dengue and 73.3% in chikungunya versus controls. The findings, presented amid Brazil's severe 2024 dengue epidemic, suggest meaningful protection during high transmission. Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium not normally found in Aedes aegypti, reduces viral replication and is transmitted to offspring, enabling self-sustaining, non-genetic modification of the mosquito population; human infection isn’t affected by the bacterium. Routine vector control continued in both groups. Brazil's wider experience shows similar gains: Niterói dengue reductions ~89% and Campo Grande ~63.2% after Wolbachia establishment. Zika data were inconclusive due to small numbers.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱対策における新たな武器
triage.triage_reason: 記事はWolbachia媒介蚊によるデング熱等の予防研究の成果報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱・チクングニア熱の予防介入（Wolbachia法）の有効性研究結果の報告であり、新規発生や異常事態の報告ではない。2024年のブラジルでの大規模デング熱流行は背景情報として言及されているが、本記事自体は対策の成功事例を扱う内容。

article.articleHeadline: Inactivated Vaccine Protects Against Equine Streptococcus zooepidemicus in
article.articleSummary: Inactivated whole-cell vaccine against Streptococcus zooepidemicus strain NMMXQZ-1 demonstrated 100% protective efficacy in a rabbit challenge using Montanide ISA-201 adjuvant, achieving a serum antibody titre of 1:32 and markedly reducing multi-organ pathology. In target horses, vaccination was well tolerated with transient local swelling resolving within 48 hours and eliciting high antibody levels. The NMMXQZ-1 isolate was obtained from an infected horse in Inner Mongolia and clusters with Xinjiang XJYL-M6-2, reflecting regional circulation linked to horse movement between Inner Mongolia and Xinjiang. Genomic analysis identified 43 virulence-associated genes, including LPXTG and Fnz2 adhesion determinants. The study, published in BMC Microbiology (2026), supports a safe, highly effective regional vaccine strategy to control the opportunistic zoonotic pathogen Streptococcus zooepidemicus in equine breeding and public health contexts.

triage.headline_ja: 不活化ワクチンが馬のStreptococcus zooepidemicus感染を予防、地域予備臨床試験で効果確認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は馬を対象としたワクチン研究に関する学術報告であり、ヒトへの感染事例や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は獣医学的ワクチン開発研究であり、動物（馬）感染症の学術論文紹介。ヒト症例・公衆衛生イベントの発生は報告されていないため対象国に該当せず。

article.articleHeadline: UN peacekeepers evacuate trapped Ebola workers as fighting in eastern Congo disrupts outbreak response
article.articleSummary: UN peacekeepers evacuated 10 health workers from Akwe hospital in Ituri as fighting between Congolese forces and the CRP disrupts Congo’s deadliest Ebola outbreak. About a dozen people, including two WHO staff and Congolese health officials, reached Bunia after three days in crossfire. WHO moved its Mongbwalu team to Bunia as road access was cut; blocked roads hinder supplies, patient transfers, and safe burials, leaving some treatment centers short of staff. In North Kivu, attacks displaced more than 20,000 people and disrupted contact tracing. The outbreak has infected more than 11,700 people and killed over 5,700 since May, spanning eight provinces. The CRP, led by Thomas Lubanga, declared a unilateral ceasefire in May but fighting continues; authorities say the army pushed rebels back. Some local response teams were returning to work on Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: 国連平和維持軍、コンゴ東部の戦闘でアウトブレイク対応が混乱する中、取り残されたエボラ対応従事者を避難
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（感染11,700人超、死亡5,700人超）が継続しており、武力紛争により対応活動（接触者追跡、物資輸送、安全な埋葬）が深刻に妨げられている点で公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 既に進行中の大規模エボラ流行（2026年5月以降、8州に拡大）について、武力紛争による対応活動の中断という新たな展開を報じる記事。フルRRAによる継続評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Flags New COVID Variant as It Spreads Across Countries Including US and China
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a newly identified COVID-19 variant, is spreading across Canada, the United States (first US case detected in New York City on June 30; subsequent cases in California, Arizona, New Jersey, Virginia, North Carolina, Missouri, Oklahoma, Colorado, and Florida) and China, with Hong Kong the only location where wastewater testing detected the variant, suggesting possible community transmission there. The WHO classifies global risk as low for now, though data remain limited and could change. In China, two virologists allege PJ.2.1 has circulated since August, with northern provinces Hebei, Shanxi, Jilin, and Liaoning most affected; Shenzhen in Guangdong, and reports from Sichuan and Chongqing also cited; Beijing wastewater readings have risen. Laboratory input claims the variant spreads mainly via stronger ACE2 binding and increased kidney-cell infection, implying higher infectivity and potential diagnostic challenges due to rapid test false negatives (>30%). Whistleblower claims accuse CCP authorities of suppressing information; no independent verification is provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが新型COVID変異株に警告、米国・中国を含む複数国に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国（米国・カナダ・中国）で確認され、下水検査で市中感染の可能性が示唆されている。WHOも注視しており、感染性増大の主張もあることから初期トリアージでピックアップし詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。香港は対象国リストの中国に含めて計上。内部告発者による情報隠蔽疑惑は未検証であり、WHOはリスクを現時点で低いと評価しているが、データ不足のため変動しうる点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Ubangi : 400 cas suspects d'Ebola notifiés à Wapinda au 19 novembre - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nord-Ubangi: 400 suspected Ebola cases reported in Wapinda as of November 19 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Wapinda health zone, Yakoma territory, Nord-Ubangi, western Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of November 19, the zone reports a cumulative >400 suspected Ebola cases, including seven confirmed cases and two deaths, not counting those who died before the response team arrived from Gbadolite. Officials deem Ebola an international public health emergency requiring urgent government and technical/financial support to halt transmission. The epidemiological response is hampered by a 45-day lull in community activities, with only two motorcycles available for responders, and shortages of lubricants, medicines, ambulances, and handwashing kits. The 104,851-strong population lacks isolation facilities and a center for confirmed cases. Calls for installation of an INRB laboratory in Wapinda for rapid detection and for national/provincial authorities to intensify the outbreak response, as seen in Ituri, Tshopo, and Beni.

triage.headline_ja: ノール・ウバンギ州:ワピンダで11月19日時点でエボラ出血熱の疑い例400件が報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の疑い症例400例超（確定7例、死亡2例）が報告され、対応能力不足が指摘されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では隔離施設・検査室・医療資材・輸送手段の不足が強調されており、対応能力の限界が明確。国際的な技術・資金支援の要請が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: 中國疫情急遽上升 48小時為黃金治療時間 | 新冠 | PJ.2.1 | 封鎖消息
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's outbreak surges; 48 hours is the golden treatment window | COVID-19 | PJ.2.1 | Lockdown News
article.articleSummary: China faces a surge in COVID-19 driven by the PJ.2.1 variant, with authorities allegedly blocking reporting. Concurrently, influenza A subtypes H1N1 and H3N2, and influenza B Victoria lineage are circulating; H1N1 accounts for 56.2% of flu positives, with children aged 5–14 showing the highest rate. Clinicians warn both COVID-19 and influenza virulence and mortality are rising, with rapid progression to severe disease. Southern cities including Sichuan and Guangdong report high activity; hospitals run around the clock, and pediatric wards report daily triage queues near 1,000–2,000. On Nov 24, the China CDC press briefing reportedly omitted COVID-19 discussion, yet insiders say the wave is dangerous. Infection within 48 hours is described as a golden treatment window due to potential for pneumonia ('white lung'), heart attack, and stroke. A 2022 Yiwu outbreak linked to Qingkou Night Market is cited as a benchmark, with current spread exceeding that event.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の疫病急増、48時間が黄金治療時間 | 新型コロナ | PJ.2.1 | 封鎖情報
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19(PJ.2.1変異株)とインフルエンザ(H1N1/H3N2/B型)の同時流行による病院逼迫が報告されており、WPRO基準（流行しやすさ・曝露の継続性）に該当し社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。ただし情報源の信頼性には留意が必要。
triage.notes: 情報源は新唐人電視台（NTDTV）で、中国当局による情報統制を主張する政治色の強い報道。死亡率上昇や『白肺』『心臓発作』『脳卒中』などの表現は未確認かつ扇情的であり、公式統計（China CDC等）による裏付けが取れていない点に留意。四川省・広東省はいずれも中国国内の地域であり、国としてはChinaのみを計上。続報・公式発表の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose visceral em cães pode passar despercebida e exige prevenção - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã/MS e Pedro Juan Caballero/PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Visceral leishmaniasis in dogs can go unnoticed and requires prevention - Ponta Porã Informa - News from Ponta Porã/MS and Pedro Juan Caballero/PY.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis poses a zoonotic threat: dogs in endemic areas can be infected without symptoms, underscoring the need for vector protection. In Minas Gerais, Brazil, 407 human cases and 58 deaths were recorded from 2023 through August 2025. Transmission mainly via infected sandflies (phlebotomines). Prevention in dogs focuses on bite prevention and veterinary risk assessment; more than half of infected dogs are asymptomatic, so clinical screening is advised. Ourofino Saúde Animal will present at Brasileish 2026 (27th International Symposium of Canine Visceral Leishmaniasis) in Belo Horizonte on 28-29 November, with a talk on From the vector to protection: strategies for canine leishmaniasis control. The Leevre collar (deltamethrin + propoxur) is highlighted as an effective tool; collars require replacement on schedule, and yard hygiene and city testing/distribution programs support community protection against the sandfly vector and visceral leishmaniasis.

triage.headline_ja: 犬の内臓リーシュマニア症は気づかれないまま進行することがあり、予防が必要
triage.triage_reason: 内容は犬の予防啓発・獣医学的な啓発記事であり、ブラジルの既知の風土病状況に関する一般情報で、新規性・異常性・急性の公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 内臓リーシュマニア症はブラジルの風土病であり、記事は予防啓発・製品紹介（Leevreカラー）とシンポジウム告知が主旨。人の症例数(407例、死亡58例)は2023年〜2025年8月の累積データであり、急性のアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Accelerates at Alarming Rate, WHO Warns
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus declared 15 May 2026. By 17 November 2026, 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths (crude CFR ~49%) have been reported, with 3,148 recoveries. The epidemic spans eight provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu heavily affected. WHO warns the outbreak is accelerating faster than any prior Ebola outbreak, calling it the second-largest. In the first 100 days, CDC counted 5,458 cases and 2,606 deaths, roughly sevenfold the pace of 2014. Of 720 deaths in the three weeks to 17 Nov, 452 occurred in communities outside treatment facilities. Transmission is via direct contact with infected blood or fluids; wildlife exposure and fruit bats are suspected reservoirs. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain; severe disease may involve organ dysfunction and bleeding. Containment is hindered by insecurity, limited healthcare access, gaps in contact tracing, community deaths, and funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、驚異的な速さで拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが過去最速ペースで拡大し、死亡者数・致死率ともに極めて高く、複数州に拡大しており国際的な公衆衛生上の重大懸念に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが『過去最大級かつ過去最速ペースのエボラ流行』と警告。致死率約49%、8州に拡大、治安悪化や医療アクセス制限により封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Drones may help track mosquito hotspots before outbreaks: Study
article.articleSummary: ICMR-NIMR in India is developing a semi-automated drone-based system to identify hidden mosquito breeding sites in dense urban areas of Delhi and enable targeted spraying of insecticides and larvicides to curb malaria and other vector-borne diseases. A Malaria Journal cross-sectional study from Delhi’s southwest district assessed community acceptance of drone-based surveillance among 406 residents. Among respondents, 82.3% were willing to allow drones over homes to map breeding sites; 79.6% considered drone use for vector control safe; 70.2% believed drones could spray insecticides or larvicides precisely; and 83.3% felt drones could conduct mosquito surveillance faster than conventional methods. About 64.3% saw drones as more effective, albeit costlier. Drones can scan rooftops, terraces, construction sites, overhead water tanks, and gutters; when paired with AI/ML and geospatial mapping, they could identify larvae and map breeding habitats to plan targeted interventions, prioritizing larval-stage control.

triage.headline_ja: ドローンが発生前に蚊の発生源を追跡する助けとなる可能性:研究
triage.triage_reason: マラリア発生自体の報告ではなく、蚊媒介性疾患対策としてのドローン活用に関する研究・受容度調査の記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア流行や発生事例ではなく、ドローンを用いた蚊の発生源特定技術の研究・コミュニティ受容度調査に関する内容。感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kementan Terjunkan Tim ke Bireuen, Periksa Kesehatan Sapi Cegah Wabah PMK |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture Deploys a Team to Bireuen, Conducts Cattle Health Checks to Prevent Foot-and-Mouth Disease Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) prevention efforts in Aceh: The Ministry of Agriculture, via Balai Veteriner Medan (BV Medan), conducted cattle health checks in Bireuen Regency, Aceh, focusing on Desa Krueng Juli Timur, Kuala District. The operation combines clinical examinations, epidemiological tracing, farmer interviews, and laboratory sampling to identify causes of livestock health issues and guide appropriate interventions. The effort is conducted with Dinas Peternakan dan Kesehatan Hewan (Disnakkeswan) Kabupaten Bireuen, as part of ongoing PMK/FMD surveillance and prevention campaigns in Aceh. BV Medan chief Arif Hukmi emphasizes vaccination participation and the use of Puskeswan veterinary services, urging farmers to isolate and report any suspicious signs. Epidemiological procedures include tracking animal movements and transport history. Laboratory results will underpin diagnostic confirmation and control recommendations, with authorities reinforcing coordination among animal health workers, local government, and farmers to prevent spread to other farms.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、ビルウェンに調査チームを派遣しPMK（口蹄疫）流行防止のため牛の健康チェックを実施
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（口蹄疫）の予防的監視活動に関する報道であり、ヒトへの直接影響はないが、家畜疾病の拡大防止策として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物（牛）の口蹄疫予防に関するもので、ヒトの感染症リスクではない。農業省による予防的監視活動が中心であり、現時点で大規模流行の兆候は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever Detected in Bhutan Wild Pigs Near Human Settlements
article.articleSummary: ASF detected in Bhutan's wild pigs near human settlements in Bumthang and Dagana districts. The field study uses integrated field epidemiology, laboratory confirmation, and spatial analysis to assess wildlife–livestock interfaces. A total of 62 diagnostic samples from domestic swine, wild pigs, and commercial pork facilities were tested by RT-PCR at the National Centre for Animal Health, yielding an overall positivity of 79%; 100% positivity in wild pigs and 85% in domestic pigs. QGIS mapping showed wild pig carcasses within 600 meters of human settlements in both districts. Bumthang showed intense human–wildlife–food-system interactions, while Dagana represented a forest-border interface near the India border with domestic dogs scavenging carcasses, indicating a potential indirect spread route. Rapid Response Teams operated in Bumthang and an Incident Operation Centre in Dagana. The authors call for an integrated One Health surveillance framework to address cross-species transmission and the absence of a wild-pig control strategy.

triage.headline_ja: ブータンの野生イノシシでアフリカ豚熱(ASF)を検出、人間居住地近くで確認
triage.triage_reason: 本事例は動物（豚）のみに影響するASFの疫学調査報告であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクはない。また発生国であるブータンは対象国リストに含まれず、インドは国境近接の地理的言及のみで発生国ではない。
triage.notes: ASF(アフリカ豚熱)はヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、人獣共通感染症ではない。発生地はブータン（対象国リスト外）。記事中のインドは国境近接の地理的文脈のみで、ASF発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Alta de casos de Covid-19 está ligada à baixa vacinação, afirma médico infectologista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19 cases linked to low vaccination rates, says infectious disease doctor.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases in Brazil rose, with the positive test rate increasing from 1% to 17% over the past three months, the Ministry of Health reports. The uptick is linked to insufficient vaccination against new variants. Immunocompromised individuals and workers in high-risk settings should receive periodic boosters, and others should stay up to date, including through pregnancy. Symptoms prompting precautions include respiratory signs such as sneezing, runny nose, and coughing; officials advise mask use if symptomatic and, when possible, staying away from work. Infectious-disease physician Guilherme Roveri calls the rise a warning to complete or maintain vaccination. Emphasis is placed on hand hygiene (washing hands in addition to sanitizers) and targeted protection for exposure-prone populations. Reported by Record News from Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19感染者の増加はワクチン接種率の低さに関連、感染症専門医が指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで陽性率の上昇（1%→17%）が報告されているが、既知の疾患（COVID-19）の季節的・接種率低下に伴う増加であり、IHR基準の該当は乏しい。国内の公衆衛生対応として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 陽性率の急上昇が報告されているが、重症度・死亡者数等の詳細情報は記事に記載されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária: ES confirma foco e Japão veta compra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: Espírito Santo confirms outbreak and Japan vetoes purchase
article.articleSummary: High-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreak confirmed in Espírito Santo, Brazil, at a subsistence poultry farm near São Mateus in the state’s north, with confirmation on 24 November and sanitary culling of all site birds on 25 November. No commercial farms are implicated as yet. Idaf initiated a 3-km surveillance zone around the outbreak for 28 days under MAPA protocol to prevent spread to commercial flocks. An emergency CGIA meeting outlined prevention, surveillance, and control measures. The subtype and the exact number of birds affected were not disclosed. Japan suspended imports of Espírito Santo-origin poultry in response to the notification. The Espírito Santo outbreak recalls Brazil’s 2023 entry of HPAI via the state, while authorities emphasize low human infection risk and advise against handling dead or diseased birds. Export context: Espírito Santo’s poultry trade includes small imports from Japan, with limited share in recent years.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：エスピリト・サント州で発生確認、日本が輸入停止
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ発生により日本が輸出入を停止するなど貿易制限と国際的対応が生じており、IHR基準の該当数が2つとなるためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 自給自足養鶏場での発生で商業農場への影響は未確認。ヒトへの感染リスクは低いとされているが、日本の輸入停止という貿易制限が発生している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia tem 19 casos de Mpox em 2026; Brasil chega a 1.499 no ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia has 19 Mpox cases in 2026; Brazil reaches 1,499 for the year.
article.articleSummary: Bahia has 19 confirmed Mpox (Monkeypox) cases in 2026, per the State Health Secretariat (Sesab) updated through Nov 24, 2026; Paramirim municipality announced 2 additional infections, not yet incorporated in official counts, bringing the total to 21. Of the 19 confirmed in Bahia, 12 live in Salvador, 2 in São Sebastião do Passé, 1 in Feira de Santana, 1 in São Francisco do Conde, 1 in Vitória da Conquista, with 2 cases residing in other states. Nationally, Brazil records 1,499 confirmed Mpox cases for 2026, 56 probable, and 1,484 suspected, with 1 death reported in Rio de Janeiro. Transmission is by close contact with infectious lesions, secretions, or contaminated objects; symptoms include skin eruptions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, chills, and weakness. Health authorities recommend avoiding contact, not sharing personal items, seeking medical care for symptoms, and vaccination for priority groups per SUS.

triage.headline_ja: バイーア州で2026年にMpox症例19件、ブラジル全体で年間1,499件に達する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続的に発生しているMpoxの定例報告であり、死亡例が1件あるものの重症度・異常性は低く、新規シグナルというより既存流行の経過観察に該当する。
triage.notes: El Salvadorは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーには言及がなく除外した。Bahia・Rio de JaneiroはBrazil国内の州のためBrazilに統合。

article.articleHeadline: TEŠKA SITUACIJA U KONGU: Mirovne snage UN evakuisale zdravstvene radnike angažovane u borbi protiv ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serious Situation in the Congo: UN peacekeepers evacuated healthcare workers involved in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, centered on Bunia, with 11,955 cases and 5,867 deaths to date. UN peacekeepers evacuated 10 healthcare workers trapped at a hospital in Bunia as fighting between the Congolese army and the CRP rebels disrupts response; the mission established a mobile base and intensified patrols to protect civilians in Akveu, Damas, and Mbidjo. The CRP, led by Thomas Lubanga (ICC 2012 for recruiting child soldiers), has escalated clashes despite a unilateral ceasefire. The outbreak is the worst on record; Reuters satellite analysis indicates excess mortality in Bunia above 1,000 by November, well above the official toll of 707. About 60% of deaths occur outside health facilities, and under 15% of new confirmed cases are linked to known contacts. WHO suggests true scale may be 2–4 times higher than reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ深刻な状況：国連平和維持軍、エボラ対応に従事していた医療従事者を避難させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で過去最大規模（11,955症例、5,867死亡）のエボラ流行が継続し、武力紛争により対応が阻害され、WHOは過小報告の可能性を指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCosta Rica（Damas, Provincia de San José）が含まれているが、記事主題はDRCイトゥリ州のエボラ流行のみであり無関係な地名と判断し除外した。既知感染経路の追跡率が15%未満、施設外死亡が60%に上るなど、感染制御・サーベイランス体制の脆弱性が顕著。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Salmonella outbreaks put oysters and turkey on alert this Thanksgiving
article.articleSummary: UK researchers using bacteriophages against Salmonella Infantis in a chicken-gut model reduced bacteria by 99.9% with a single dose, leaving gut microbiota largely unchanged. Brazilian Biopark in Toledo, Paraná developed a processing treatment that cut Salmonella on chicken carcasses by 99.8% in simulations of industrial conditions and reduced pork contamination by 95.4%; cost about €0.52 per metric ton; no residues and no sensory changes; patent and regulatory approval pending. Virginia’s Little Wicomico River oyster recall: Little Wicomico Oyster Company oysters harvested Sept 18–Oct 8; Nov 25 all 10 samples tested positive for Salmonella Telelkebir; river remains closed; 28 sick in 13 states; 5 hospitalized; no deaths. FDA investigating two new Salmonella Enteritidis outbreaks with 49 illnesses; sources not yet identified; CDC links to chicken and eggs; underreporting factor ~29x. For Thanksgiving, cook to 165°F; a thermometer is crucial; buttermilk marinades do not reliably kill Salmonella; dried spices can carry it.

triage.headline_ja: サルモネラ感染の多発により、感謝祭を前に牡蠣と七面鳥に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 記事は米国・英国・ブラジルでのサルモネラ対策技術や米国内リコール事案に関する内容であり、対象国（ブラジルは研究機関の技術開発の言及のみで実際の発生地域ではない）における感染症発生は確認されない。
triage.notes: 疾患名がParatyphoid/Typhoidとなっているが、記事内容は実際にはSalmonella（食中毒系、Salmonella Infantis, Telelkebir, Enteritidis等）に関するものであり分類に誤りがある可能性がある。発生国は米国（バージニア州の牡蠣リコール）と米国内の七面鳥関連アウトブレイクで、対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル（パラナ州トレド）は食品処理技術の研究開発拠点としての言及のみで、実際の感染症発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: No pior surto em 35 anos, casos de sarampo passam de 6 000 nos Estados Unidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the worst outbreak in 35 years, measles cases exceed 6,000 in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Measles in the United States now totals 6,039 confirmed cases as of Nov 24, 2026—the worst outbreak since 1991—with nine CDC-confirmed deaths and 14 total fatalities reported by state health departments. The CDC reports 43 new outbreaks this year, with transmission across 47 states and DC, including Alaska, California, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas and Washington; 18 cases involve foreign visitors. The U.S. lost its measles elimination status on Nov 17, 2026, per OPAS, after sustained domestic transmission for more than 12 months. About 96% of cases are in unvaccinated or unknown-status individuals; vaccination coverage for young children declined from 95.2% (2019–2020) to 92.4% (2025–2026), leaving about 280,000 children unprotected. Symptoms include fever, rash, cough, conjunctivitis; severe outcomes include pneumonia and encephalitis. Brazil provides measles vaccination via SUS; D1 at 12 months, D2 at 15 months; 6–11 months dose zero; 5–29 years recommendations for two-dose MMR; 30–59 years—details not provided.

triage.headline_ja: 35年で最悪の流行、米国の麻疹症例が6,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 35年ぶりの規模の麻疹流行で、麻疹排除ステータスを喪失するなど異常性が高く、死亡例や重症合併症（肺炎・脳炎）も報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国における麻疹流行（排除ステータス喪失、6,039例、14人死亡）。ブラジルは発生地域に含まれるが、記事内ではSUSによるワクチン接種制度の補足説明のみで、発生国としての主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストに米国は含まれないため、verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 VOLTA A AVANÇAR NO ESTADO DE SP; SANTA CASA DE AVARÉ NÃO REGISTRA INTERNAÇÕES PELA DOENÇA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 on the rise again in the state of São Paulo; Santa Casa de Avaré reports no COVID-19 hospitalizations.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is rising again in São Paulo state, Brazil, with Fiocruz reporting an uptick in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases linked to COVID-19, especially in late October and early November. Despite higher circulation, hospitalizations remain low, and in Avaré the Santa Casa de Misericórdia reported no admissions or suspected cases through November 24. Data up to November 17 show 1,527 Covid-19 hospitalizations in 2026, including 485 in intensive care and 206 deaths, with totals below the 2025 same period (5,169 hospitalizations and 863 deaths). Private hospitals show more positives: Hospital Sírio-Libanês had 70 October positives (vs 19 Sept, 12 Aug); Hospital Santa Catarina had 98 October positives (vs 57 Sept, 18 Aug). Vaccination remains the main protection, with about 90% of ICU Covid-19 patients not up to date; vaccination is free for eligible groups, and those with respiratory symptoms should practice hygiene, masking, and avoid exposure to high-risk individuals.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州でCOVID-19が再び増加傾向、アヴァレのサンタ・カーザは入院なしと報告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な増加であり、入院数は前年同期より低く、通常の流行範囲内と考えられ、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトは確認できない。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）の季節的変動に関する地域報道であり、入院・死亡数は前年を下回っている。ワクチン接種の重要性を啓発する内容が中心。

article.articleHeadline: LIRAa aponta alto risco de infestação pelo Aedes aegypti nas quatro cidades do Vale do Aço
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIRAa indicates a high risk of infestation by Aedes aegypti in the four cities of Vale do Aço.
article.articleSummary: Four cities in Vale do Aço—Ipatinga, Timóteo, Coronel Fabriciano, and Santana do Paraíso—reported Aedes aegypti infestation at or above 4% in November, indicating high risk for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya per LIRAa (Rapid Indices for Aedes aegypti). Santana do Paraíso led at 8.7%, followed by Timóteo 6.9%, and Ipatinga and Coronel Fabriciano at 4.7% each. In Ipatinga, an 11% hotspot spans Limoeiro, Chácara Madalena, Córrego Novo, Barra Alegre, and Chácara Oliveira, with plant pots, vases, bottles, and pet-water bowls comprising 38.7% of foci. Timóteo rose from 2.6% in September to 6.9% in November across 1,167 inspected properties (Nov 10–12). Coronel Fabriciano, after 1,740 inspections, shows Chácaras Contente and Santa Terezinha I at 33.3% each; plant pots and tanks account for 18% of foci. In Santana do Paraíso (Nov 9–13), authorities urge sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters, and removing water-collecting containers, as rainfall drives spread and community action is requested.

triage.headline_ja: LIRAaがヴァレ・ド・アソの4都市でネッタイシマカの高い感染リスクを指摘
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介指数(LIRAa)の上昇を報告するものであり、実際の症例発生報告ではないが、デング・ジカ・チクングニアの流行拡大リスクを示唆するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の生息密度調査（LIRAa）結果であり、実際の感染症患者数データは含まれていない。今後の症例発生動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: На межі вимирання. Рідкісний чагарниковий собака може зникнути через хвороби, які переносять свійські пси
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On the brink of extinction. A rare bush dog may disappear due to diseases carried by domestic dogs.
article.articleSummary: Biologists from the World Wildlife Fund (WCS) analyzed 25 years of camera-trap data across seven South American countries to assess the rare bush dog Speothos venaticus. Cameras at 97 sites over more than 611,000 nights yielded over 2.1 million images, with just 12 sightings of the species, each at a new location. The bush dog’s range stretches from Costa Rica to northeastern Argentina, but densities are extremely low—roughly 50x lower than the short-eared dog (Atelocynus microtis), 100x lower than the jaguar, and about 280x lower than the ocelot. In many areas, densities are below one individual per 100 km². Paraguay, Peru, and Venezuela had no detections despite broad surveys. The Amazon faces the greatest risk due to roads, settlements, hunting camps, and extraction. Domestic dogs may introduce canine distemper, parvovirus, or rabies to packs, risking local population collapse in small or fragmented groups. Since 2011, Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List; authors urge a status revision. Canid Biology & Conservation.

triage.headline_ja: 絶滅の危機。希少なヤブイヌが家庭犬から媒介される病気により消滅する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は野生動物（ヤブイヌ）の保全生態学研究であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の脅威や実際の狂犬病発生事例を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は野生動物保全に関する学術研究の紹介であり、ヒトの感染症発生情報ではない。言及されている国（ブラジル等）は対象国リストに含まれるが、狂犬病の実際の発生事例ではなく潜在的リスク要因としての言及に留まるため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose, doença transmitida por gatos, já infectou mais de 1,4 mil pessoas no RS em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis, a cat-transmitted disease, has already infected more than 1,400 people in Rio Grande do Sul in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, a fungal infection transmissible from cats to humans, has 1,465 confirmed human cases in Rio Grande do Sul for 2026, with most records in the Porto Alegre metropolitan region. The state reports 243 discarded and 1,051 under investigation this year; 2025 recorded 1,960 infections. In animals, 2,510 notifications for dogs and cats were logged in 2026 through voluntary reporting via the Ministry of Health electronic form. Sporothrix fungi inhabit soil, tree bark, and decomposing organic material; cats are the main zoonotic vectors, typically spreading via scratches, bites, or contact with lesion secretions. Because animal case reporting remains voluntary or faces recording barriers, official numbers likely underrepresent the fungus’s true circulation.

triage.headline_ja: 猫から感染する病気「スポロトリコーシス」、2026年にリオグランデ・ド・スルで1,400人以上が感染
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部で地域的な人獣共通感染症（真菌症）の継続的な発生が確認されているが、国際的拡大や重篤な公衆衛生危機の兆候はなく、動物媒介の地域流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル南部リオグランデ・ド・スル州における猫由来のスポロトリコーシスの継続的流行。動物側の報告が任意制であり実態把握が不十分な点が懸念されるが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Кількість зареєстрованих випадків денге у світі зросла у 34 рази -- Nature
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of registered dengue cases worldwide has increased 34-fold -- Nature.
article.articleSummary: Worldwide dengue cases rose 34-fold, from 430,000 in 1990 to 14.7 million in 2024, according to a new analysis presented 22 November at the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene meeting in National Harbor, Maryland. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and causes fever, headache, and severe bone or joint pain in warm urban settings. The study, led by Ahyon Lim of the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, harmonized disparate surveillance data and used statistical modeling to fill gaps; results were posted as a preprint on Research Square. Virologist Eng Eong Ooi of Duke-NUS Singapore, not involved in the work, notes the rise aligns with urbanization. In Brazil, the first randomized trial of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes showed a 68% lower dengue infection risk among about 6,000 children in release areas (releases of ~32 million mosquitoes from Jan 2021 to May 2022; blood samples collected 2020–2024).

triage.headline_ja: 世界のデング熱登録症例数が34倍に増加 -- Nature
triage.triage_reason: 特定国における新規アウトブレイクではなく、1990年から2024年にかけての世界的なデング熱症例数増加に関する学術研究（Nature/ASTMH発表）の紹介記事であり、即時のリスク評価を要するシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事は長期トレンドの統計分析と学術研究（ウォルバキア蚊によるデング予防効果の無作為化試験）の紹介であり、特定国での急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。ブラジルは研究実施地として言及されているが、現在進行中の発生イベントではないため対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde reforça cuidados contra a dengue nos cemitérios de Jaraguá do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health reinforces dengue precautions in the cemeteries of Jaraguá do Sul.
article.articleSummary: In Jaraguá do Sul, Brazil, health authorities intensified inspections in municipal cemeteries as part of the Municipal Dengue Control Week to curb Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Despite a post-All Souls' Day cleanup, inspectors found plastic wrapping around vase arrangements and water buildup in pots, creating breeding sites under humid, warm rainy conditions. Ongoing vigilance is urged during cemetery visits and tomb maintenance. Preventive measures include removing plastic wrappers around flower vases, using pots with drainage holes, avoiding trays, filling non-draining vases with sand, removing artificial flowers or decor that can hold water, removing empty containers, bottles and other potential breeding receptacles, checking tombs for cracks or cavities that accumulate water, and properly disposing of decayed flowers and waste. Community participation is essential; even small amounts of standing water can sustain mosquito populations.

triage.headline_ja: ジャラグア・ド・スルの墓地でデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱予防・啓発活動の報告であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定期的な蚊媒介性疾患の予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数・重症度の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo Water Firm Denies E. coli Claims
article.articleSummary: Sabesp, São Paulo state's main water utility, says it is the target of a coordinated misinformation campaign about water quality after Instagram posts claimed Escherichia coli contamination in tap water. The posts, traced to at least 32 profiles and 89 posts on 23–24 November 2026, allegedly misread laboratory results. Sabesp reports subsequent water samples in the cited distribution areas tested negative for E. coli and met four other potability parameters. Brazilian rules require E. coli absence in a 100-mL sample (Portaria GM/MS nº 888, 4 May 2021); a single positive reading triggers out-of-standard status, prompting retests. All results are recorded in Sisagua and publicly accessible on Sabesp’s site; out-of-standard findings trigger immediate investigation and reporting to Vigilância. Sabesp did not name affected localities and is pursuing responsibility in court; no confirmed contamination to date.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの水道会社、大腸菌汚染の主張を否定
triage.triage_reason: 水道水の大腸菌汚染はSNS上の誤情報とされ、再検査では陰性で汚染は確認されていないため、公衆衛生上の実質的リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: SNS上での誤情報拡散が主題であり、実際のE. coli感染症イベントではないため対象国の該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura realizará dia D de combate a Dengue em Sena Madureira no próximo sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall will hold Dengue D-Day in Sena Madureira next Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Dengue D-Day will be held on Saturday, November 28, in Sena Madureira, Brazil, organized by the City Hall via the Municipal Health Secretariat and Semsur, with activities concentrated in the Nenê das Neves neighborhood and support from Endemias teams. Authorities have already cleaned several districts, including Cristo Libertador, Jorge Alves Junior and Rosa Gonçalves, removing debris to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Serginey Amorim, Health Surveillance coordinator, urges residents to keep yards clean and place backyard trash on street edges for collection by Semsur during the mutirão. Endemias agents conduct door-to-door guidance and measures to neutralize breeding sites. The dengue situation is currently controlled, but ongoing prevention is essential; dengue may present as classic or hemorrhagic, the latter being potentially fatal.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所、来週土曜日にセナ・マドゥレイラでデング熱対策「Dデー」を実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱予防のための地域啓発活動・清掃キャンペーンに関する内容であり、現状は「制御下にある」と明記されている。異常な流行拡大や深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地域行政による予防啓発・清掃活動の告知記事であり、デング熱の状況は「制御下」と明記されている。具体的な症例数や死亡者数の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : MSF annonce le transfert progressif de la gestion du CTE de Mongbwalu au ministère de la santé ‎
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: MSF announces the gradual transfer of the management of the Mongbwalu Ebola Treatment Center to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: MSF begins a gradual handover of the Mongwalu Ebola Treatment Center in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, to the Ministry of Health as part of the response to the 17th Ebola outbreak. The transfer, agreed with the Mongbwalu health zone authorities, takes effect on 30 November 2026. The center will maintain a 20-bed capacity (10 beds for suspected cases and 10 for confirmed Ebola). The move aims to strengthen national and local management while allowing MSF to redeploy resources to other zones with ongoing needs. Ituri’s Ebola response continues, with authorities cautioning that the disease remains circulating; communities should maintain prevention measures and seek care promptly if symptoms arise. Mongbwalu, a rural commune about 85 km north of Bunia in Djugu territory, was the epicenter of the 17th Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak before the May declaration.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ:MSFがモングバルのエボラ治療センターの管理を保健省へ段階的に移管すると発表
triage.triage_reason: 既知の第17次エボラ流行（コンゴ民主共和国・イトゥリ州）における治療センターの運営移管に関する継続報道であり、新規発生や急激な状況変化を示すものではないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は第17次エボラ流行（5月宣言）の継続対応に関するもので、MSFから保健省への治療センター管理移管という運営上の動きが主題。感染拡大の新規性は低いが、エボラの疾患特性上、感染が継続している地域であるため引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Conflitos armados forçam retirada de equipes de combate ao Ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Armed conflicts force withdrawal of Ebola response teams in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to worsen as armed clashes in eastern DRC forced response teams to withdraw. The outbreak, detected in May 2026 in Ituri Province, has infected over 11,700 people and killed more than 5,700 across eight provinces, making it the deadliest of the country’s 17 outbreaks. Fighting blocked road access to Akwe and Mongbwalu, hampering contact tracing, patient transport, and safe burials. About 12 people—including two WHO staff and Congolese health officials—were evacuated from a hospital in Akwe to Bunia, the Ituri capital, on 24 November. The WHO temporarily moved teams from Mongbwalu to Bunia as security deteriorated. In Nord-Kivu, attacks displaced over 20,000 people and disrupted surveillance of exposed individuals. A humanitarian team came under fire on 23 November, sought UN protection, and was escorted to Bunia. Rebels under the Convention for the Popular Revolution claimed to halt their advance toward Bunia; authorities say they were repelled, but security remains unstable.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で武力衝突によりエボラ対応チームが撤退を余儀なくされる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模（感染1万1700人超、死者5700人超）のエボラ流行が進行中であり、武力衝突により対応活動が阻害され国際的な懸念・支援ニーズが高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 2026年5月にイトゥリ州で検知されたエボラ流行は8州に拡大し、同国史上17回の流行の中で最も致死的。武力衝突により接触者追跡・患者搬送・安全埋葬などの対応活動が妨げられ、WHO職員を含む要員が避難する事態となっている。治安悪化が感染拡大・対応能力に直結するため高い懸念が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Por que o Brasil vive surto de mpox? O que se sabe -- e o que não se sabe -- sobre os novos casos da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is Brazil experiencing an mpox outbreak? What is known -- and what is not known -- about the new mpox cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 November 2026, Brazil has 1,499 mpox cases this year, up 39.4% from 2025, with São Paulo tallying 120 cases in November through 24 November (vs 81 in October, 22 in September). Nationally, cases remain far below 2022’s 10,591. Epidemiologists cite ongoing transmission, susceptible populations, limited vaccination, and diagnostic delays, with mpox sometimes presenting discreet lesions that hinder detection. The circulating lineage appears to be clade 1b, the newer Congo-associated variant; however, severity mirrors clade 2b, so not evidently more dangerous. Spatial distribution is not fully explained, though population density and travel may play roles; Ceará’s rise warrants investigation. Brazil has acquired 25,000 vaccine doses, with WHO recommending vaccination targeted to high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルはなぜmpoxの流行に見舞われているのか？新たな症例について分かっていること・分かっていないこと
triage.triage_reason: clade 1b（コンゴ関連の新系統）がブラジル国内で継続的に伝播しており、地理的拡大の要因が不明な点やワクチン不足など、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスクに該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: clade 1b（アフリカ由来系統）がブラジル国内で継続伝播している点が特に注目される。重症度は既存のclade 2bと同程度とされるが、地理的拡大の要因（人口密度・渡航等）が未解明であり、セアラ州での増加も要調査とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Time to tip scales against tuberculosis in India
article.articleSummary: India accounts for about a quarter of global TB cases, with persistent transmission and rising drug resistance. Researchers at Bengaluru's Indian Institute of Science report that pairing isoniazid with vancomycin restores its effectiveness: mutations hinder isoniazid activation, while vancomycin enables entry to kill the bacillus. In vitro, the combination yielded roughly a 90% reduction in TB growth and is awaiting clinical trials. TB imposes heavy costs: 2021 deaths reached 3.93 lakh, with non-health GDP losses around ₹85,000 crore; 2025 deaths were about 2.63 lakh. India’s TB programs, NTEP and TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, reduced mortality by about 38% through 2025, surpassing the global 35% decline. The research emphasizes overcoming multi-drug resistance at the molecular level to tip the scales against TB, drawing on past smallpox and polio successes.

triage.headline_ja: インドで結核に対抗する好機
triage.triage_reason: 結核治療薬の研究進展と既存のTB対策プログラムに関する解説記事であり、異常な発生事象や急性的な公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核（既知の流行病）に関する研究・政策論評であり、天然痘・ポリオは過去の成功例として言及されているのみ。急性アウトブレイクのシグナルではないため対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo Ronaldo intensifica combate à dengue e chikungunya em Feira de Santana; Bairro Tomba registra 379 casos prováveis de chikungunya em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ronaldo's government intensifies the fight against dengue and chikungunya in Feira de Santana; Tomba neighborhood records 379 probable chikungunya cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil – The municipal health department intensifies control of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika during a Week of Mobilization from Nov 23–28, 2026, culminating in a Day D on Dec 5, 2026 (8:00–14:00) at Praça do Tomba. Activities include health-unit and school education, home visits, shop and waste-site inspections, and elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites, with focal larvicide treatment when needed. The Day D also features the Operação Bota-Fora in partnership with Sesp to collect inservíveis (sofas, beds, mattresses, tires) and remove water-holding items. Inspections extend to tire shops, junkyards, depots, and vacant lots to identify possible breeding contexts beyond homes. In Tomba, 136 probable dengue and 379 probable chikungunya cases have been recorded in 2026 through Nov 24, rising from 2025 (38 dengue, 2 chikungunya). Community blitzes and a public walk aim to boost prevention, awareness of arboviruses' symptoms, and medical care-seeking.

triage.headline_ja: ロナウド市長の政府、フェイラ・デ・サンタナでデング熱・チクングニア熱対策を強化；トンバ地区で2026年にチクングニア熱疑い379例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイア州の一地区における定例的なデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の予防啓発キャンペーンに関する報道であり、異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す記述はなく、地方自治体レベルの通常対応にとどまる。
triage.notes: 前年比で地区内のチクングニア熱疑い例が大幅増加（2例→379例）しているが、記事は地方自治体による媒介蚊対策強化キャンペーンの告知が主旨であり、重症度や国際的拡大に関する情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de gripe aviária é registrdo em São Mateus, no Espírito Santo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza case registered in São Mateus, Espírito Santo.
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza confirmed in domestic birds in São Mateus, northern Espírito Santo, Brazil. The outbreak occurred on a subsistence backyard farm with no involvement of commercial poultry. Diagnosis was confirmed on Tuesday, 24 November 2026; the following day, all birds on the property were culled as part of sanitary control measures. The event is in a peri-urban area and is being monitored to prevent further cases. Surveillance covers properties within a 3-kilometer radius for 28 days, with reinforced biosecurity guidance for producers. An emergency meeting of the Espírito Santo Avian Influenza Steering Committee, with public sector and poultry industry representatives, discussed prevention, monitoring, and control strategies and the need to alert producers. The virus has been present in Espírito Santo since May 2023. Rapid notification is urged via the e-Sisbravet system.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・エスピリトサント州サンマテウスで鳥インフルエンザの症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（裏庭飼育）での高病原性鳥インフルエンザ発生で、ヒトへの感染報告はなく国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていないが、動物衛生面での監視が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ヒト感染の報告はなく、裏庭家禽での発生。2023年5月から当地域でウイルスが存在しており、継続的な監視対象となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese Brucella Canis Genomes Reveal Divergent Lineages and Heterogeneous
article.articleSummary: 77 Brucella canis genomes analyzed reveal Mainland China isolates belong to sequence type 21 but exhibit divergent lineages and heterogeneous backgrounds. The set includes 11 Chinese isolates (seven human cases, four canine infections, 1988–2025) and 66 genomes from other countries, enabling global comparison. Using ANI, nine-locus MLST, core-genome SNP phylogeny, and fastBAPS, researchers identify five major clades across the 77 genomes. All Chinese isolates cluster in fastBAPS cluster 4 and split into two subgroups: Subgroup A (eight Chinese) linked to Japan and South Korea; Subgroup B (three Chinese) linked to Ukraine and South Africa. Within cluster 4, Chinese isolates show 0–128 core-genome SNP differences, indicating substantial genetic diversity despite sharing sequence type 21. The findings broaden knowledge of B. canis diversity in Mainland China and support enhanced surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 中国産ブルセラ・カニスのゲノム解析、多様な系統と異質な遺伝的背景を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存分離株の遺伝子系統解析に関する学術研究であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年までの既存分離株（1988-2025年）の遺伝学的比較研究であり、新規症例発生や流行の報告ではない。日本・韓国・ウクライナ・南アフリカは比較対象として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Zoliflodacin (NUZOLVENCE®) Receives WHO Recommendation as Alternative Treatment for Uncomplicated Urogenital Gonorrhea
article.articleSummary: Zoliflodacin (NUZOLVENCE) gains WHO guideline recommending it as an oral alternative to ceftriaxone for uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhea, expanding global access where appropriate. NUZOLVENCE is now the only oral alternative to ceftriaxone for this indication. The global gonorrhea burden is about 82 million new infections annually, with the United States reporting roughly 500,000 cases per year and over 1 million new infections overall. Neisseria gonorrhoeae has developed resistance to all antibiotic classes, including ceftriaxone—the widely used intramuscular mainstay. The guidance cites Phase 3 evidence and aims to broaden access to NUZOLVENCE. NUZOLVENCE is a first-in-class, single-dose oral antibiotic approved in the U.S. and Thailand for uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhea in patients aged 12+ and weighing at least 35 kg. FDA approval was December 2025; Thai FDA followed six months later. Safety concerns include embryo-fetal toxicity, potential male fertility effects, hypersensitivity, and Clostridioides difficile infection risk, with contraindication in those taking strong CYP3A4 inducers.

triage.headline_ja: ゾリフロダシン（NUZOLVENCE）、単純性尿路性器淋病の代替治療薬としてWHOの推奨を取得
triage.triage_reason: 新薬の承認・治療ガイドライン更新に関する製薬企業発の記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントや異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規抗菌薬の承認・WHO推奨に関する製薬ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイはFDA承認国として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital registra aumento de pacientes com sintomas gripais em Sena Madureira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital records increase in patients with flu-like symptoms in Sena Madureira.
article.articleSummary: Influenza-like illness cases rise at Hospital João Câncio Fernandes in Sena Madureira as of November 2026, with more people seeking care for cough, fever, and diarrhea. The article notes increased patient visits at the hospital during November, triggering alerts from hospital administration and local health authorities. No laboratory confirmation or specific pathogen is reported. Health officials emphasize preventive measures to curb transmission, including frequent handwashing with soap and water or alcohol gel, avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, ensuring well-ventilated environments, not sharing personal items, and covering the mouth and nose with the elbow or a disposable tissue when coughing or sneezing. People presenting symptoms are advised to avoid crowds when possible and wear masks in public, and to seek medical attention if symptoms worsen, especially for shortness of breath, persistent fever, or dehydration. Avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: セナ・マドゥレイラの病院でインフルエンザ様症状の患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: 特定病原体の検査確認がなく季節性インフルエンザ様疾患の増加に留まるが、地域での患者増加と公衆衛生当局の注意喚起があるため継続観察とする。
triage.notes: 病原体の検査確認なし。局地的な病院での患者増加報告であり、全国規模の拡大や重症度の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Wolbachia Cuts Dengue Infections in Brazilian Children
article.articleSummary: Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti released in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, substantially reduced arboviral infections among schoolchildren in the EVITA trial (2020–2024). Nearly 6,000 children were randomized to Wolbachia deployment or standard control measures; routine blood tests showed arboviral infection positivity of 4% in Wolbachia areas versus 14% in control areas, during the city’s largest dengue outbreak in its history. The intervention was 68.5% effective against dengue and 73.3% against chikungunya. Wolbachia bacteria inhibit virus replication in mosquitoes and spread through offspring, enabling local transmission suppression. The four-year study provides strong evidence that large-scale Wolbachia releases can reduce dengue and chikungunya transmissions in dense urban settings.

triage.headline_ja: ウォルバキアがブラジルの子供たちのデング熱感染を減少
triage.triage_reason: 研究成果に関する報告であり、新規感染症の発生や公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事象ではない。既存の対策技術の有効性を示す学術的内容。
triage.notes: 本記事は2020-2024年に実施されたウォルバキア蚊を用いた媒介制御研究(EVITA trial)の結果報告であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクの速報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Primer lote de medicamentos de la India cubrirá a pacientes de VIH, diabetes y malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first batch of medicines from India will cover patients with HIV, diabetes, and malaria.
article.articleSummary: Ecuador will distribute a first batch of 9,155,939 medicines from India to treat HIV, tuberculosis, diabetes, and malaria within its public health system. The stock is stored in Quito at MSP warehouses, with initial deliveries planned for Friday, 27 November 2026 in Guayaquil at Hospital General Monte Sinaí and Bastión Popular Type C Health Center. The shipment breakdown includes 9,114,200 units for HIV and TB, 29,000 units of intermediate-acting insulin (NPH), and 12,739 units of antimalarials. Distribution will occur in stages through November–December 2026 and continue into 2027 via the 24 Provincial Health Directorates under the 'La Medicina Llega' campaign. The purchase was a government-to-government deal after a bilateral MOU, with public company AIL E.P. and MSP overseeing. Regulatory controls involve FDA-approved labs and Arcsa credential verification, aiming to reach 80% hospital supply by December 2026 and later add oncology and dialysis meds.

triage.headline_ja: インドからの医薬品第一便、HIV・糖尿病・マラリア患者に提供へ
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生ではなく、エクアドルにおける医薬品供給・配布に関する行政ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はエクアドルの医薬品調達・配布計画に関する内容で、インドは医薬品供給元として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。対象国リストにエクアドルは含まれないため該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Miraí registra 23 casos suspeitos de Covid-19 em uma semana, aponta boletim epidemiológico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miraí records 23 suspected COVID-19 cases in one week, according to the epidemiological bulletin.
article.articleSummary: In Miraí, a municipality in the Zona da Mata region of Minas Gerais, Brazil, 23 suspected COVID-19 cases were recorded from November 17-24, 2026, according to the Weekly Epidemiological Bulletin published November 25, 2026. All patients presented mild influenza-like illness symptoms and remain in home isolation under clinical monitoring while awaiting or undergoing diagnostic testing per protocol. There were no cases progressing to Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG), and no hospitalizations or deaths related to COVID-19 in the period. The Epidemiological Surveillance urges symptomatic individuals to wear masks, wash hands, seek testing at health facilities when needed, and keep vaccination up to date. While the 23 cases are suspected and mild, authorities advise vigilance and prompt medical care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: ミライ市、週間疫学速報で新型コロナ疑い例23件を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市における軽症のCOVID-19疑い例の定例報告であり、重症化・入院・死亡例もなく、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体の定例疫学速報であり、全例軽症・在宅経過観察中。既知の疾患(COVID-19)の季節的な軽微な増加とみられる。

diseases.name: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Antarctic Seabirds Harbor Avian Flu Lineages Linked to South American
article.articleSummary: Active circulation of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b was detected in Antarctic seabirds during the 2024–2025 austral summer. Genomic analysis of isolates from the South Shetland Islands (King George Island, Half Moon, Robert, Livingston, Snow, Nelson) shows clade 2.3.4.4b with direct genetic connectivity to contemporary South American lineages detected along the southern Atlantic coast, indicating intercontinental spread into Antarctic avifauna. Field work during the 43rd Antarctic Operation (Nov 2024–Jan 2025) yielded 278 samples from four species—gentoo and chinstrap penguins, southern giant petrels, and south polar skuas—comprising 166 cloacal excreta plus paired sampling from 56 birds (56 cloacal and 56 orotracheal swabs). Laboratory processing at the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul used MagMAX CORE RNA extraction and real-time RT-PCR targeting the influenza A matrix gene; CT thresholds were <30 high loads, 30–36 low positives, >36 negative. The findings document sustained viral dissemination in southern polar ecosystems and highlight intercontinental transmission via ecological networks.

triage.headline_ja: 南極の海鳥、南米のアウトブレイクに関連する鳥インフルエンザ系統を保有
triage.triage_reason: H5N1クレード2.3.4.4bの大陸間伝播という学術的に重要な知見だが、発生は南極海鳥が主体であり、対象国（ブラジル等）での直接的な発生事例ではないため、現時点でのフルRRAへの移行は見送り、継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事は南極海鳥（南シェトランド諸島）でのH5N1検出と、ブラジル・南大西洋岸の既存株との遺伝的連関を報告する学術研究。ブラジルは検体解析を行った研究機関（Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul）の所在地として言及されているのみで、ブラジル国内での新規発生事例ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はないと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: BH soma 13 mortes e mais de 800 casos confirmados neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Belo Horizonte reports 13 deaths and more than 800 confirmed cases this year.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurges in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, with 837 confirmed cases and 13 deaths in 2026 as of November 25. Test positivity peaked around 37% in epidemiological week 44, then fell to 29% and 30% in the following weeks; week 46 recorded over 1,000 tests. The 14-day incidence rose from 2.3 per 100,000 on November 2 to 6.3 on November 16, then 5.7 on November 18. Total notifications reached 30,660, with 837 confirmed and 13 deaths, predominantly among those aged 60 and over (12 deaths), plus one death in 40–59; 8 women and 5 men. Context: 2021 had 204,352 cases and 4,714 deaths; 2025 had 2,815 confirmations and 55 deaths. Respiratory-symptom activity includes 14,225 hospitalizations for respiratory diseases in 2026, of which 146 were COVID-19. Private sector testing (Drogaria Araujo) showed 30.3% positivity in early November, with a 341% rise in testing demand versus 2025. Vaccination remains key to preventing severe cases; high-risk groups should stay up to date, and masking or medical advice is advised if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19:ベロオリゾンテで今年13人死亡、確認症例800件超
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の疾患で季節的な再流行の範囲内であり、既存の公衆衛生対応で管理可能、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの季節性COVID-19動向報告であり、過去年（2021年）と比較しても規模は大幅に縮小している。既知の疾患であり通常の監視対応で十分。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente diagnosticado com mpox foge de Hospital Universitário de Divinópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient diagnosed with mpox escapes from Divinópolis University Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, Brazil: a 36-year-old man diagnosed with mpox escaped Divinópolis University Hospital, prompting search efforts by the Municipal Health Secretariat and Social Approach teams; Civil and Military Police were alerted. Authorities warn that the patient must receive care and observe isolation to prevent transmission; noncompliance with isolation can be a crime under Article 268 of the Brazilian Penal Code, with penalties from one month to one year in detention and fines. The year’s first mpox case in Divinópolis was confirmed November 18, a 19-year-old patient admitted to UPA Padre Roberto in stable condition and isolated. Mpox is caused by MPXV and transmits mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects; close contact and exposure to respiratory secretions can also spread infection. Symptoms: skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, fatigue. Incubation 3–21 days.

article.articleHeadline: Thailand launches AI-assisted TB screening for public transport drivers
article.articleSummary: Bangkok, Thailand — A pilot TB screening campaign using mobile digital chest X-ray and AI began on Nov 24 in Bangkok, targeting public transport drivers and the general public. Led by the Department of Disease Control (DDC) and Department of Land Transport (DLT), the initiative drew over 500 participants. Thailand reports about 101,000 new TB cases annually (≈142 per 100,000 people) per the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026. The program advances the DDC’s Four Accelerated Measures to End TB: proactive screening, rapid diagnosis, timely treatment, and increased public awareness. Mobile units identify potential abnormalities; those needing evaluation receive molecular diagnostic testing, counseling, and referrals for treatment. DLT aims to expand to other transport workers and at-risk groups nationwide. The event offered fitness-to-drive checks, influenza vaccines, health consultations, and education; TB screening is urged for persistent coughs or close TB contact via hotline 1422.

Across Paraíba, total confirmed infections stand at 22, with cases also reported in Cabedelo, Campina Grande, Conceição, and Cajazeiras. Vaccination is available for priority groups aged 18 and older. Reported symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, muscle pains, and fatigue. The health department (Secretaria de Estado da Saúde) indicates an ongoing outbreak with local transmission across multiple municipalities; no further details on infection sources or import/export of cases are provided.
